aardvark.en: Ecologists studying African grasslands note that the aardvark, by digging extensive burrows, reshapes the soil and creates shelter for dozens of smaller species.
aardvark.zh: 生态学家在研究非洲草原时注意到，土豚通过挖掘大量洞穴改变了土壤结构，并为数十种较小的物种创造了栖身之所。

aback.en: Economists were taken aback when inflation accelerated even as unemployment rose, a combination that standard models had long ruled out.
aback.zh: 令经济学家们大吃一惊的是，通胀竟在失业率上升之际进一步加剧，而这一组合正是标准模型长期排除的情形。

abacus.en: Long before electronic calculators appeared, merchants across Asia relied on the abacus, a device that trained users in remarkably rapid mental arithmetic.
abacus.zh: 在电子计算器出现之前很久，亚洲各地的商人就依赖算盘，这种器具还训练使用者掌握了惊人的快速心算能力。

abalone.en: Tight export controls on abalone were introduced after poaching reduced wild stocks to levels that marine biologists warned were beyond recovery.
abalone.zh: 在盗捕使野生鲍鱼种群降至海洋生物学家警告无法恢复的水平之后，各国实施了严格的鲍鱼出口管制。

abandon.en: Firms rarely abandon a profitable technology voluntarily; more often, regulation or changing consumer habits force the shift toward cleaner alternatives.
abandon.zh: 企业很少自愿放弃有利可图的技术，更多时候是监管或消费习惯的变化迫使它们转向更清洁的替代品。

abandonment.en: Rural depopulation has led to the widespread abandonment of farmland, which ecologists say may actually benefit certain endangered birds.
abandonment.zh: 农村人口减少导致农田被广泛撂荒，生态学家认为这或许反而对某些濒危鸟类有利。

abash.en: Harsh public rebukes seldom abash a determined politician; they tend instead to harden his support among loyal followers.
abash.zh: 严厉的公开斥责很少能让一位意志坚定的政治家感到羞愧，反而往往使他在忠实拥趸中的立场更加强硬。

abate.en: Epidemiologists caution that the outbreak will not abate until vaccination reaches the remote districts where reporting is least reliable.
abate.zh: 流行病学家警告说，在疫苗接种覆盖到报告最不可靠的偏远地区之前，疫情不会减退。

abatement.en: Cities that invest in noise abatement along busy corridors report measurable gains in residents' sleep quality and school performance.
abatement.zh: 在繁忙交通走廊沿线投入降噪治理的城市报告说，居民睡眠质量和学生学业表现都有可测量的改善。

abates.en: Once the floodwater abates, engineers must assess whether the levee can withstand the next season's storms.
abates.zh: 洪水一旦减退，工程师们就必须评估堤坝能否经受住下一汛期的风暴。

abattoir.en: Documentaries filmed inside a modern abattoir have done more to change eating habits than decades of vegetarian campaigning.
abattoir.zh: 在现代化屠宰场内拍摄的纪录片对改变饮食习惯所起的作用，超过了数十年的素食宣传。

abbey.en: The medieval abbey, once a center of learning and agriculture, now attracts more visitors than the town's entire museum district.
abbey.zh: 这座曾经集学术与农业中心于一身的中世纪修道院，如今吸引的游客比该镇整个博物馆区还要多。

abbreviate.en: Academic writers abbreviate journal titles in citations, a convention that saves space but often bewilders readers new to the field.
abbreviate.zh: 学术作者在引文中缩写期刊名称，这一惯例节省了篇幅，却常常令初入该领域的读者感到困惑。

abbreviation.en: Even the abbreviation of a scientific term can shape thought, as when DNA replaced the far clumsier full name.
abbreviation.zh: 即便是科学术语的缩写也能影响思维，比如DNA就取代了原本冗长得多的全称。

abdicate.en: Constitutional scholars argue that legislators who delegate every hard question to expert agencies in effect abdicate their representative duty.
abdicate.zh: 宪法学者认为，把所有难题都推给专家机构的立法者，实际上等于放弃了自身的代议职责。

abdication.en: Historians still debate whether the king's abdication in 1936 was an act of principle or merely personal preference.
abdication.zh: 史学界仍在争论，国王1936年的退位究竟是出于原则，还是仅仅出于个人偏好。

abdomen.en: The ultrasound scan revealed no abnormalities in the patient's abdomen, so physicians ordered further tests to explain the persistent pain.
abdomen.zh: 超声扫描未发现患者腹部有任何异常，因此医生要求做进一步检查以解释其持续的疼痛。

abdominal.en: Surgeons now favor small incisions for many abdominal operations, a shift that shortens hospital stays and lowers infection rates.
abdominal.zh: 如今外科医生做许多腹部手术都倾向于采用小切口，这一转变缩短了住院时间并降低了感染率。

abduct.en: Criminologists note that strangers rarely abduct children; in most documented cases the perpetrator is already known to the family.
abduct.zh: 犯罪学家指出，陌生人绑架儿童的情况其实很少见，在有记载的大多数案件中，加害者都是家人认识的人。

abductee.en: Interviews with each former abductee revealed consistent details about the camp, details no single witness could have fabricated.
abductee.zh: 对每位获释被绑架者的访谈都显示出关于营地的一致细节，而这些细节绝非任何单个证人所能编造。

abduction.en: The child's abduction prompted a national debate about whether schools should control exits more strictly during the day.
abduction.zh: 这起儿童绑架案引发了一场全国性辩论：学校是否应在白天更严格地管控出口。

abductor.en: Forensic evidence finally identified the abductor, whose profile had sat unmatched in the national database for eleven years.
abductor.zh: 法医证据最终查明了绑架者的身份，其特征数据在数据库中沉寂十一年无人比对。

aberrant.en: Statistical checks flag aberrant test scores so that examiners can investigate suspected cheating before results are certified.
aberrant.zh: 统计核查会标记出异常的考试分数，以便考官在成绩认定之前调查涉嫌作弊的行为。

aberration.en: Economists disagree over whether the 2020 recession was a temporary aberration or the start of a structural slowdown.
aberration.zh: 经济学家对2020年的衰退究竟是一次暂时性偏差，还是结构性放缓的开端，意见并不一致。

aberrational.en: Analysts concluded that the quarter's wild price swings were aberrational rather than evidence of a new market regime.
aberrational.zh: 分析人士断定，该季度剧烈的价格波动属于失常现象，而非新市场格局确立的迹象。

abet.en: Judges who knowingly accept forged evidence do not merely err; they abet the fraud they later purport to punish.
abet.zh: 明知证据系伪造却仍加以采信的法官不只是犯错误，他们是在纵容自己事后又声称要惩处的欺诈行为。

abetting.en: Laws against aiding and abetting financial crime were tightened after it became clear that intermediaries faced almost no personal risk.
abetting.zh: 在人们看清中介机构几乎不承担任何个人风险之后，针对协助和教唆金融犯罪的法律被收紧了。

abeyance.en: Plans for the high-speed line were held in abeyance for a decade until revised cost estimates revived parliamentary interest.
abeyance.zh: 高铁线路的规划被搁置了十年，直到修订后的成本估算重新激起议会的兴趣。

abhor.en: Survey data suggest younger consumers abhor wasteful packaging far more than earlier generations did, pushing retailers to redesign.
abhor.zh: 调查数据显示，年轻消费者对浪费性包装的反感远超上一代人，这促使零售商重新设计包装。

abhorrence.en: The philosopher argued that our abhorrence of cruelty, not abstract reasoning, is the true foundation of moral progress.
abhorrence.zh: 这位哲学家认为，真正构成道德进步基础的，是人们对残忍行为的憎恶，而非抽象的推理。

abhorrent.en: Practices once tolerated in colonial administration are now regarded as abhorrent, a shift that took generations of argument.
abhorrent.zh: 曾在殖民行政中被容忍的做法如今被视为可憎，这一观念转变经历了数代人的论争。

abide.en: Companies that publicly commit to ethical guidelines are still expected to abide by them when profits are at stake.
abide.zh: 公开承诺遵守道德准则的企业，在利润攸关之时仍被期望切实遵守这些准则。

ability.en: A child's ability to delay gratification predicts later outcomes only weakly, according to large replication studies of the famous marshmallow experiments.
ability.zh: 对著名棉花糖实验的大规模重复研究表明，儿童延迟满足的能力对其日后表现的预测力相当有限。

abject.en: The commission's report describes abject poverty in regions barely an hour's drive from the capital's business districts.
abject.zh: 委员会的报告描述了距首都商务区仅一小时车程的部分地区所处的赤贫状态。

ablate.en: Ophthalmologists use precisely calibrated lasers to ablate microscopic layers of corneal tissue, reshaping the eye without a single incision.
ablate.zh: 眼科医生用经过精确校准的激光消融微小的角膜组织层，无需任何切口就能重塑角膜曲率。

ablation.en: Studying the ablation of Arctic sea ice with buoys and satellites helps scientists model how quickly the winter cover is thinning.
ablation.zh: 借助浮标与卫星研究北极海冰的消融，有助于科学家模拟冬季冰盖变薄的速度。

ablaze.en: Contemporary accounts describe the parliament building ablaze within minutes of the first crowd breaking through the gates.
ablaze.zh: 据当时记载，人群突破大门后仅几分钟，议会大厦便燃起大火。

abloom.en: Travel writers describe the desert floor as abloom for barely three weeks each spring, a brief spectacle the regional economy has learned to monetize.
abloom.zh: 旅行作家写道，沙漠地表每年春季仅有大约三周繁花盛开，当地经济已学会把这一短暂奇观变现。

ablution.en: Anthropologists treat the morning ablution as a social ritual as much as a matter of hygiene, varying widely across cultures.
ablution.zh: 人类学家把晨间盥洗视为一种社会仪式，其意义不亚于卫生本身，且在不同文化间差异极大。

ably.en: The interim director ably managed the transition, though few outside the department noticed how near collapse the accounts had been.
ably.zh: 代理主管干练地完成了过渡，尽管部门之外几乎无人察觉财务曾濒临崩溃。

abnegation.en: Critics of heroic individualism read the hermit's abnegation not as escape but as a protest against market values.
abnegation.zh: 批评个人英雄主义的人认为，隐修者的自我舍弃并非逃避，而是对市场价值观的一种抗议。

abnormal.en: Psychologists warn that labeling normal grief abnormal can push patients into treatment they do not need.
abnormal.zh: 心理学家警告，把正常的悲伤标注为异常，可能使患者接受本不需要的治疗。

abnormality.en: A single abnormality on the scan rarely justifies invasive surgery, and second opinions frequently overturn the initial recommendation.
abnormality.zh: 扫描中仅有一处异常很少足以支持进行创伤性手术，第二诊疗意见常常推翻最初的建议。

abnormally.en: Insurance actuaries have begun pricing abnormally warm winters into premiums, a quiet acknowledgment of shifting climate risk.
abnormally.zh: 保险精算师已开始把异常温暖的冬季计入保费定价，这是对气候风险变化的无声承认。

aboard.en: Regulators tightened rules after investigators found that the crew aboard the ferry had never rehearsed a full evacuation.
aboard.zh: 调查人员发现渡轮上的船员从未演练过完整的撤离程序之后，监管机构收紧了相关规则。

abolish.en: Economists long predicted that automation would abolish routine clerical work, yet employment in such roles has proved surprisingly durable.
abolish.zh: 经济学家曾长期预测自动化将消灭常规文书工作，但此类岗位的就业却出人意料地持久。

abolition.en: Historians date the abolition of capital punishment in Britain to 1965, though the last executions occurred two years earlier.
abolition.zh: 史学家把英国废除死刑的时间定在1965年，尽管最后一次执行发生在两年之前。

abolitionism.en: American abolitionism began as a scattered religious movement and matured, within two generations, into a mass political force.
abolitionism.zh: 美国废奴主义起初是一场分散的宗教运动，不到两代人便发展成群众性的政治力量。

abolitionist.en: Each abolitionist newspaper faced mob violence and postal bans, which its editors treated as proof of their influence.
abolitionist.zh: 每一家废奴主义报纸都遭到暴徒袭扰和邮政封禁，其编辑将此视为自身影响力的明证。

abominable.en: Early alpine guidebooks describe abominable snow conditions matter-of-factly, assuming that any reader would expect suffering as part of the climb.
abominable.zh: 早期阿尔卑斯登山指南以平实的笔调描述恶劣的雪况，默认任何读者都会把吃苦当作攀登的一部分。

abomination.en: What one generation dismisses as mere fashion, the next may condemn as an aesthetic abomination, as architectural debates repeatedly show.
abomination.zh: 建筑界的争论一再表明，被一代人视为寻常时尚的东西，可能被下一代人斥为彻底的审美异端。

aboriginal.en: Landmark court rulings have affirmed aboriginal title to vast territories, redrawing the map of resource development across Canada.
aboriginal.zh: 具有里程碑意义的法院裁决确认了原住民对广袤土地的所有权，重新划定了加拿大资源开发的版图。

aborigine.en: The diary of a young aborigine, dictated to a missionary in 1890, is now regarded as a foundational text of the national literature.
aborigine.zh: 一位年轻土著1890年向传教士口述的日记，如今被视为该国文学的奠基性文本。

abort.en: Mission control had only seconds to abort the launch once telemetry showed pressure falling in the second stage.
abort.zh: 一旦遥测数据显示第二级火箭压力下降，地面控制中心只有几秒钟时间来中止发射。

abortion.en: The debate over abortion has shaped party alignments in America for half a century, outlasting most other social issues.
abortion.zh: 围绕堕胎的争论塑造了美国半个世纪的政党格局，其持久性超过大多数其他社会议题。

abortionist.en: Nineteenth-century newspapers denounced every back-street abortionist, yet their advertisements ran in the very same columns.
abortionist.zh: 十九世纪的报纸痛斥每一位地下堕胎医生，但他们的广告就登在同一份报纸的栏目里。

abortive.en: The company's abortive attempt to enter the phone market consumed research funding that its core division desperately needed.
abortive.zh: 该公司进军手机市场的尝试以失败告终，耗尽了核心部门急需的研发资金。

abound.en: Warnings about artificial intelligence abound, yet rigorous assessments of its actual workplace impact remain surprisingly scarce.
abound.zh: 关于人工智能的警告比比皆是，但对其职场实际影响的严谨评估却少得出奇。

aboveboard.en: Public procurement reforms were sold as a way to keep every stage of bidding strictly aboveboard and auditable.
aboveboard.zh: 政府采购改革的初衷，是让招标的每个环节都严格做到光明正大、有据可查。

abracadabra.en: To its critics, management jargon is mere abracadabra, words that create the impression of expertise while explaining nothing.
abracadabra.zh: 在批评者看来，管理行话不过是故弄玄虚的咒语，制造出专业的印象却解释不了任何问题。

abrade.en: Windborne sand can abrade solar panels over years, gradually cutting their output in desert installations.
abrade.zh: 风沙经年累月会磨损太阳能电池板，使沙漠电站的输出功率逐渐下降。

abrasion.en: Materials engineers judge a coating not by its gloss but by its resistance to abrasion under repeated cleaning.
abrasion.zh: 材料工程师评判涂层的标准不是光泽，而是它在反复清洁之下的抗磨损能力。

abrasive.en: Negotiators learned that an abrasive style wins short-term concessions while quietly destroying the trust that treaties require.
abrasive.zh: 谈判者逐渐明白，生硬粗暴的风格能赢得眼前的让步，却在暗中摧毁条约赖以维系的信任。

abreast.en: Professional code reviewers must keep abreast of security research, because yesterday's best practices become tomorrow's vulnerabilities.
abreast.zh: 专业的代码审查人员必须紧跟安全研究的进展，因为昨日的最佳实践可能成为明日的安全漏洞。

abridge.en: Constitutional lawyers debate whether wartime censorship may ever lawfully abridge speech, or whether the power is inherently unlimited.
abridge.zh: 宪法律师争论的是，战时审查是否可能合法地限制言论，还是这种权力本质上就不受限制。

abridgement.en: Every abridgement involves judgment about what matters, which is why scholars distrust condensed classics prepared by anonymous editors.
abridgement.zh: 每一种删节都包含对何为重要的判断，这正是学者不信任匿名编辑整理的缩编经典的原因。

abroad.en: Universities that send a fifth of their students abroad report higher graduate employment, though causation remains disputed.
abroad.zh: 把五分之一学生送往海外交流的大学报告称其毕业生就业率更高，尽管因果关系仍有争议。

abrogate.en: International lawyers ask whether a security council resolution can abrogate a treaty ratified by dozens of parliaments.
abrogate.zh: 国际法学者追问，安理会的一项决议能否废除一份经数十个议会批准的条约。

abrogation.en: The treaty's quiet abrogation went almost unreported, yet it reshaped trade in the region more than any tariff.
abrogation.zh: 该条约被悄然废除几乎无人报道，但它对该地区贸易的重塑超过任何一项关税。

abrupt.en: Economic historians note that the transition from coal was not abrupt; it unfolded across four decades of policy and protest.
abrupt.zh: 经济史学家指出，告别煤炭的转型并非一蹴而就，而是在政策与抗议的交织中经历了四十年。

abruptly.en: The trial ended abruptly when the chief witness withdrew her testimony, leaving both legal teams unprepared for the fallout.
abruptly.zh: 关键证人突然撤回证词，审判就此仓促终止，令两支律师团队都对后续局面措手不及。

abruptness.en: The abruptness of the central bank's reversal startled markets that had been assured rates would stay low for years.
abruptness.zh: 央行态度的陡然逆转令市场震惊，因为此前官方一再保证利率将多年维持低位。

abscess.en: Dentists stress that an untreated abscess can spread infection to the jaw and bloodstream within days, not months.
abscess.zh: 牙医强调，未经治疗的脓肿可能在数天而非数月内就把感染扩散到下颌和血液。

abscond.en: Auditors recommend that firms facing investigations restrict the finance director's access, since senior insiders most often abscond with the evidence.
abscond.zh: 审计人员建议，正受调查的公司应限制财务主管的权限，因为带着证据潜逃的往往是内部高层。

absence.en: Researchers call it the absence problem: you cannot measure the harms a regulation prevented, only the ones it failed to.
absence.zh: 研究者称之为缺失问题：一项监管究竟防止了哪些危害无法测量，能测量的只有它没能防止的部分。

absentee.en: Housing researchers blame absentee ownership for the decay of whole blocks, since distant landlords rarely fund basic maintenance.
absentee.zh: 住房研究者把整片街区的衰败归咎于业主不在本地的产权形态，因为身在远处的房东很少出资做基本维护。

absenteeism.en: Firms that allow flexible scheduling report sharply lower absenteeism, though managers initially predicted the opposite effect.
absenteeism.zh: 实行弹性排班的公司报告称缺勤率大幅下降，尽管管理者当初预测的效果恰恰相反。

absentia.en: The war-crimes tribunal tried the fugitive general in absentia, a procedure critics say trades legitimacy for speed.
absentia.zh: 战争罪法庭对在逃将军进行了缺席审判，批评者称这种程序是用正当性换取效率。

absinthe.en: The myth that absinthe causes hallucinations was manufactured by temperance campaigners, yet it shaped liquor laws for a century.
absinthe.zh: 苦艾酒致幻的神话本是由禁酒运动者编造出来的，却左右酒类立法长达一个世纪。

absolut.en: Marketing scholars still cite the Absolut vodka campaign as evidence that minimalist design can build near absolute brand recognition.
absolut.zh: 营销学者至今仍在引用绝对伏特加的广告战役，以此证明极简设计足以打造近乎绝对的品牌辨识度。

absolute.en: Behavioral economists caution that no survey question yields an absolute measure of happiness, only comparisons with recent experience.
absolute.zh: 行为经济学家提醒，任何调查问题都无法对幸福感给出绝对度量，得到的只是与近期经历的比较。

absolutely.en: Early investors were told the technology was absolutely safe, a promise the subsequent congressional inquiry dismantled line by line.
absolutely.zh: 早期投资者被告知这项技术绝对安全，而随后的国会调查把这一承诺逐条拆穿。

absoluteness.en: Philosophers question the absoluteness of moral rules by constructing dilemmas in which every available act harms someone.
absoluteness.zh: 哲学家通过构造无论怎么选都会伤害到人的两难困境，来质疑道德规则的绝对性。

absolution.en: Truth commissions offer something courts cannot: public absolution in exchange for full disclosure of what was done.
absolution.zh: 真相委员会提供法庭无法给予的东西：以彻底交代所作所为换取公开的宽恕。

absolutism.en: Historians once treated absolutism as a uniform system, but regional studies now emphasize how differently kings exercised it.
absolutism.zh: 史学家曾把专制主义当作整齐划一的制度来研究，但区域研究如今强调，各国君主行使权力的方式差别极大。

absolutist.en: The philosopher's absolutist claims about free speech collapse, critics argue, once real defamation cases are on the table.
absolutist.zh: 批评者认为，一旦直面真实的诽谤案件，这位哲学家关于言论自由的绝对化主张便难以成立。

absolve.en: Ethicists warn that blaming algorithms lets manufacturers absolve themselves of design choices that were entirely predictable.
absolve.zh: 伦理学家警告，把责任推给算法，只会让制造商为完全可以预见的糟糕设计开脱。

absorb.en: Developing economies must absorb millions of new workers each year, a challenge that manufacturing can no longer meet alone.
absorb.zh: 发展中经济体每年必须吸纳数以百万计的新增劳动力，单靠制造业已难以应对这一挑战。

absorbency.en: Textile engineers improved the absorbency of hospital gowns so that fluids could not reach the skin during procedures.
absorbency.zh: 纺织工程师提高了病号服的吸水性，使液体在医疗操作中无法渗到皮肤。

absorbent.en: Wetlands function as a naturally absorbent buffer, holding floodwater that concrete channels merely accelerate downstream.
absorbent.zh: 湿地起着天然吸水缓冲带的作用，能够蓄住洪水，而混凝土排水道只会让洪水更快地涌向下游。

absorption.en: Economists debate whether the rapid absorption of rural migrants into cities raises or suppresses wages for existing residents.
absorption.zh: 经济学家争论农村移民被城市快速吸纳究竟是推高还是压低了原有居民的工资。

abstain.en: Supreme court justices occasionally abstain in cases involving companies whose shares they hold, a practice governed by strict rules.
abstain.zh: 最高法院大法官偶尔会在涉及自己所持股份公司的案件中回避表决，这种回避受到严格规则约束。

abstention.en: A high rate of abstention among young voters usually reflects disillusion with the choices offered, not apathy.
abstention.zh: 年轻选民的高弃权率通常反映的是对既有选择的心灰意冷，而非漠不关心。

abstinence.en: Programs that teach abstinence alone have failed repeated evaluations, while comprehensive curricula show measurable reductions in teenage pregnancy.
abstinence.zh: 只教禁欲的项目在多次评估中均告失败，而内容全面的课程则显示出青少年怀孕率出现了可测量的下降。

abstinent.en: Recovery researchers note that patients who remain abstinent for five years relapse far less often than shorter-term survivors suggest.
abstinent.zh: 康复研究者注意到，保持戒断满五年的患者，其复发率远低于短期随访数据所提示的水平。

abstract.en: Children grasp concrete fairness rules years before they can reason in purely abstract ethical terms.
abstract.zh: 儿童在能够进行纯抽象的伦理推理之前好几年，就已经能理解具体的公平规则。

abstraction.en: Mathematics succeeds, one physicist argued, because each useful abstraction discards detail while preserving exactly the structure that matters.
abstraction.zh: 一位物理学家认为，数学之所以成功，是因为每一个有用的抽象都在舍弃细节的同时恰好保留了关键的结构。

abstruse.en: The referee reports praised the mathematics while noting that its most abstruse passages would defeat nearly all practicing engineers.
abstruse.zh: 审稿报告赞赏了其中的数学，同时指出最深奥的段落几乎会让所有执业工程师望而却步。

absurd.en: It is not absurd to worry about job automation, but predictions made with false precision deserve the skepticism they receive.
absurd.zh: 担心自动化取代工作并非荒谬，但那些伪装出虚假精确性的预测理应受到质疑。

absurdist.en: Early reviewers dismissed the play as absurdist provocation, missing the rigorous economics hidden in its jokes.
absurdist.zh: 早期剧评人把这出戏斥为荒诞派的挑衅之作，却没有看出笑话背后严谨的经济学。

absurdity.en: The commission finally acknowledged the absurdity of requiring farmers to file the same soil data with four separate agencies.
absurdity.zh: 委员会终于承认，要求农民向四个不同的机构重复提交同样的土壤数据十分荒谬。

absurdly.en: Rent in the capital rose absurdly fast during the boom, tripling in five years while wages barely moved.
absurdly.zh: 繁荣时期首都房租涨得离谱，五年间翻了三倍，而工资几乎原地不动。

abundance.en: The abundance of cheap solar panels has changed energy politics more quickly than most forecasters anticipated.
abundance.zh: 廉价太阳能电池板的充裕供应改变了能源政治格局，速度超出多数预测者的预料。

abundant.en: Labor remains abundant in the region, yet manufacturers complain that skilled technicians are scarcer than ever.
abundant.zh: 该地区劳动力依然充裕，但制造商抱怨熟练技师比以往任何时候都更稀缺。

abundantly.en: The report made abundantly clear that the budget shortfall resulted from policy choices, not from demographic pressure alone.
abundantly.zh: 报告已把话说得十分明白：预算缺口源于政策选择，而非仅仅出于人口压力。

abuse.en: Economists studying the abuse of market power find that dominant firms raise prices most aggressively where regulators are weakest.
abuse.zh: 研究滥用市场支配地位的经济学家发现，在监管最薄弱的地方，支配性企业提价最凶。

abusive.en: Platforms removed thousands of accounts for abusive messages, yet researchers found the hardest cases reappear within days under new names.
abusive.zh: 平台以发布辱骂信息为由移除了数千个账户，但研究者发现最难处理的案例几天后就会以新身份卷土重来。

abut.en: Urban planners favor designs in which shops abut residential streets, since passive surveillance reduces street crime measurably.
abut.zh: 城市规划者青睐商铺紧邻住宅街道的设计，因为这种无形的邻里注视能切实减少街头犯罪。

abutting.en: Residents of abutting properties were notified of the rezoning, while tenants three streets away learned of it from the press.
abutting.zh: 毗邻地块的业主接到了重新划区的通知，而三条街以外的租户却是从报纸上得知这件事的。

abuzz.en: Within a week of the preprint appearing online, laboratories across three continents were abuzz with attempts to replicate it.
abuzz.zh: 预印本在网上出现不到一周，三大洲的实验室便争相尝试复现，一时议论纷纷。

abysmal.en: The inspector's report called sanitation at the plant abysmal, documenting violations that dated back nearly a decade.
abysmal.zh: 督察报告称该工厂的卫生状况极差，并记录了可追溯到近十年前的违规行为。

abysmally.en: Public transport in the region performs abysmally on punctuality, yet fare increases are approved almost every year.
abysmally.zh: 该地区公共交通的准点表现差得惊人，票价却几乎年年获批上调。

abyss.en: The finance minister warned that uncontrolled deficit spending would lead the economy toward an abyss, not prosperity.
abyss.zh: 财政部长警告说，失控的赤字支出会把经济拖向深渊，而不是带向繁荣。

acacia.en: Researchers found that giraffes often avoid acacia trees downwind of those being browsed, apparently because attacked trees release airborne chemical signals that stiffen the defences of their neighbours.
acacia.zh: 研究者发现，长颈鹿常常避开处于正在被啃食的金合欢树下风向的树木，显然是因为遭啃食的树会释放挥发性化学信号，促使邻近的树加强防御。

academe.en: Debates that rage in academe often reach the public decades later, translated into textbooks and school curricula.
academe.zh: 在学术界激烈争论的问题往往几十年后才抵达公众，化身为教科书与学校课程。

academia.en: The proportion of research staff in academia on temporary contracts has doubled since 2000, according to national statistics.
academia.zh: 国家统计数据显示，学术界中持临时合同的研究人员比例自2000年以来翻了一番。

academic.en: The distinction is not merely academic: whether the reef is classified as endangered determines which international funds become available.
academic.zh: 这一区别绝非纸上空谈：珊瑚礁是否被列为濒危，决定了哪些国际资金可供使用。

academically.en: Follow-up studies show that children who repeat a year rarely improve academically, and often suffer socially.
academically.zh: 后续追踪研究显示，留级一年的儿童在学业上鲜有改善，在社交上反而常常受损。

acrid.en: The acrid smell of burning coal filled the valley, prompting residents to demand stricter regulations on the factory that had operated there for decades.
acrid.zh: 燃煤产生的刺鼻气味弥漫山谷，促使居民要求对那家已运营数十年的工厂实施更严格的监管。

acrimonious.en: The merger negotiations turned increasingly acrimonious when the two boards failed to agree on how to divide the company's mounting debts.
acrimonious.zh: 当两家董事会未能就如何分担公司不断累积的债务达成一致时，合并谈判变得愈发剑拔弩张。

acrimony.en: Despite years of acrimony between the rival research teams, their final joint paper was widely praised for its methodological rigor.
acrimony.zh: 尽管这两个相互竞争的研究团队之间积怨多年、针锋相对，他们最终的合作论文仍因其方法论严谨而广受好评。

acrobat.en: Once an acrobat in a travelling circus, she later earned a doctorate in psychology, proving that early careers rarely determine final achievements.
acrobat.zh: 她曾是巡回马戏团的一名杂技演员，后来取得了心理学博士学位，这证明早期的职业很少决定最终的成就。

acrobatic.en: The study found that children who practiced acrobatic movements developed stronger spatial reasoning skills than those engaged only in repetitive aerobic exercise.
acrobatic.zh: 研究发现，练习杂技动作的儿童比只做重复有氧运动的儿童发展出更强的空间推理能力。

acronym.en: The report explains that each acronym used in official documents must be defined at first mention, a rule many government agencies still neglect.
acronym.zh: 报告解释说，官方文件中使用的每个首字母缩略词在首次出现时都必须给出完整定义，而许多政府机构仍忽视这一规则。

acropolis.en: Archaeologists argue that restoring the acropolis with modern concrete damaged more ancient marble than pollution had destroyed in the previous century.
acropolis.zh: 考古学家认为，用现代混凝土修复卫城所损毁的古代大理石，比污染在过去一个世纪里毁掉的还要多。

acrylic.en: Museums now face a conservation dilemma because acrylic paints, once celebrated for their durability, are proving far less stable than early tests suggested.
acrylic.zh: 博物馆如今面临一个保护难题：丙烯颜料曾因耐久性而备受赞誉，如今却证明远不如早期测试所显示的那样稳定。

act.en: Under the new privacy act, companies must disclose data breaches within seventy-two hours or face fines calculated as a percentage of annual revenue.
act.zh: 根据这项新的隐私法案，公司必须在七十二小时内披露数据泄露事件，否则将面临按年收入百分比计算的罚款。

action.en: Environmental groups argue that voluntary corporate pledges are meaningless without legal action against firms that quietly exceed their approved emission limits.
action.zh: 环保组织认为，如果没有对悄悄超出核准排放限额的企业采取法律行动，企业的自愿承诺便毫无意义。

actionable.en: The committee rejected the proposal for lacking actionable steps, noting that ambitious goals without measurable milestones rarely survive budget reviews.
actionable.zh: 委员会以缺乏可执行的步骤为由否决了该提案，并指出没有可衡量节点的宏大目标很难在预算审查中幸存。

activate.en: Users must activate the security feature manually, a requirement that many researchers blame for the persistently low adoption of the free service.
activate.zh: 用户必须手动激活该安全功能，许多研究者将这项免费服务采用率持续偏低归咎于这一要求。

activation.en: The activation of the emergency plan was delayed for hours because officials could not agree on who held the authority to issue it.
activation.zh: 由于官员们无法就谁有权发布应急预案，该预案的启动被耽搁了数小时。

activator.en: Chemists discovered that a cheap iron compound works as effectively as imported catalysts, acting as an activator in industrial polymer production.
activator.zh: 化学家发现，一种廉价的铁化合物与进口催化剂效果相当，可在工业聚合物生产中充当激活剂。

active.en: Linguists emphasize that children remain remarkably active learners, acquiring grammar through interaction long before formal instruction begins at school.
active.zh: 语言学家强调，儿童始终是极为主动的学习者，早在学校正式授课之前就通过互动习得语法。

actively.en: Employers who actively sponsor apprenticeship schemes report lower staff turnover than rivals that rely exclusively on graduate recruitment fairs.
actively.zh: 积极资助学徒计划的企业报告的人员流动率，低于完全依靠校园招聘会的竞争对手。

activism.en: Scholars trace modern consumer activism to boycotts organized long before social media, when pamphlets and public meetings served as the main tools of mobilization.
activism.zh: 学者将现代消费者行动主义追溯到社交媒体出现之前的抵制运动，当时小册子和公众集会是主要的动员工具。

activist.en: The veteran campaigner began as a local activist protesting housing demolition, yet her petitions ultimately reshaped national urban renewal legislation.
activist.zh: 这位资深活动人士起初只是抗议拆迁的基层行动者，但她的请愿最终重塑了全国性的城市更新立法。

activity.en: Brain imaging reveals that creative problem solving involves coordinated activity across regions previously assumed to operate independently of one another.
activity.zh: 脑成像显示，创造性问题解决涉及多个脑区的协同活动，而这些脑区此前被认为彼此独立运作。

actor.en: Sociologists describe international climate negotiations as a stage where each actor, whether a state or a corporation, pursues partially incompatible interests.
actor.zh: 社会学家把国际气候谈判描述为一个舞台，其中每个角色——无论是国家还是企业——都在追逐部分互不相容的利益。

actress.en: The celebrated actress funded a scholarship for drama students from rural regions, arguing that talent is distributed more widely than opportunity.
actress.zh: 这位著名女演员资助了一项面向农村戏剧学生的奖学金，她认为天赋的分布远比机会广泛。

actual.en: The survey asked about intended voting behavior, yet economists caution that stated preferences often diverge sharply from actual choices at the ballot box.
actual.zh: 这项调查询问的是投票意向，但经济学家提醒，人们声称的偏好往往与投票时的真实选择大相径庭。

actuality.en: Philosophers long debated whether photography records mere appearance or a deeper actuality, a question that now confronts creators of virtual worlds.
actuality.zh: 哲学家长期争论摄影记录的究竟是表象还是更深层的现实，如今虚拟世界的创造者也面临着同样的问题。

actualize.en: Startup culture urges graduates to actualize their ideas within months, although history shows that most transformative companies needed years of quiet refinement.
actualize.zh: 创业文化敦促毕业生在几个月内将想法付诸实现，但历史表明，大多数变革性公司都经历了多年的默默打磨。

actually.en: Although the policy was officially designed to cut costs, it actually shifted spending from visible services to less scrutinized administrative contracts.
actually.zh: 尽管该政策名义上旨在削减成本，实际上却把支出从看得见的服务转向了受监督较少的行政合同。

actuarial.en: Insurers that ignore climate risk in their actuarial models may drastically underestimate liabilities, according to a study commissioned by the reinsurance industry.
actuarial.zh: 再保险行业委托的一项研究表明，在精算模型中忽视气候风险的保险公司可能严重低估其负债。

actuary.en: An experienced actuary testified that the company had priced its annuities using outdated mortality tables drawn from a healthier, shorter-lived population.
actuary.zh: 一位资深精算师作证说，该公司使用过时的死亡率表为年金定价，而那些数据取自更健康、更短命的人群。

actuate.en: What actuated the reform, the minister admitted, was not ideological conviction but the alarming quarterly figures published by the treasury.
actuate.zh: 部长承认，促成这项改革的并非意识形态信念，而是财政部发布的令人担忧的季度数据。

actuator.en: Engineers replaced the faulty actuator in the robotic arm, cutting production errors by forty percent within the first month of operation.
actuator.zh: 工程师更换了机械臂上出现故障的执行器，在投入运行的第一个月内将生产差错减少了百分之四十。

acuity.en: Longitudinal studies suggest that bilingual adults retain higher mental acuity in old age, though the size of the effect remains contested.
acuity.zh: 纵向研究表明，双语成年人在老年时保持更高的心智敏锐度，尽管这种效应的大小仍有争议。

acumen.en: Her business acumen was evident early: she anticipated the shift to streaming and sold the family cinema chain near its peak value.
acumen.zh: 她的商业敏锐很早便显露出来：她预见到流媒体转型的到来，并在家族影院连锁接近价值峰值时将其出售。

acupuncture.en: Clinical trials indicate that acupuncture relieves chronic lower back pain better than sham treatment, yet the underlying mechanism is still poorly understood.
acupuncture.zh: 临床试验表明，针灸缓解慢性腰痛的效果优于假针灸，但其作用机制仍知之甚少。

acute.en: The report highlights an acute shortage of geriatric nurses, warning that the gap will widen as the postwar generation reaches its eighties.
acute.zh: 报告着重指出老年科护士严重短缺，并警告随着战后一代步入八十高龄，这一缺口还将扩大。

acutely.en: Small firms feel economic downturns acutely because they lack the cash reserves that allow large corporations to survive temporary collapses in demand.
acutely.zh: 小企业对经济衰退的感受格外深切，因为它们缺乏让大公司挺过需求暂时崩溃的现金储备。

acuteness.en: The acuteness of the housing crisis varies dramatically across the country, with inner cities experiencing pressures that rural districts can scarcely imagine.
acuteness.zh: 住房危机的严重程度在全国各地差异巨大，内城区承受的压力是农村地区难以想象的。

adage.en: The old adage that history repeats itself first as tragedy and then as farce has become a tired phrase in modern political commentary.
adage.zh: 历史先以悲剧出现、再以闹剧重演这一古老格言，如今已成为政治评论中的一句老生常谈。

adamant.en: Union leaders remained adamant that any wage agreement must include automatic adjustments for inflation, even at the risk of a prolonged strike.
adamant.zh: 工会领导人坚决主张，任何工资协议都必须包含随通胀自动调整的条款，哪怕冒着长期罢工的风险。

adamantly.en: The ministry adamantly denied the allegations, yet internal emails released later suggested that senior officials had known of the problem for years.
adamantly.zh: 该部坚决否认这些指控，但后来公布的内部电子邮件表明，高级官员多年前就已知情。

adapt.en: Cities that fail to adapt their drainage systems to heavier rainfall will pay far more in flood damage than the upgrades would cost.
adapt.zh: 未能使排水系统适应更强降雨的城市，最终在洪灾损失上的付出将远远超过升级改造的成本。

adaptability.en: Biologists consider the species' remarkable adaptability a warning rather than a comfort, since it thrives equally well in polluted and pristine waters.
adaptability.zh: 生物学家认为，该物种非凡的适应性与其说是令人安心，不如说是一种警示，因为它在污染水域和洁净水域都能茁壮生长。

adaptable.en: Employers consistently rank adaptable graduates above narrow specialists, arguing that technical skills depreciate quickly in industries transformed by automation.
adaptable.zh: 雇主们普遍认为适应能力强的毕业生胜过狭隘的专才，因为在自动化改变行业的背景下，技术技能会迅速贬值。

adaptation.en: The film adaptation compressed three hundred pages into two hours, and critics argued that the cuts had stripped the novel of its ambiguity.
adaptation.zh: 这部改编电影把三百页的内容压缩进两个小时，评论家认为删减使小说失去了原有的含混多义。

adaptive.en: Schools that purchased adaptive learning software report modest gains, though evidence on its long-term effectiveness remains mixed.
adaptive.zh: 购买了自适应学习软件的学校报告取得了一定成效，但有关其长期效果的证据仍不一致。

adaptor.en: The novel's television adaptor preserved the ending that earlier film versions had altered, earning praise from the author's estate.
adaptor.zh: 这部小说的电视剧改编者保留了早期电影版本曾改动过的结局，赢得了作者遗产管理方的赞誉。

add.en: Small recurring fees that seem harmless can add substantially to annual expenses, which is why regulators require clearer billing summaries.
add.zh: 看似无害的小额经常性费用会大幅累积到年度开支中，这正是监管机构要求账单摘要更加清晰的原因。

addendum.en: The publisher issued the textbook with a brief addendum correcting the outdated statistics that had embarrassed instructors during the previous semester.
addendum.zh: 出版社随教科书附上一份简短附录，更正了上一学期令教师们难堪的过时统计数据。

addict.en: Research on the recovering addict challenges the stereotype of moral failure, emphasizing instead how addiction rewires the brain's reward circuitry.
addict.zh: 对康复中成瘾者的研究挑战了道德失败这一刻板印象，转而强调成瘾如何重塑大脑的奖赏回路。

addiction.en: Treating addiction as a chronic illness rather than a crime has reduced reoffending rates in the countries that adopted the approach.
addiction.zh: 将成瘾视为慢性疾病而非罪行，使采纳这一做法的国家的再犯率有所下降。

addictive.en: Regulators are examining whether loot boxes in video games constitute an addictive gambling mechanism aimed deliberately at minors.
addictive.zh: 监管机构正在研究电子游戏中的开箱机制是否构成一种蓄意针对未成年人的成瘾性赌博手段。

addition.en: In addition to raising the minimum wage, the city introduced subsidies for small businesses, hoping to soften the transition.
addition.zh: 除了提高最低工资之外，该市还推出了小企业补贴，希望缓和转型带来的冲击。

additional.en: The airline charged passengers additional fees for seat selection, a practice that consumer agencies now describe as deceptive pricing.
additional.zh: 这家航空公司向乘客收取额外的选座费，消费者机构如今将这种做法称为欺骗性定价。

additionally.en: The vaccine proved safe in trials; additionally, its low storage requirements made it practical for regions without reliable refrigeration.
additionally.zh: 这种疫苗在试验中被证明安全；此外，其较低的储存要求使其在没有可靠冷链的地区也切实可行。

additive.en: The study found no evidence that the banned colour additive causes hyperactivity, but the researchers concede the sample was too small to be conclusive.
additive.zh: 该研究没有发现被禁色素添加剂导致多动症的证据，但研究者承认样本过小，尚不足以得出决定性结论。

address.en: The seminar examined how governments address rising inequality, comparing taxation, education spending, and direct transfers across a dozen economies.
address.zh: 研讨会探讨了各国政府如何应对日益加剧的不平等，比较了十多个经济体的税收、教育支出与直接转移支付。

addressable.en: The chip provides a larger addressable memory space than its predecessor, allowing operating systems to run far more concurrent applications.
addressable.zh: 这款芯片提供了比前代更大的可寻址内存空间，使操作系统能够运行多得多的并发应用。

addressee.en: Because the addressee had moved, the legal notice was returned unopened, which delayed the court proceedings by nearly two months.
addressee.zh: 由于收件人已迁居，法律文书被原封退回，导致诉讼程序延误了近两个月。

adds.en: The study adds weight to the argument that class sizes matter less than teacher quality in determining pupils' later earnings.
adds.zh: 这项研究进一步支持了这样一种观点：在决定学生日后收入方面，班级规模的影响不如教师素质。

adept.en: Long-distance traders were remarkably adept at reading political signals, adjusting their routes months before official travel warnings appeared.
adept.zh: 长途商人极为善于解读政治信号，往往在官方旅行警告发布前数月就调整了行进路线。

adequacy.en: The court will assess the adequacy of the government's consultation process, not merely whether a meeting technically took place.
adequacy.zh: 法院将评估政府咨询程序的充分性，而不仅仅是看会议是否在形式上召开过。

adequate.en: Public health officials insisted that hospital capacity remained adequate, although leaked memoranda described intensive care units operating at twice their rated limit.
adequate.zh: 公共卫生官员坚称医院容量仍然充足，尽管泄露的内部备忘录称重症监护室的运行负荷已达核定上限的两倍。

adequately.en: Unless teachers are adequately trained in the new curriculum, reformers warn, digital classrooms will simply reproduce old lectures on expensive screens.
adequately.zh: 改革者警告，如果教师未能在新课程方面得到充分培训，数字课堂只会把旧式讲课搬到昂贵的屏幕上。

adhere.en: Insects rely on microscopic hairs that help them adhere to vertical glass, an ability that inspires new reversible adhesives.
adhere.zh: 昆虫依靠微小绒毛使自己能附着在垂直的玻璃上，这种能力启发了新型可逆黏合剂的研发。

adherence.en: Strict adherence to clinical guidelines reduced unnecessary antibiotic prescriptions by a third across the participating hospitals.
adherence.zh: 严格遵守临床指南使参与医院的非必要抗生素处方减少了三分之一。

adherent.en: The philosopher attracted one devoted adherent for every ten fierce critics, a ratio he considered proof that his ideas unsettled orthodoxy.
adherent.zh: 这位哲学家每招致十名激烈的批评者，便拥有一名忠实的追随者，他认为这一比例恰恰证明其思想撼动了正统。

adhesion.en: The bridge collapse was traced to inadequate adhesion between concrete and steel, prompting nationwide inspections of similar structures.
adhesion.zh: 大桥坍塌被追查到混凝土与钢筋之间附着力不足，由此引发了对类似结构的全国性检查。

adhesive.en: A biodegradable adhesive developed for medical implants dissolves safely once the wound has healed, eliminating the need for follow-up surgery.
adhesive.zh: 为医疗植入物开发的一种可生物降解黏合剂在伤口愈合后能安全溶解，免去了二次手术。

adipose.en: Researchers distinguished brown adipose tissue, which burns calories, from white fat that merely stores energy, reopening interest in metabolic therapies.
adipose.zh: 研究人员区分了燃烧热量的棕色脂肪组织与仅仅储存能量的白色脂肪，重新激发了人们对代谢疗法的兴趣。

adjacent.en: Property values in the district adjacent to the new technology park rose faster than regional averages, displacing many longtime renters.
adjacent.zh: 毗邻新科技园区的街区房价涨幅超过区域平均水平，许多老租户因此被迫迁离。

adjective.en: Corpus linguistics shows that writers overuse evaluative adjectives in early drafts, and that deleting them often strengthens the underlying argument.
adjective.zh: 语料库语言学研究表明，写作者在初稿中往往滥用评价性形容词，而删去这些词常能使论证更加有力。

adjoin.en: The two laboratories adjoin a shared clean room, an arrangement that accelerated collaboration on semiconductor fabrication.
adjoin.zh: 这两间实验室共用一间毗邻的洁净室，这种布局加快了半导体制造方面的合作。

adjourn.en: The judge threatened to adjourn the trial indefinitely unless prosecutors disclosed the forensic reports they had withheld for two years.
adjourn.zh: 法官威胁说，除非检察官交出他们扣压了两年的法医报告，否则将无限期休庭。

adjournment.en: After six hours of heated testimony, the chair requested a brief adjournment so that members could review the amended text.
adjournment.zh: 经过六个小时激烈的作证之后，主席要求短暂休会，以便成员们审阅修订后的文本。

adjudge.en: Legal scholars questioned whether the tribunal had the authority to adjudge a sitting head of state responsible for economic sabotage.
adjudge.zh: 法学界质疑该法庭是否有权裁定一位在任国家元首对经济破坏行为负责。

adjudicate.en: Independent commissions were created to adjudicate disputes between landowners and mining companies, replacing a system that critics called opaque.
adjudicate.zh: 政府设立了独立委员会来裁决土地所有者与矿业公司之间的纠纷，取代了被批评者称为暗箱操作的旧体制。

adjudication.en: Speedy adjudication of small claims encourages entrepreneurs to enforce contracts, whereas years of delay push them toward informal markets.
adjudication.zh: 小额索赔的快速裁决能鼓励创业者依约维权，而经年累月的拖延则会把他们推向非正规市场。

adjunct.en: Universities increasingly depend on adjunct instructors, who teach half of all introductory courses yet rarely receive benefits or permanent contracts.
adjunct.zh: 大学日益依赖兼职讲师，他们承担了一半的入门课程，却很少享有福利或长期合同。

adjust.en: Insurers adjust premiums annually to reflect claims history, which quietly penalizes neighbourhoods where accidents cluster for reasons residents cannot control.
adjust.zh: 保险公司每年根据理赔记录调整保费，这悄然惩罚了那些因居民无法控制的原因而事故频发的社区。

adjustable.en: Ergonomists recommend adjustable desks because a fixed height that suits the average worker still strains shorter and taller colleagues.
adjustable.zh: 人体工学专家推荐可调节的书桌，因为适合中等身高的固定高度仍会伤害较矮和较高的员工。

adjustment.en: Economists debated whether the currency's sharp adjustment reflected genuine fundamentals or a wave of speculation amplified by social media panic.
adjustment.zh: 经济学家争论，货币的急剧调整究竟反映了真实的基本面，还是被社交媒体恐慌放大的投机浪潮。

adjutant.en: The general's adjutant kept the field notebooks that historians later relied on, since the commander himself rarely wrote anything down.
adjutant.zh: 将军的副官保存了战地笔记本，历史学家后来主要依靠这些笔记，因为指挥官本人几乎从不亲笔记录。

administer.en: Nurses administer the vaccine in schools and pharmacies, a decentralised strategy that doubled coverage within a single season.
administer.zh: 护士在学校和药房接种疫苗，这种分散实施的策略使接种覆盖率在一个季度内翻了一番。

administrate.en: The agency was created to administrate rural broadband grants after earlier programmes proved vulnerable to political interference.
administrate.zh: 由于此前的计划容易被政治干预，政府专门设立了机构来管理农村宽带补贴。

administration.en: The new administration promised to simplify tax filing, but eighteen months later only the cover page of the form had changed.
administration.zh: 新一届政府承诺简化报税流程，但十八个月过去，税表上只有封面页发生了变化。

administrative.en: Courts generally defer to administrative agencies on technical matters, yet this deference shrinks when decisions affect fundamental rights.
administrative.zh: 法院通常在技术性问题上尊重行政机构的判断，但当裁决涉及基本权利时，这种尊重就会减弱。

administrator.en: The hospital administrator defended the rationing protocol, arguing that explicit criteria were fairer than informal queues decided by seniority.
administrator.zh: 医院管理者为配给方案辩护，称明确的规则比按资历排列的非正式队伍更公平。

admirable.en: The charity's logistics are admirable, yet donors increasingly ask whether efficient delivery of aid addresses the causes of the emergency.
admirable.zh: 这家慈善机构的物流组织令人钦佩，但捐赠者越来越追问，高效的援助运送是否触及了危机的根源。

admirably.en: The small department performed admirably during the crisis, though its success relied on staff working unpaid overtime for months.
admirably.zh: 这个小部门在危机中的表现可圈可点，但其成功依赖于员工数月的无偿加班。

admiral.en: The retired admiral cautioned that naval presence alone cannot secure shipping lanes without agreed rules for boarding suspect vessels.
admiral.zh: 这位退役海军上将警告，如果没有登临检查可疑船只的既定规则，仅凭海军存在无法保障航道安全。

admiralty.en: The dispute was heard in the admiralty court, where centuries-old maritime customs still guide judgments on salvage and collision.
admiralty.zh: 这起纠纷由海事法庭审理，数百年的海运惯例仍在引导着有关海难救助和船舶碰撞的判决。

admiration.en: Biographers describe Darwin's genuine admiration for rival researchers, whose objections he treated as gifts that strengthened his arguments.
admiration.zh: 传记作者笔下的达尔文真诚钦佩持异议的研究者，他把对方的反对意见当作完善自己论证的馈赠。

admire.en: Economists admire the Nordic model's flexibility, but they caution that its success depends on unusually high levels of social trust.
admire.zh: 经济学家赞赏北欧模式的灵活性，但也提醒说，其成功有赖于异常高水平的社会信任。

admirer.en: A lifelong admirer of the architect donated her correspondence to the archive, including sketches never shown in public exhibitions.
admirer.zh: 这位建筑师的终身仰慕者把她的书信捐赠给档案馆，其中包括从未公开展出的草图。

admiringly.en: Competitors speak admiringly of the firm's engineering culture, even while petitioning regulators to restrict its market power.
admiringly.zh: 竞争对手对该公司的工程文化赞赏有加，与此同时却又请求监管机构限制其市场支配力。

admissibility.en: The defense challenged the admissibility of the forensic evidence, arguing that the laboratory had failed its annual proficiency audit.
admissibility.zh: 辩方质疑法医证据的可采性，理由是该实验室未能通过年度能力审核。

admissible.en: Only data collected with informed consent is admissible in the tribunal, a rule that has excluded much of the prosecution's archive.
admissible.zh: 只有在知情同意下收集的数据才能被法庭采纳，这一规则已将检方档案中的大量材料排除在外。

admission.en: Universities defend holistic admission on equity grounds, yet researchers find legacy preferences outweigh every diversity factor combined.
admission.zh: 大学以公平为由为综合评价录取制度辩护，但研究者发现，校友关系优先的影响力超过了所有多元化因素的总和。

admit.en: Officials eventually had to admit that the river had been polluted for years, contradicting a decade of confident public assurances.
admit.zh: 官员们最终不得不承认这条河流已被污染多年，这与十年来自信满满的公开保证截然相反。

admittance.en: The archive grants admittance only to researchers with institutional sponsorship, a policy that independent scholars call quietly exclusionary.
admittance.zh: 该档案馆只向有机构担保的研究者开放，独立学者称这一政策是在不动声色地把局外人挡在门外。

admitted.en: Students admitted through the specialized track outperformed their peers in mathematics, but showed no lasting advantage in language courses.
admitted.zh: 通过特殊通道录取的学生数学成绩优于同龄人，但在语言课程上并无持久优势。

admittedly.en: The reform admittedly raised administrative costs, yet audit data show that fraud losses fell by nearly two thirds.
admittedly.zh: 诚然，改革增加了行政成本，但审计数据显示欺诈损失减少了近三分之二。

admitting.en: After years of admitting only anecdotal evidence, the ministry commissioned a nationwide study of classroom technology.
admitting.zh: 在多年只承认零散证据之后，该部委委托开展了一项针对课堂技术的全国性研究。

admonish.en: The central bank governor chose to admonish lenders in public for reckless mortgage practices, hinting that formal regulation would follow if voluntary restraint failed.
admonish.zh: 央行行长公开告诫放贷机构不要进行鲁莽的抵押贷款操作，并暗示若行业自律失效，正式监管将会出台。

admonishment.en: His public admonishment of junior researchers backfired, prompting an open letter defending the right to publish controversial results.
admonishment.zh: 他对年轻研究者的公开训诫适得其反，引发了一封为发表争议性成果的权利辩护的公开信。

admonition.en: Despite the founder's repeated admonition to stay out of politics, the board publicly endorsed a candidate within months of his retirement.
admonition.zh: 尽管创始人一再告诫董事会远离政治，但在他退休后仅数月，董事会便公开为一名候选人背书。

admonitory.en: The report closes with an admonitory comparison to earlier societies that ignored ecological warnings until collapse became unavoidable.
admonitory.zh: 报告结尾作了一个警世性的比较，提到一些早期社会无视生态警示，直至崩溃变得无可避免。

adolescence.en: Psychologists increasingly view adolescence as a second critical period for brain plasticity, rivaling early childhood in its capacity for change.
adolescence.zh: 心理学家日益把青春期视为大脑可塑性的第二个关键期，其可变程度堪比幼儿期。

adolescent.en: Sleep researchers report that the average adolescent needs over nine hours of rest, roughly two more than most school schedules allow.
adolescent.zh: 睡眠研究报告称，青少年平均需要九小时以上的睡眠，比大多数学校的作息安排多出约两小时。

adopt.en: Developing nations argue that they cannot adopt costly green technologies unless wealthier countries transfer patents and finance the transition.
adopt.zh: 发展中国家指出，除非较富裕国家转让专利并为转型提供资金，否则它们无法采用昂贵的绿色技术。

adoptable.en: Shelter statistics show that most adoptable dogs wait less than three weeks, while black-coated animals linger far longer.
adoptable.zh: 收容所的统计显示，大多数可供领养的狗等待时间不到三周，而黑毛动物的等待时间则长得多。

adoptee.en: The adoptee's search for her biological family challenged national laws that had sealed birth records for a century.
adoptee.zh: 这位被收养者对亲生家庭的寻找，挑战了将出生记录封存百年的国家法律。

adoption.en: The rapid adoption of mobile banking in East Africa leapfrogged traditional branches, forcing regulators to rewrite licensing rules.
adoption.zh: 移动银行在东非的迅速普及跳过了传统网点的阶段，迫使监管机构重写许可规则。

adoptive.en: Longitudinal data on adoptive families helped separate the effects of parenting from inherited traits in reading development.
adoptive.zh: 对收养家庭的纵向数据有助于在阅读能力发展中区分养育作用与遗传特质。

adorable.en: Marketing teams exploit adorable mascots precisely because likeable images lower consumers' critical guard, research on persuasion confirms.
adorable.zh: 有关说服的研究证实，营销团队之所以利用可爱的吉祥物，正是因为讨喜的形象能降低消费者的警惕。

adoration.en: Celebrity adoration has economic consequences: brands pay millions for a single endorsement from a figure with devoted followers.
adoration.zh: 对名人的崇拜会带来经济后果：品牌愿意为一个拥有忠实粉丝的人物的一次代言支付数百万。

adore.en: Consumers adore novelty in packaging but abandon unfamiliar flavours, a contradiction that plagues food companies planning product lines.
adore.zh: 消费者喜欢包装上的新意，却放弃不熟悉的味道，这一矛盾困扰着规划产品线的食品公司。

adorn.en: Over two decades, an ethnographer showed that the patterns which adorn everyday baskets carry symbolic meanings outsiders routinely overlook.
adorn.zh: 一位民族志学者历时二十多年证明，装点日常提篮的纹样承载着外人经常忽视的象征意义。

adornment.en: Anthropologists argue that personal adornment is never merely aesthetic; jewelry often encodes rank, alliance, and religious allegiance.
adornment.zh: 人类学家认为，个人装饰绝不仅出于审美，首饰往往编码着等级、联盟与宗教归属。

adrenal.en: Chronic stress keeps adrenal hormones elevated, and researchers link this sustained elevation to impaired memory consolidation in older adults.
adrenal.zh: 慢性压力使肾上腺激素持续处于高位，研究人员将这种持续升高与老年人记忆巩固受损联系起来。

clock.en: Because global markets operate around the clock, financial analysts must monitor price movements in Asia, Europe, and America simultaneously.
clock.zh: 由于全球市场全天候运转，金融分析师必须同时监测亚洲、欧洲和美国的价格波动。

clothing.en: Fast fashion retailers profit from rapidly changing styles, yet critics argue that cheap clothing imposes serious environmental costs on developing countries.
clothing.zh: 快时尚零售商从快速变化的款式中获利，但批评者认为廉价服装给发展中国家带来了沉重的环境代价。

cloud.en: Businesses increasingly store sensitive data on the cloud, raising urgent questions about who is legally responsible when private information leaks.
cloud.zh: 企业越来越多地把敏感数据存储在云端，当私人信息泄露时谁应承担法律责任便成为紧迫问题。

club.en: Membership in a professional club or association often provides young graduates with valuable contacts that formal education alone cannot offer.
club.zh: 加入专业俱乐部或协会往往能为年轻毕业生提供仅靠正规教育无法获得的有价值的人脉。

clue.en: Archaeologists hoped the newly discovered inscriptions would provide a crucial clue to how this ancient civilization organized its trade networks.
clue.zh: 考古学家希望新发现的铭文能为这一古代文明如何组织贸易网络提供关键线索。

cluster.en: Silicon Valley demonstrates how a geographical cluster of innovative firms can generate more growth than scattered companies acting independently.
cluster.zh: 硅谷表明，创新型企业的地理集群能比分散独立经营的公司创造更多增长。

coach.en: Leadership researchers note that a good coach develops individual talent through detailed feedback rather than simply demanding immediate results.
coach.zh: 领导力研究者指出，优秀的教练通过细致的反馈培养个人才能，而不是单纯要求立竿见影的成绩。

coal.en: Although coal remains a cheap source of energy, its environmental costs are increasingly factored into national energy policies.
coal.zh: 尽管煤炭仍是廉价的能源，但其环境成本正日益被纳入各国能源政策的考量。

coalition.en: Environmental groups formed a broad coalition to pressure the government into strengthening regulations on industrial emissions.
coalition.zh: 环保组织结成广泛的联盟，敦促政府加强对工业排放的监管。

coast.en: Rapid urbanization along the coast has destroyed wetlands that once protected inland communities from flooding and storm damage.
coast.zh: 沿海地区的快速城市化破坏了曾经保护内陆社区免受洪水和风暴侵害的湿地。

coat.en: Engineers coat the metal surface with a thin polymer layer to prevent corrosion in humid marine environments.
coat.zh: 工程师在金属表面涂上一层薄薄的聚合物，以防其在潮湿的海洋环境中腐蚀。

code.en: Computer scientists warn that a single flaw in the code of a self-driving system can produce catastrophic and irreversible consequences.
code.zh: 计算机科学家警告说，自动驾驶系统代码中的单一缺陷就可能造成灾难性且不可逆转的后果。

cognitive.en: Psychologists have found that regular physical exercise improves cognitive performance in children, particularly in tasks requiring sustained attention.
cognitive.zh: 心理学家发现，规律的体育锻炼能改善儿童的认知表现，尤其是在需要持续注意力的任务中。

coherent.en: To persuade skeptical readers, an argument must be both logically coherent and supported by evidence drawn from reliable sources.
coherent.zh: 要说服持怀疑态度的读者，论证必须逻辑连贯，并有来自可靠来源的证据支持。

cohesion.en: Sociologists argue that economic inequality gradually erodes social cohesion, making collective action on public problems far more difficult.
cohesion.zh: 社会学家认为，经济不平等会逐渐侵蚀社会凝聚力，使针对公共问题的集体行动变得更加困难。

coincide.en: The timing of the economic recovery happened to coincide with the launch of new training programs, muddying the causal evidence.
coincide.zh: 经济复苏的时间恰好与新培训计划的启动重合，使因果证据变得模糊。

cold.en: Even in cold northern regions, district heating systems can significantly reduce household energy consumption and urban air pollution.
cold.zh: 即使在寒冷的北方地区，区域供热系统也能显著降低家庭能源消耗和城市空气污染。

collaborate.en: Modern drug discovery increasingly depends on teams in which chemists, biologists, and statisticians collaborate across national and institutional boundaries.
collaborate.zh: 现代药物研发日益依赖于化学家、生物学家和统计学家跨越国界与机构界限开展合作的团队。

collapse.en: Historians still debate whether the collapse of the Maya civilization was caused primarily by prolonged drought or by internal warfare.
collapse.zh: 历史学家仍在争论玛雅文明的崩溃主要是由长期干旱还是由内部战争造成的。

colleague.en: In peer review, a colleague who shares the author's assumptions may overlook methodological flaws that an outsider would immediately question.
colleague.zh: 在同行评审中，与作者抱有相同假设的同事可能会忽视局外人会立即质疑的方法缺陷。

collect.en: Anthropologists collect data through long periods of fieldwork, a method that differs sharply from the laboratory experiments favored by psychologists.
collect.zh: 人类学家通过长期的田野调查收集数据，这一方法与心理学家偏好的实验室实验截然不同。

collection.en: The museum's digital collection allows researchers worldwide to examine rare manuscripts without traveling to the institution itself.
collection.zh: 该博物馆的数字馆藏使世界各地的研究人员无需亲临该机构就能查阅珍稀手稿。

collective.en: Public health campaigns succeed only when individual behavior changes accumulate into measurable collective benefits for the entire community.
collective.zh: 公共卫生运动只有在个人行为改变累积为整个社区可衡量的集体收益时才会成功。

colonial.en: Many developing countries inherited legal systems from their colonial rulers, and reforming these institutions remains politically difficult today.
colonial.zh: 许多发展中国家的法律体系承袭自殖民统治者，如今改革这些制度在政治上依然困难。

color.en: Marketing research shows that the color of packaging influences consumer perception of quality even before the product is evaluated.
color.zh: 营销研究表明，包装颜色会在消费者评价产品之前就影响其对质量的感知。

column.en: Her weekly column in the financial newspaper translates complex monetary policy debates into language ordinary readers can understand.
column.zh: 她在财经报纸上的每周专栏把复杂的货币政策辩论转化为普通读者能理解的语言。

combat.en: Governments have introduced generous subsidies to combat urban air pollution, yet enforcement remains weak in many rapidly growing cities.
combat.zh: 各国政府推出了慷慨的补贴来治理城市空气污染，但在许多快速发展的城市，执行仍然乏力。

combination.en: Success in modern biotechnology typically requires a combination of scientific insight, patient capital, and carefully designed regulation.
combination.zh: 现代生物技术的成功通常需要科学洞察力、耐心资本和审慎设计的监管三者相结合。

combine.en: Researchers combine survey data with satellite imagery to estimate how urban expansion affects surrounding agricultural productivity.
combine.zh: 研究人员将调查数据与卫星图像相结合，以估算城市扩张对周边农业生产力的影响。

comedy.en: Scholars of literature argue that comedy often reveals social anxieties more honestly than serious drama does.
comedy.zh: 文学学者认为，喜剧往往比严肃戏剧更真实地揭示社会的焦虑。

comfort.en: Economists caution that rising material comfort does not automatically translate into greater happiness once basic needs are met.
comfort.zh: 经济学家提醒，一旦基本需求得到满足，物质舒适程度的提高并不会自动转化为更大的幸福。

comfortable.en: Employees are more comfortable reporting mistakes in workplaces where admitting error is treated as learning rather than failure.
comfortable.zh: 在承认错误被视为学习而非失败的工作场所，员工会更安心地报告错误。

command.en: Fluency programs show that learners need a command of several thousand words before they can read authentic academic texts comfortably.
command.zh: 流利度项目表明，学习者只有掌握数千个单词，才能轻松阅读真实的学术文本。

comment.en: Officials refused to comment on the leaked report, but its central findings quickly circulated among policy analysts online.
comment.zh: 官员们拒绝对泄露的报告置评，但其核心结论很快在网上的政策分析人士中传开。

commercial.en: Critics claim that commercial pressures increasingly determine which research topics universities pursue, distorting the academic agenda.
commercial.zh: 批评者称，商业压力日益左右大学选择哪些研究课题，从而扭曲了学术议程。

commission.en: The government appointed an independent commission to investigate whether the banks had systematically misled small investors.
commission.zh: 政府成立了一个独立委员会，调查银行是否系统性地误导了小投资者。

commit.en: Firms that commit to long-term staff training often recover the investment through lower turnover and higher productivity.
commit.zh: 致力于长期员工培训的企业往往能通过降低人员流动率和提高生产率收回投资。

committee.en: The ethics committee rejected the experiment because the potential benefits did not justify the risks to participants.
committee.zh: 伦理委员会否决了这项实验，因为其潜在收益无法证明让参与者承担风险是正当的。

commodity.en: When a raw material becomes a global commodity, its price is set less by local producers than by distant financial markets.
commodity.zh: 当一种原材料成为全球性商品时，其价格更多由遥远的金融市场而非当地生产者决定。

common.en: Economists once assumed that rational self-interest was common to all buyers, but behavioral research has complicated this picture.
common.zh: 经济学家曾假定理性自利为所有买者所共有，但行为研究使这一图景变得复杂。

communicate.en: Scientists must communicate uncertainty honestly, because exaggerated claims ultimately damage public trust in research institutions.
communicate.zh: 科学家必须诚实地传达不确定性，因为夸大的说法最终会损害公众对研究机构的信任。

communication.en: Improvements in communication technology have allowed multinational firms to coordinate production across continents almost in real time.
communication.zh: 通信技术的进步使跨国公司能够近乎实时地协调各大洲的生产。

community.en: Urban planners emphasize that a healthy community offers affordable housing, reliable transport, and shared public spaces.
community.zh: 城市规划者强调，健康的社区应提供负担得起的住房、可靠的交通和共享的公共空间。

company.en: A company that treats data protection as an afterthought risks losing customers faster than any advertising campaign can win them back.
company.zh: 一家把数据保护当作事后考虑的公司，失去顾客的速度会超过任何广告活动赢回顾客的速度。

comparable.en: Wages in the two regions are barely comparable once differences in living costs are taken into account.
comparable.zh: 一旦考虑生活成本的差异，两地的工资几乎不具备可比性。

compare.en: It is misleading to compare the academic performance of rural and urban students without controlling for family income.
compare.zh: 在不控制家庭收入的情况下比较农村和城市学生的学业表现是误导性的。

comparison.en: Careful comparison of the two datasets revealed that the earlier study had systematically overestimated job creation.
comparison.zh: 对两个数据集的仔细比较显示，早期的研究系统性地高估了就业创造。

compatible.en: Economic growth is not automatically compatible with environmental protection, though well-designed policy can reconcile the two goals.
compatible.zh: 经济增长与环境保护并非天然兼容，不过设计良好的政策可以调和这两个目标。

compel.en: Strict disclosure rules compel firms to reveal environmental liabilities that they would otherwise prefer to keep hidden.
compel.zh: 严格的信息披露规则迫使企业披露它们原本更愿隐瞒的环境负债。

compelling.en: The committee accepted the new theory only after its proponents presented compelling evidence from multiple independent laboratories.
compelling.zh: 只有在其支持者拿出多个独立实验室的令人信服的证据后，委员会才接受了这一新理论。

compensate.en: Higher salaries alone cannot compensate for chronic overwork, which is why burnout keeps rising in demanding professions.
compensate.zh: 仅靠加薪无法弥补长期过度劳累，这就是高要求职业中职业倦怠持续上升的原因。

compete.en: Small bookshops struggle to compete with online retailers on price, so many now emphasize curation and community events instead.
compete.zh: 小书店难以在网上零售商的价格上竞争，因此许多书店转而强调精选书目和社区活动。

competence.en: Employers complain that graduates possess technical knowledge but lack the practical competence needed in ambiguous workplace situations.
competence.zh: 雇主们抱怨毕业生虽具备技术知识，却缺乏在模糊职场情境中所需的实际胜任能力。

competition.en: Critics worry that fierce competition among universities for research funding encourages innovation but discourages data sharing.
competition.zh: 批评者担心，大学之间为争夺科研经费的激烈竞争虽鼓励了创新，却也阻碍了数据共享。

competitive.en: In highly competitive labor markets, workers invest heavily in credentials that signal ability but add little real skill.
competitive.zh: 在竞争激烈的劳动力市场中，劳动者大量投资于能彰显能力却几乎不增加实际技能的证书。

compile.en: To compile a reliable dictionary of contemporary usage, editors must analyze millions of authentic sentences collected over decades.
compile.zh: 要编纂一部可靠的当代用法词典，编辑必须分析数十年间收集的数百万个真实句子。

complain.en: Consumers increasingly complain about opaque subscription terms that make canceling a service far harder than signing up.
complain.zh: 消费者越来越多地抱怨不透明的订阅条款，这些条款使取消服务远比注册困难。

complaint.en: The most common complaint among gig workers is not low pay itself but unpredictable income from week to week.
complaint.zh: 零工劳动者最普遍的抱怨不是工资低本身，而是每周收入难以预测。

complement.en: Online courses should complement rather than replace classroom teaching, since discussion and mentorship remain hard to replicate.
complement.zh: 在线课程应当补充而非取代课堂教学，因为讨论和导师指导仍难以复制。

complementary.en: Designers found that the two approaches were complementary: quantitative models identified risks while qualitative interviews explained them.
complementary.zh: 设计者发现这两种方法是互补的：定量模型识别风险，定性访谈解释风险。

complete.en: It took researchers nearly a decade to complete the field survey, but the resulting dataset transformed the discipline.
complete.zh: 研究人员花了近十年才完成这项实地调查，但所得数据集改变了整个学科。

complex.en: Climate policy is a complex problem in which economic incentives, international politics, and public beliefs interact continuously.
complex.zh: 气候政策是一个复杂问题，经济激励、国际政治和公众信念在其中持续相互作用。

compliance.en: Auditors discovered that formal compliance with safety regulations concealed widespread shortcuts taken during routine operations.
compliance.zh: 审计人员发现，对安全法规的形式合规掩盖了日常操作中普遍存在的偷工减料。

complicated.en: The instructions were so complicated that most users skipped them completely, producing entirely predictable installation errors.
complicated.zh: 说明书过于复杂，大多数用户干脆完全跳过，导致完全可以预见的安装错误。

comply.en: Shipping companies that refuse to comply with new emission standards may soon lose access to major European ports.
comply.zh: 拒绝遵守新排放标准的航运公司可能很快会被欧洲主要港口拒之门外。

component.en: Trust is an essential component of effective teams, yet it is rarely measured directly in performance evaluations.
component.zh: 信任是高效团队的重要组成部分，却很少在绩效评估中被直接衡量。

compose.en: In several European parliaments, women now compose almost half of the members, a striking change from one generation ago.
compose.zh: 在几个欧洲议会中，女性如今几乎占成员的一半，与上一代相比变化惊人。

composition.en: The chemical composition of ancient pottery helps archaeologists trace trade routes across the Mediterranean thousands of years ago.
composition.zh: 古代陶器的化学成分帮助考古学家追溯数千年前横贯地中海的贸易路线。

comprehensive.en: Only a comprehensive national survey can reveal how many households still lack reliable access to broadband internet.
comprehensive.zh: 只有全面的国家调查才能揭示多少家庭仍无法可靠地接入宽带互联网。

compromise.en: Negotiators finally reached a compromise under which emissions targets would phase in gradually rather than take effect immediately.
compromise.zh: 谈判者最终达成妥协：排放目标将逐步实施，而不是立即生效。

computational.en: Advances in computational methods now allow linguists to test grammar hypotheses against enormous text corpora within minutes.
computational.zh: 计算方法的进步使语言学家如今能在几分钟内用海量文本语料检验语法假设。

computing.en: Cloud computing has shifted the economics of research, giving small laboratories access to processing power once reserved for giants.
computing.zh: 云计算改变了研究经济学，使小实验室也能获得过去只有巨头才拥有的计算能力。

conceal.en: Officials attempted to conceal the scale of the outbreak, a decision that later proved catastrophic for public trust.
conceal.zh: 官员们试图隐瞒疫情的规模，这一决定后来被证明对公众信任是灾难性的。

concede.en: Even the strongest opponents of the reform concede that the current system fails too many students.
concede.zh: 即便是该改革最强烈的反对者也承认，现行制度辜负了太多学生。

conceive.en: It is difficult to conceive of a modern economy functioning without reliable systems for verifying identity and ownership.
conceive.zh: 很难设想一个缺乏可靠身份与产权验证系统的现代经济如何运转。

concentrate.en: Critics argue that allowing a few platform companies to concentrate market power will ultimately reduce innovation and consumer choice.
concentrate.zh: 批评者认为，允许少数平台公司集中市场权力最终会削弱创新和消费者选择。

concentration.en: Excessive concentration of media ownership threatens the plurality of opinions on which healthy democratic debate ultimately depends.
concentration.zh: 媒体所有权过度集中会威胁观点的多元性，而健康的民主辩论正有赖于这种多元性。

concept.en: The economic concept of opportunity cost explains why spending public money on one program means abandoning others.
concept.zh: 机会成本这一经济学概念解释了为什么把公共资金花在一个项目上就意味着放弃其他项目。

concern.en: Public health experts share a growing concern that antibiotic resistance may undermine decades of medical progress.
concern.zh: 公共卫生专家日益担忧抗生素耐药性可能会毁掉数十年的医学进步。

concerning.en: The committee issued new guidelines concerning the storage and sharing of genetic data collected from volunteers.
concerning.zh: 该委员会就志愿者基因数据的存储与共享发布了新的指导准则。

concert.en: The city funded a free outdoor concert series, hoping to revive foot traffic in the struggling downtown district.
concert.zh: 该市资助了一系列免费户外音乐会，希望以此重振萧条市中心的客流。

conclude.en: The panel could not conclude that the drug was effective, because too many participants dropped out of the trial.
conclude.zh: 由于太多受试者中途退出试验，专家组无法断定该药物有效。

conclusion.en: The report's central conclusion was that early childhood investment yields higher returns than most later interventions.
conclusion.zh: 该报告的核心结论是，幼儿期投资的回报高于大多数后期的干预措施。

conclusive.en: Despite decades of research, scientists still lack conclusive proof that moderate daily drinking harms the heart.
conclusive.zh: 尽管研究已持续数十年，科学家仍缺乏确凿证据证明每日适量饮酒会损害心脏。

concrete.en: Abstract principles mean little to voters until politicians translate them into concrete policies with visible local benefits.
concrete.zh: 抽象原则对选民意义不大，直到政治家将其转化为能带来明显本地利益的具体政策。

concurrent.en: The court imposed concurrent sentences, meaning the defendant will serve both prison terms at the same time.
concurrent.zh: 法院判处数刑并罚，即被告的两项刑期将同时执行。

condition.en: Economists have long debated whether attaching a strict condition to foreign aid improves outcomes or merely delays disbursement.
condition.zh: 经济学家长期争论：给对外援助附加严格条件究竟是能改善效果，还是仅仅推迟拨款。

conduct.en: Regulators accused the bank of reckless conduct in selling complex products to customers who could not understand them.
conduct.zh: 监管机构指控该银行向无法理解产品的客户销售复杂金融产品，行为鲁莽。

confer.en: Many universities confer honorary degrees on public figures, a practice that critics say dilutes academic standards.
confer.zh: 许多大学授予公众人物荣誉学位，批评者称这种做法淡化了学术标准。

conference.en: Researchers postponed the annual conference after most airlines suspended international flights during the public health emergency.
conference.zh: 在公共卫生紧急事件期间多数航空公司暂停国际航班后，研究人员推迟了年会。

confidence.en: Consumer confidence typically falls sharply before recessions begin, which is why economists monitor survey data so closely.
confidence.zh: 消费者信心通常在经济衰退开始前急剧下降，这就是经济学家密切监测调查数据的原因。

confident.en: Students who feel confident about their ability persist longer on difficult problems than those who attribute early failure to fixed talent.
confident.zh: 对自己能力有信心的学生在难题上坚持得更久，而把早期失败归因于固定才能的学生则不然。

confine.en: Administrators decided to confine the pilot program to two districts before extending it across the entire province.
confine.zh: 管理者决定先将试点项目限制在两个区，然后再推广到全省。

confirm.en: Independent replication is required to confirm a scientific claim, because a single study can always be a statistical fluke.
confirm.zh: 确认一项科学主张需要独立的重复验证，因为单一研究总可能只是统计上的偶然。

conflict.en: The study exposed a conflict between what managers claimed to value and how they actually rewarded employees.
conflict.zh: 该研究揭示了管理者宣称的价值观与他们实际奖励员工方式之间的冲突。

conform.en: Even in creative industries, employees face pressure to conform to unwritten norms about dress, speech, and working hours.
conform.zh: 即便在创意产业，员工也面临遵从着装、言谈和工作时间等不成文规范的压力。

confront.en: Developing countries confront a painful dilemma between expanding cheap energy access and meeting international climate commitments.
confront.zh: 发展中国家面临两难：既要扩大廉价能源供应，又要履行国际气候承诺。

confusion.en: The instructions generated widespread confusion because the online form and the printed brochure described different deadlines.
confusion.zh: 由于在线表格与印刷手册写的截止日期不同，说明引发了普遍的困惑。

conglomerate.en: The media conglomerate owns newspapers, television stations, and streaming platforms, raising concerns about its influence over public opinion.
conglomerate.zh: 这家传媒集团拥有报纸、电视台和流媒体平台，引发人们对其左右舆论的担忧。

congress.en: The national congress approved the budget only after weeks of negotiation between the ruling party and regional representatives.
congress.zh: 经过执政党与地方代表数周的谈判，国民议会才批准了预算案。

connect.en: Urban designers connect parks and waterfronts with cycling paths so that recreational spaces become part of daily commuting.
connect.zh: 城市设计者用自行车道把公园与滨水区连接起来，使休闲空间成为日常通勤的一部分。

connection.en: Epidemiologists established a clear connection between air pollution exposure and the frequency of childhood asthma attacks.
connection.zh: 流行病学家确立了空气污染暴露与儿童哮喘发作频率之间的明确联系。

connotation.en: For international marketers, even a harmless word can carry an unintended connotation that damages a brand overnight.
connotation.zh: 对国际营销者而言，一个看似无害的词也可能带有会一夜之间损害品牌的意外含义。

conscious.en: Consumers are increasingly conscious of the environmental footprint of the products they buy, forcing firms to redesign supply chains.
conscious.zh: 消费者越来越在意所购产品的环境足迹，这迫使企业重新设计供应链。

consecutive.en: The factory reported consecutive quarters of declining orders, prompting management to reconsider its dependence on a single export market.
consecutive.zh: 该工厂订单连续数个季度下滑，促使管理层重新考虑对单一出口市场的依赖。

consensus.en: After months of disagreement, the scientific community finally reached a consensus on the safety threshold for the chemical.
consensus.zh: 经过数月的分歧，科学界最终就该化学品的安全阈值达成共识。

consent.en: Ethical guidelines require that patients give informed consent before their medical records are used for research purposes.
consent.zh: 伦理准则要求患者在病历被用于研究之前给予知情同意。

consequence.en: As a consequence of chronic underfunding, many rural schools cannot attract or retain qualified science teachers.
consequence.zh: 由于长期经费不足，许多乡村学校无法吸引或留住合格的理科教师。

conservation.en: Wildlife conservation projects rarely succeed unless local communities receive a fair share of the tourism revenue generated.
conservation.zh: 除非当地社区能分得公平的旅游收益，否则野生动物保护项目很少能成功。

conservative.en: Insurance firms now argue that even conservative estimates of future flood losses are dangerously optimistic.
conservative.zh: 保险公司如今认为，即使对未来洪水损失作保守估计，也乐观得危险。

consider.en: Policy makers should consider how a proposed tax will affect low-income households before it is enacted.
consider.zh: 决策者应当在新税种实施之前考虑它将如何影响低收入家庭。

considerable.en: Relocating the factory required considerable investment in retraining workers whose old skills no longer matched the new equipment.
considerable.zh: 搬迁工厂需要大量投资，用于再培训那些原有技能已不适应新设备的工人。

consideration.en: After much consideration, the board approved the acquisition despite warnings from two dissenting directors about hidden liabilities.
consideration.zh: 经过反复考虑，董事会批准了这次收购，尽管两名持异议的董事就隐性债务提出了警告。

consist.en: A healthy diet does not consist of expensive supplements but of ordinary vegetables, grains, and modest portions of meat.
consist.zh: 健康饮食不在于昂贵的补品，而在于普通蔬菜、谷物和适量的肉类。

consistency.en: Investors value consistency in corporate reporting because sudden changes in accounting methods usually signal deeper problems.
consistency.zh: 投资者重视公司报告的一致性，因为会计方法的突然改变通常预示着更深层次的问题。

consistent.en: The experimental results were consistent across all age groups, strengthening the case for revising the existing guidelines.
consistent.zh: 实验结果在所有年龄组中均保持一致，这强化了修订现行准则的理由。

consolidate.en: The merger allowed the two regional banks to consolidate their branches and cut administrative costs by nearly a fifth.
consolidate.zh: 此次合并使两家地区性银行得以整合网点，并将管理成本削减近五分之一。

constant.en: Language learners benefit from constant exposure to authentic material rather than from occasional intense cramming sessions.
constant.zh: 语言学习者受益于持续接触真实语料，而不是偶尔进行高强度的突击学习。

constitute.en: Under the new rules, repeated data breaches may constitute grounds for revoking a company's operating license.
constitute.zh: 根据新规，反复发生数据泄露可能构成吊销企业经营执照的理由。

constitution.en: The supreme court ruled that the new surveillance law violated the constitution, forcing parliament to redraft key provisions.
constitution.zh: 最高法院裁定新的监控法违宪，迫使议会重新起草关键条款。

constitutive.en: Scholars treat free public deliberation as constitutive of genuine democracy rather than as a mere procedural formality.
constitutive.zh: 学者将自由的公共审议视为真正民主的构成要素，而非单纯的形式化程序。

constrain.en: Limited bandwidth continues to constrain the ambitions of rural telemedicine programs that require high-resolution video consultations.
constrain.zh: 带宽不足继续制约着需要高分辨率视频问诊的农村远程医疗计划的抱负。

construct.en: Modern engineers construct bridges that can flex during earthquakes, absorbing energy that would once have destroyed the structure.
construct.zh: 现代工程师建造的桥梁能在地震中弯曲变形，吸收过去足以摧毁结构物的能量。

construction.en: Delays in the construction of new housing have pushed rents sharply higher in nearly every major city.
construction.zh: 新住宅建设的延误使几乎所有大城市的房租大幅上涨。

consultant.en: The city hired an outside consultant to assess whether the metro expansion justified its projected costs.
consultant.zh: 该市聘请外部顾问评估地铁扩建是否物有所值。

consume.en: Data centers now consume roughly two percent of global electricity, prompting engineers to redesign cooling systems.
consume.zh: 数据中心如今消耗全球约百分之二的电力，促使工程师重新设计冷却系统。

consumer.en: Advertising increasingly targets the consumer directly through personalized feeds rather than through expensive mass media campaigns.
consumer.zh: 广告越来越通过个性化信息流直接面向消费者，而不是依靠昂贵的大众媒体投放。

consumption.en: Taxing sugary drinks aims to reduce consumption without banning products outright, a compromise many governments prefer.
consumption.zh: 对含糖饮料征税旨在减少消费而不直接禁售产品，这是许多政府偏好的折中做法。

contact.en: Epidemiologists traced every recent contact of the infected travelers to contain the outbreak before it reached major cities.
contact.zh: 流行病学家追踪了受感染旅客近期的每一位接触者，以便在疫情蔓延到大城市之前加以控制。

contain.en: The archive may contain sensitive personal data, so researchers must strip all identifying details before publication.
contain.zh: 档案中可能包含敏感的个人数据，因此研究人员在发表前必须删除所有可识别身份的细节。

container.en: Standardized container shipping slashed the cost of moving goods across oceans, quietly reshaping global trade patterns.
container.zh: 标准化的集装箱运输大幅削减了跨洋运输成本，悄然改变了全球贸易格局。

contemplate.en: Regulators now contemplate stricter capital requirements for banks whose trading desks rely heavily on automated algorithms.
contemplate.zh: 监管机构如今正考虑对交易部门严重依赖自动化算法的银行实施更严格的资本要求。

contemporary.en: Unlike many contemporary novelists, she writes about rural depopulation rather than urban anxieties, which has won her a devoted audience.
contemporary.zh: 与许多同时代小说家不同，她描写农村人口流失而非都市焦虑，这为她赢得了忠实的读者。

content.en: Streaming platforms compete on the quality of their content libraries rather than on subscription price alone.
content.zh: 流媒体平台的竞争在于内容库的质量，而不只是订阅价格。

contest.en: Opposition parties plan to contest the election results in court, alleging systematic irregularities in several provinces.
contest.zh: 反对党计划在法庭上对选举结果提出异议，指控数个省份存在系统性违规。

context.en: Taken out of context, the statistic suggests a crisis, but long-term data tell a far more reassuring story.
context.zh: 脱离上下文来看，这一统计数据像是在暗示危机，但长期数据讲述的情况要令人安心得多。

contingent.en: The consultancy fee is contingent on the project meeting its announced deadlines, which critics say encourages shortcuts.
contingent.zh: 咨询费取决于项目能否按公布的期限完成，批评者称这会助长投机取巧。

continue.en: Unless universities continue to attract doctoral students, an entire generation of research capacity will simply disappear.
continue.zh: 除非大学继续吸引博士生，否则整整一代科研力量将不复存在。

continuous.en: Sensors provide a continuous stream of measurements, allowing engineers to detect structural weaknesses long before failure.
continuous.zh: 传感器提供连续不断的测量数据，使工程师能在结构失效很久之前发现薄弱环节。

contract.en: Before signing the contract, the hospital demanded written guarantees that the software vendor would store data domestically.
contract.zh: 在签订合同之前，医院要求软件供应商书面保证将数据存储在国内。

contradict.en: The new fossils contradict the widely accepted timeline of early human migration out of Africa.
contradict.zh: 新发现的化石与广为接受的早期人类走出非洲的时间线相矛盾。

contrast.en: In sharp contrast to previous decades, young workers now change employers frequently in search of better work-life balance.
contrast.zh: 与过去几十年形成鲜明对比的是，如今的年轻劳动者为了更好的工作与生活平衡而频繁更换雇主。

contribute.en: Volunteers contribute thousands of hours to citizen science projects, expanding research capacity far beyond professional laboratories.
contribute.zh: 志愿者为公民科学项目贡献了数千小时，使科研能力远超专业实验室的范围。

contribution.en: The economist's most cited contribution was demonstrating that small differences in interest rates compound into large long-term gaps.
contribution.zh: 这位经济学家被引用最多的贡献是证明了利率的微小差异会经复利累积成长期的大差距。

control.en: Central banks use interest rates to control inflation, yet their instruments work slowly and unevenly across regions.
control.zh: 中央银行利用利率来控制通胀，但其政策工具传导缓慢且在各地效果不一。

controversial.en: The decision to rank universities publicly remains controversial because ranking criteria inevitably favor institutions with historic wealth.
controversial.zh: 公开大学排名的决定仍具争议，因为排名标准不可避免地偏向拥有历史财富的院校。

controversy.en: The hiring decision sparked a campus controversy about whether diversity goals should ever override formal qualifications.
controversy.zh: 这次聘用决定引发了一场校园争论：多元目标是否应当凌驾于正式资格之上。

controvert.en: Defense lawyers sought to controvert the forensic evidence by hiring two independent experts to retest the samples.
controvert.zh: 辩护律师聘请两名独立专家重新检测样本，试图驳倒法医证据。

convention.en: The conference examined how the social convention of tipping varies dramatically across countries and service industries.
convention.zh: 会议探讨了付小费这一社会惯例在不同国家和服务业之间的巨大差异。

conventional.en: Farmers who abandoned conventional pesticides reported higher long-term yields once natural predator populations had fully recovered.
conventional.zh: 放弃传统杀虫剂的农民发现，一旦天敌种群完全恢复，长期产量反而更高。

conventionality.en: Art historians criticize the conventionality of portrait painting, in which sitters were posed according to rigid social codes.
conventionality.zh: 艺术史家批评肖像画的因循守旧：画中人物必须按照僵化的社会规范摆出姿态。

conversation.en: Sociolinguists observe that everyday conversation, rather than formal writing, is where most grammatical change quietly begins.
conversation.zh: 社会语言学家观察到，日常谈话而非正式写作才是多数语法变化悄然发生之处。

convert.en: Several European utilities convert obsolete coal plants into biomass stations to meet emission targets without losing generating capacity.
convert.zh: 几家欧洲公用事业公司将老化的燃煤电厂改造为生物质电站，以便在不损失发电能力的情况下实现减排目标。

convey.en: Well-designed charts convey statistical relationships far more efficiently than dense paragraphs of numerical text ever could.
convey.zh: 设计良好的图表传达统计关系的效率远高于密密麻麻的数字段落。

conviction.en: The appeal court overturned the original conviction after new DNA analysis contradicted the key eyewitness testimony.
conviction.zh: 上诉法院推翻了原判定罪，因为新的DNA分析驳倒了关键的目击证词。

convince.en: Public health campaigns struggle to convince young adults that risks accumulate invisibly long before symptoms appear.
convince.zh: 公共卫生宣传难以让年轻人相信，风险早在症状出现之前就已在无形中累积。

cooperation.en: Managing migratory fish stocks requires international cooperation, because no single country controls the routes the fish follow.
cooperation.zh: 管理洄游鱼类资源需要国际合作，因为没有哪个国家能单独控制鱼类的洄游路线。

coordinate.en: Disaster relief agencies must coordinate their logistics carefully, or duplicated deliveries will crowd out supplies that are actually needed.
coordinate.zh: 救灾机构必须仔细协调物流，否则重复运送会挤占真正急需的物资。

cop.en: Sociologists studying street-level bureaucracy found that each cop develops informal rules for deciding when to make an arrest.
cop.zh: 研究基层官僚的社会学家发现，每名警察都会形成一套决定何时执行逮捕的非正式规则。

cope.en: Hospitals cope with seasonal surges in admissions by hiring temporary staff rather than expanding permanent capacity.
cope.zh: 医院通过雇用临时员工而非扩大固定编制来应对就诊量的季节性激增。

core.en: Digital literacy now sits at the core of national education strategies, alongside traditional reading and mathematics.
core.zh: 数字素养如今与传统的阅读和数学一道，居于国家教育战略的核心。

corn.en: Generous subsidies for corn production lowered feed prices and unintentionally reshaped the economics of the global meat industry.
corn.zh: 对玉米生产的慷慨补贴降低了饲料价格，无意中重塑了全球肉类产业的经济学。

corporate.en: In many firms, corporate boards now include directors with climate expertise, reflecting investor pressure for credible environmental strategies.
corporate.zh: 许多公司的董事会如今纳入具备气候专业知识的董事，反映出投资者对可信环境策略施加的压力。

corporation.en: When a multinational corporation shifts profits to low-tax jurisdictions, ordinary taxpayers effectively subsidize its global operations.
corporation.zh: 当跨国公司将利润转移到低税率辖区时，普通纳税人实际上在补贴其全球业务。

correct.en: Peer review exists partly to correct errors before publication, yet flawed papers still pass through journals regularly.
correct.zh: 同行评审存在的部分目的是在发表前纠正错误，但仍有缺陷的论文经常被期刊发表。

correlate.en: Across virtually every developed society, educational attainment continues to correlate strongly with income, health, and even life expectancy.
correlate.zh: 在几乎所有发达社会中，受教育程度仍与收入、健康乃至预期寿命高度相关。

correspond.en: The number of published papers does not always correspond to the actual quality of a scholar's research.
correspond.zh: 发表论文的数量并不总是与学者研究的实际质量相对应。
