correspondent.en: The veteran foreign correspondent argued that headlines distort wars more than any single government report does.
correspondent.zh: 这位资深驻外记者认为，新闻标题对战争的歪曲甚于任何一份政府报告。

cotton.en: The mechanization of cotton harvesting displaced millions of agricultural workers, accelerating migration toward industrial cities.
cotton.zh: 棉花采收的机械化使数百万农业工人失去生计，加速了向工业城市的迁移。

couch.en: Economists studying attention found that viewers retain little information from advertisements while lying on the couch watching television.
couch.zh: 研究注意力的经济学家发现，人们躺在沙发上看电视时几乎记不住广告中的信息。

council.en: The city council rejected the stadium proposal after residents complained about traffic, noise, and the loss of public green space.
council.zh: 在居民抱怨交通、噪音和公共绿地减少之后，市议会否决了体育场的提案。

counsel.en: Legal aid programs counsel low-income tenants facing eviction, significantly improving their outcomes in housing courts.
counsel.zh: 法律援助项目为面临驱逐的低收入租户提供咨询，显著改善了他们在住房法庭的处境。

counseling.en: Schools that offer free counseling report measurable declines in dropout rates among students facing family crises.
counseling.zh: 提供免费心理辅导的学校报告说，面临家庭危机的学生的辍学率有明显下降。

count.en: Recruiters count demonstrable project experience more heavily than grades when they evaluate recent graduates for technical positions.
count.zh: 招聘人员在评估应届毕业生能否胜任技术岗位时，更看重可展示的项目经验而非成绩。

counter.en: Optimists counter that every previous wave of automation ultimately created more jobs than it destroyed, though transition costs were severe.
counter.zh: 乐观者反驳说，以往每一轮自动化最终创造的岗位都多于其摧毁的数量，尽管转型代价高昂。

country.en: A country that underinvests in primary education will eventually pay far more in welfare costs and lost productivity.
country.zh: 一个在初等教育上投资不足的国家，最终将在福利支出和生产率损失上付出高得多的代价。

county.en: Rural county hospitals have merged with urban systems to survive, reducing local access to emergency care.
county.zh: 为求生存，乡村县医院已并入城市医疗系统，导致当地急诊服务的可及性下降。

couple.en: In interviews, each couple described how they divided childcare responsibilities, revealing deep variation across social classes.
couple.zh: 在访谈中，每对夫妇都讲述了如何分担育儿责任，这揭示出不同社会阶层之间的巨大差异。

courage.en: Whistleblowers need considerable courage, because their careers, finances, and personal relationships are all placed at serious risk.
courage.zh: 举报人需要相当的勇气，因为他们的职业、财务和人际关系都将面临严重风险。

course.en: In the course of the long field study, the team documented more than two hundred previously unknown species.
course.zh: 在漫长的实地研究过程中，团队记录了两百多个此前未知的物种。

court.en: Legal scholars note that the supreme court tends to uphold agency decisions when solid technical expertise supports them.
court.zh: 法律学者指出，当可靠的专业技术支持各机构的决定时，最高法院往往会予以维持。

cousin.en: Anthropologists found that terms such as cousin encode far more complex kinship rules than the English word suggests.
cousin.zh: 人类学家发现，表亲称谓背后蕴含的亲属规则远比这个英文单词所暗示的复杂。

cover.en: Standard travel insurance policies cover medical emergencies abroad but frequently exclude losses caused by government travel restrictions.
cover.zh: 标准的旅行保险承保国外的医疗紧急情况，但常常把政府旅行限制造成的损失排除在外。

coverage.en: Insurance coverage for natural disasters is shrinking in high-risk coastal areas as reinsurers withdraw from those markets.
coverage.zh: 随着再保险公司撤出高风险沿海市场，这些地区的自然灾害保险覆盖范围正在缩小。

cow.en: Dairy farmers installed sensors on every cow to monitor health, cutting antibiotic use without reducing milk output.
cow.zh: 奶农为每头奶牛安装传感器以监测健康状况，在不减少牛奶产量的情况下减少了抗生素的使用。

crack.en: Engineers discovered a hairline crack in the bridge girder during a routine inspection, prompting immediate lane closures.
crack.zh: 工程师在例行检查中发现桥梁大梁上有一道发丝般的裂缝，随即封闭了部分车道。

craft.en: Museums now sponsor apprenticeships so that the craft of restoring historic buildings is not lost to automation and cost cutting.
craft.zh: 博物馆如今资助学徒制度，使修复历史建筑的技艺不至于失传于自动化和削减成本。

crash.en: Investigators traced the stock market crash to algorithmic trading systems that amplified panic selling within minutes.
crash.zh: 调查人员将此次股市暴跌归因于算法交易系统，后者在几分钟内放大了恐慌性抛售。

crazy.en: Economists initially thought the plan crazy, yet the island's radical tourism strategy doubled local incomes within five years.
crazy.zh: 经济学家起初认为这个计划疯狂，然而该岛激进的旅游战略在五年内使当地收入翻了一番。

cream.en: Dairy cooperatives earn most of their profit by processing surplus milk into butter, cream, and aged cheese.
cream.zh: 乳业合作社通过把多余的牛奶加工成黄油、奶油和陈年奶酪赚取大部分利润。

create.en: Rapid technological change can create enormous wealth while simultaneously destroying the livelihoods of workers with obsolete skills.
create.zh: 快速的技术变革能够在创造巨额财富的同时，摧毁技能过时者的生计。

creative.en: Economists find that the most creative cities combine cheap studio space with dense networks of informal collaboration.
creative.zh: 经济学家发现，最具创造力的城市将廉价的创作空间与密集的非正式协作网络结合在一起。

creature.en: Every deep-sea expedition reveals at least one creature whose unusual biochemistry may hold commercial or medical value.
creature.zh: 每一次深海考察都会发现至少一种生物，其独特的生物化学特性可能具有商业或医学价值。

credibility.en: A news outlet that publishes unverified rumors sacrifices its credibility precisely when audiences need reliable information most.
credibility.zh: 发布未经证实谣言的新闻机构恰恰在受众最需要可靠信息的时候牺牲了自己的可信度。

credible.en: Climate models are credible only after they successfully reproduce temperature patterns observed in the historical record.
credible.zh: 气候模型只有在成功重现历史记录中观测到的温度模式之后才是可信的。

credit.en: Banks extended easy credit before the crisis, allowing households to borrow far beyond their realistic repayment capacity.
credit.zh: 危机爆发前银行放松信贷，使家庭的借贷远远超出其实际偿还能力。

crew.en: The entire crew of the research vessel worked around the clock to collect ocean samples, contributing to a landmark study on marine plastic pollution.
crew.zh: 这艘科考船上的全体船员夜以继日地采集海洋样本，为一项关于海洋塑料污染的里程碑式研究做出了贡献。

crime.en: Sociologists have long debated whether poverty itself causes crime or merely creates conditions in which criminal behavior becomes more likely to occur.
crime.zh: 社会学家一直在争论究竟是贫困本身导致犯罪，还是仅仅创造了使犯罪行为更容易发生的环境。

criminal.en: The new law requires that anyone accused of a serious criminal offence be represented by counsel, a reform praised by human-rights groups.
criminal.zh: 新法律要求任何被指控犯有严重刑事罪行的人都必须获得律师辩护，这项改革受到人权组织的赞扬。

crisis.en: The 2008 financial crisis revealed how quickly confidence can collapse, forcing governments to bail out banks that had taken reckless risks.
crisis.zh: 2008年金融危机揭示了信心崩塌的速度之快，迫使政府救助那些承担了鲁莽风险的银行。

criteria.en: Admissions officers insist that their criteria are transparent, yet applicants complain that the weight given to extracurricular achievement remains unclear.
criteria.zh: 招生官员坚称他们的评判标准是透明的，但申请者抱怨课外成就所占的权重仍不明确。

criterion.en: A single criterion such as test scores, many educators warn, cannot capture the full range of a student's potential.
criterion.zh: 许多教育者警告说，仅凭考试成绩这样一条标准无法衡量学生潜力的全部范围。

critic.en: Every critic who reviewed the exhibition agreed that the young painter had redefined the boundary between photography and classical portraiture.
critic.zh: 每一位评论过该画展的评论家都一致认为，这位年轻画家重新界定了摄影与古典肖像画之间的边界。

critical.en: Careful, critical analysis of clinical trial data is essential, because a single flawed study can distort treatment guidelines for millions of patients.
critical.zh: 对临床试验数据进行审慎而批判性的分析至关重要，因为一项有缺陷的研究就可能扭曲数百万患者的治疗指南。

criticism.en: Despite widespread criticism of the scheme's cost, the government argues that the long-term benefits to public health will outweigh the initial investment.
criticism.zh: 尽管该计划的成本受到广泛批评，政府仍辩称其对公共健康的长期收益将超过初期投入。

criticize.en: Economists criticize the subsidy for distorting competition, arguing that protected industries rarely develop the efficiency needed to survive in open markets.
criticize.zh: 经济学家批评这项补贴扭曲了竞争，认为受保护的产业很少能形成在开放市场中生存所需的效率。

crop.en: Switching from rice to a drought-resistant crop could help farmers in arid regions adapt to increasingly unpredictable rainfall patterns.
crop.zh: 从水稻改种耐旱作物可以帮助干旱地区的农民适应日益难以预测的降雨模式。

cross.en: Researchers who cross disciplinary boundaries often produce the most original work, combining insights from biology, engineering, and economics.
cross.zh: 跨越学科边界的研究者往往能产出最具原创性的成果，将生物学、工程学与经济学的洞见结合起来。

crowd.en: A crowd of anxious investors gathered outside the exchange within minutes of the announcement that trading had been suspended.
crowd.zh: 在交易被暂停的消息宣布后几分钟内，一群焦虑的投资者聚集在交易所外。

crucial.en: Access to reliable data is crucial to evidence-based policymaking, because decisions made on anecdote tend to misallocate scarce public resources.
crucial.zh: 获得可靠数据对循证决策至关重要，因为基于传闻做出的决定往往会错配稀缺的公共资源。

cultivate.en: Business schools claim to cultivate entrepreneurial thinking, although measurable outcomes such as startup formation remain surprisingly modest.
cultivate.zh: 商学院声称要培养创业思维，但诸如初创企业创立等可衡量的成果却出人意料地有限。

culture.en: Corporate culture, rather than formal rules, often determines whether employees report misconduct or quietly conceal problems from regulators.
culture.zh: 往往是企业文化而非正式规则决定了员工是举报不当行为，还是悄悄向监管者隐瞒问题。

cumulative.en: The cumulative effect of many small policy changes can eventually transform an institution more profoundly than any single dramatic reform.
cumulative.zh: 许多微小政策变化的累积效应最终对机构的改变，可能比任何单项剧烈改革都更为深刻。

curious.en: Teachers observe that curious students outperform their peers not because they memorize faster, but because they ask better questions and pursue them persistently.
curious.zh: 教师们观察到，好奇心强的学生之所以胜过同龄人，不是因为他们记东西更快，而是因为他们提出更好的问题并坚持不懈地探究下去。

current.en: Under current regulations, social-media platforms face few penalties for hosting content that spreads medical misinformation.
current.zh: 根据现行法规，社交媒体平台因传播医疗错误信息而承担的处罚微乎其微。

curricular.en: Reformers argue that curricular change fails unless teachers receive sustained training and assessment methods are redesigned accordingly.
curricular.zh: 改革者认为，如果教师得不到持续培训、评估方法也不相应调整，课程改革就不会成功。

curriculum.en: The revised curriculum places greater emphasis on data literacy, reflecting employers' growing demand for graduates who can interpret statistics responsibly.
curriculum.zh: 修订后的课程更加重视数据素养，反映出雇主对能够负责任地解读统计数据的毕业生日益增长的需求。

custom.en: In many societies the custom of paying a dowry persists despite legal bans, illustrating how tradition can outlast legislation.
custom.zh: 在许多社会，尽管法律明令禁止，支付嫁妆的习俗依然延续，这说明传统可以比立法更持久。

customary.en: It is customary for outgoing governments to avoid major policy commitments, leaving difficult decisions to their successors.
customary.zh: 即将卸任的政府通常会避免作出重大政策承诺，把棘手的决定留给继任者。

customer.en: Retaining an existing customer costs far less than acquiring a new one, a principle that should shape every service strategy.
customer.zh: 留住一名老客户的成本远低于获取一名新客户，这一原则应当指导每一项服务策略。

cyber.en: Policymakers increasingly treat cyber threats to hospitals and power grids as matters of national security rather than mere technical problems.
cyber.zh: 政策制定者日益将针对医院和电网的网络威胁视为国家安全问题，而不仅仅是技术问题。

cybersecurity.en: Universities are expanding cybersecurity programs as breaches of student and research data become both more frequent and more damaging.
cybersecurity.zh: 由于学生和研究数据泄露事件变得更频繁、危害更大，各大学正在扩展网络安全学科项目。

cycle.en: Analysts note that the housing market moves in a predictable cycle of boom, correction, and stagnation, though the timing varies.
cycle.zh: 分析师指出，房地产市场遵循繁荣、回调与停滞的可预测周期运行，只是时间点难以把握。

daily.en: Remote work has blurred the boundary between professional obligations and daily life, raising new questions about workers' right to disconnect.
daily.zh: 远程办公模糊了职业义务与日常生活之间的界限，对劳动者的离线权提出了新问题。

damage.en: Economists estimate that hurricane damage to coastal infrastructure will exceed earlier projections as sea levels continue to rise.
damage.zh: 经济学家估计，随着海平面持续上升，飓风对沿海基础设施造成的破坏将超过早先的预测。

danger.en: The greatest danger of algorithmic decision-making is not obvious error but subtle bias that escapes human review.
danger.zh: 算法决策最大的危险不在于明显的错误，而在于逃过人工审查的隐蔽偏见。

dangerous.en: Driving while sleep-deprived is nearly as dangerous as drunk driving, yet campaigns against it receive a fraction of the funding.
dangerous.zh: 睡眠不足时开车与酒驾几乎同样危险，但针对它的宣传活动所获得的资金却少得多。

dare.en: Few politicians dare to question the generous farm subsidy openly, because agricultural districts dominate the electoral map.
dare.zh: 很少有政客敢公开质疑这笔丰厚的农业补贴，因为农业选区在选举版图中举足轻重。

data.en: The committee refused to publish raw data supporting the report, a decision that immediately undermined public confidence in its findings.
data.zh: 委员会拒绝公布支持该报告的原始数据，这一决定立刻削弱了公众对其结论的信任。

data-driven.en: Hospitals that adopt data-driven staffing schedules report fewer medical errors and lower overtime costs within the first year.
data-driven.zh: 采用数据驱动排班制度的医院在第一年内就报告医疗差错减少、加班成本降低。

database.en: Linking each region's health records to a national database would speed outbreak detection, though privacy advocates warn of abuse.
database.zh: 将各地区的健康档案接入国家数据库将加快疫情检测，但隐私倡导者警告这可能被滥用。

daughter.en: One legislator credited his daughter with changing his views, noting that fatherhood had made gender pay gaps feel personal rather than abstract.
daughter.zh: 一位议员将观点的转变归功于他的女儿，指出为人父让性别薪酬差距从抽象问题变成了切身之事。

deal.en: The trade deal was praised for lowering tariffs, yet opponents warned that weaker labor provisions would harm domestic manufacturing.
deal.zh: 这项贸易协定因降低关税而受到赞扬，但反对者警告说，较弱的劳工条款将损害国内制造业。

dealer.en: Under the new rules, every dealer must record the origin of secondhand goods, making it harder to launder stolen items.
dealer.zh: 根据新规定，每名经销商都必须登记二手商品的来源，这使清洗赃物变得更加困难。

death.en: The death of local newspapers has left many small towns without any professional coverage of council meetings or school boards.
death.zh: 地方报纸的消亡使许多小镇的市政会议和学校董事会事务失去了任何专业报道。

debate.en: The debate over universal basic income has shifted from whether it is affordable to whether it would weaken the incentive to work.
debate.zh: 关于全民基本收入的辩论已从它是否负担得起，转向它是否会削弱工作意愿。

debt.en: Countries that finance expansion through debt must eventually choose between austerity, inflation, or default, warns a new IMF report.
debt.zh: 国际货币基金组织的一份新报告警告，靠债务为扩张融资的国家最终必须在紧缩、通胀或违约之间做出选择。

decade.en: Over the past decade, renewable energy has fallen in cost so sharply that it now undercuts new coal plants in most markets.
decade.zh: 过去十年间可再生能源成本大幅下降，如今在大多数市场上已低于新建燃煤电厂。

decentralize.en: Advocates urge the ministry to decentralize hiring so that principals, not central bureaucrats, choose the teachers their schools actually need.
decentralize.zh: 倡导者敦促教育部下放用人权，让校长而非中央官僚来挑选学校真正需要的教师。

decision.en: The court's decision that algorithmic rent-pricing tools violate antitrust law is expected to reshape the entire property market.
decision.zh: 法院裁定算法租金定价工具违反反垄断法，预计这一裁决将重塑整个房地产市场。

deck.en: Engineers found that the bridge deck had corroded faster than models predicted, prompting an urgent inspection of similar structures.
deck.zh: 工程师发现桥面板的腐蚀速度超出模型预测，这促使人们紧急检查类似结构。

declare.en: Members of the cabinet were required to declare any financial interest that might conflict with their official duties.
declare.zh: 内阁成员必须申报任何可能与公务职责相冲突的经济利益。

decline.en: Researchers attribute the decline in insect populations chiefly to pesticide use and habitat fragmentation rather than to climate change alone.
decline.zh: 研究人员将昆虫种群的减少主要归因于杀虫剂的使用和栖息地破碎化，而非仅仅归因于气候变化。

decrease.en: Even a modest decrease in salt intake across the population would prevent thousands of strokes and heart attacks each year.
decrease.zh: 全国范围内哪怕盐摄入量小幅减少，每年也能预防数千例中风和心脏病发作。

dedicate.en: The prize honors scientists who dedicate their careers to neglected tropical diseases that rarely attract commercial research funding.
dedicate.zh: 该奖项表彰那些将职业生涯奉献给被忽视的热带病的科学家，这类疾病很少吸引商业研究资金。

deduce.en: From the distribution of fossils on separate continents, Wegener deduced that the landmasses had once formed a single supercontinent.
deduce.zh: 韦格纳根据化石在各大陆上的分布推断，这些陆地曾经组成一个单一的超大陆。

deer.en: Ecologists fenced off several plots to test whether an exploding deer population was preventing forest regeneration.
deer.zh: 生态学家围起了几块样地，以检验数量激增的鹿群是否正在阻碍森林更新。

defeat.en: The reformers' defeat in parliament delayed the bill for years, though public support for it kept growing.
defeat.zh: 改革者在议会中的失败使该法案拖延了数年，尽管公众对它的支持持续增长。

defend.en: The university defended its admissions policy, arguing that considering hardship alongside grades produces a more capable student body.
defend.zh: 该大学为其招生政策辩护，称在成绩之外考量困境因素能培养出更有能力的学生群体。

defer.en: Many junior managers defer to senior colleagues even when the evidence clearly contradicts the prevailing view.
defer.zh: 许多基层管理者即便在证据明显与主流观点相悖时也顺从资深同事。

deficit.en: The trade deficit narrowed for a third consecutive quarter, driven mainly by a rebound in export manufacturing.
deficit.zh: 在出口制造业回暖的推动下，贸易赤字已连续第三个季度收窄。

define.en: How regulators define artificial intelligence will determine which products face strict scrutiny and which escape oversight altogether.
define.zh: 监管者如何定义人工智能，将决定哪些产品面临严格审查、哪些完全逃脱监管。

definition.en: The textbook's definition of inflation as a sustained rise in prices captures the phenomenon but obscures its uneven impact.
definition.zh: 教科书把通货膨胀定义为价格的持续上涨，这抓住了现象本身，却掩盖了其影响的不均衡性。

deforestation.en: Satellite data show that deforestation in the basin accelerated after enforcement budgets were cut by nearly half.
deforestation.zh: 卫星数据显示，在执法预算被削减近一半之后，该流域的毁林速度加快了。

degree.en: Employers increasingly question whether a university degree reliably signals competence, given grade inflation across many institutions.
degree.zh: 鉴于许多院校普遍存在分数虚高现象，雇主们越来越怀疑大学学位是否还能可靠地证明能力。

delay.en: A short delay in vaccination campaigns can allow an outbreak to double in size before it is brought under control.
delay.zh: 疫苗接种活动的短暂延误可能让疫情在得到控制之前规模翻倍。

deliberate.en: The committee's deliberate pace frustrated journalists, but members insisted that hasty decisions would only invite legal challenges.
deliberate.zh: 委员会的审慎节奏令记者感到沮丧，但成员们坚持认为仓促决策只会招致法律挑战。

deliver.en: Universities must deliver more than technical skills, preparing graduates to weigh evidence and argue responsibly in public life.
deliver.zh: 大学必须提供的不仅是技术技能，还要让毕业生准备好在公共生活中权衡证据并进行负责任的论证。

delivery.en: The shift to online delivery of lectures cut costs, but surveys found that students felt less connected to their instructors.
delivery.zh: 将讲课转向线上交付降低了成本，但调查发现学生感到与教师的联系变少了。

demand.en: Global demand for rare-earth metals is rising so quickly that recycling old electronics is becoming an economically attractive industry.
demand.zh: 全球对稀土金属的需求增长如此之快，以至于回收旧电子产品正成为一项在经济上有吸引力的产业。

democracy.en: Political scientists argue that a free press is not a luxury of democracy but the mechanism through which voters hold power accountable.
democracy.zh: 政治学家认为，新闻自由并非民主的奢侈品，而是选民问责权力的机制。

democratic.en: Critics claim the party's nominating process is insufficiently democratic, since a handful of officials can veto any candidate.
democratic.zh: 批评者称该党的提名程序不够民主，因为少数几名官员就能否决任何候选人。

demographic.en: The demographic shift toward older populations will strain pension systems long before automation can offset the shortage of workers.
demographic.zh: 在自动化足以弥补劳动力短缺之前很久，人口结构向老龄化的转变就将令养老金体系不堪重负。

demonstrate.en: Field trials demonstrate that cash transfers improve school attendance more reliably than building new classrooms in the same villages.
demonstrate.zh: 实地试验证明，在同样的村庄，现金补助比新建教室更能可靠地提高入学率。

deny.en: Officials deny any wrongdoing, yet internal emails released by the court showed that executives had known about the defect for years.
deny.zh: 官员们否认有任何不当行为，但法庭披露的内部邮件表明，高管们多年来一直知道该缺陷的存在。

department.en: The philosophy department's merger with linguistics was intended to save money, though some fear the field will lose visibility.
department.zh: 哲学系与语言学系的合并旨在节省经费，尽管有人担心这一学科会因此失去显示度。

depend.en: Whether remote learning succeeds depends less on the technology itself than on how teachers are trained to use it.
depend.zh: 远程学习能否成功，与其说取决于技术本身，不如说取决于教师接受怎样的使用培训。

dependency.en: The region's heavy dependency on a single export left it exposed when global prices collapsed.
dependency.zh: 该地区对单一出口商品的严重依赖，使其在全球价格崩塌时首当其冲。

dependent.en: Economies dependent on tourism suffered disproportionately during the pandemic, prompting calls for more diversified development strategies.
dependent.zh: 依赖旅游业的经济体在疫情期间遭受了格外严重的损失，促使人们呼吁更多元化的发展战略。

depict.en: The novel depicts industrialization not as progress but as a force that empties villages and poisons rivers.
depict.zh: 这部小说把工业化描绘成掏空村庄、毒化河流的力量，而非进步。

deplete.en: Groundwater reserves are being depleted far faster than rainfall can replenish them, according to a decade of satellite measurements.
deplete.zh: 十年的卫星测量显示，地下水储备的消耗速度远远超过降雨的补充速度。

deploy.en: Schools that deploy tablets without retraining teachers often find the devices used merely to reproduce old, lecture-based habits.
deploy.zh: 在不重新培训教师的情况下部署平板电脑的学校往往发现，这些设备只是被用来复制旧的灌输式教学。

depression.en: Longitudinal studies link adolescent social-media use to higher rates of depression, though causation remains fiercely contested.
depression.zh: 纵向研究将青少年使用社交媒体与更高的抑郁发生率联系起来，尽管其中的因果关系仍存在激烈争议。

deprivation.en: Early childhood deprivation, including poor nutrition and minimal stimulation, leaves measurable marks on cognitive development years later.
deprivation.zh: 幼年时期的匮乏，包括营养不良和刺激不足，会在多年后给认知发展留下可测量的印记。

depth.en: The seminar's depth impressed even senior scholars, who praised the speaker's command of both statistics and policy detail.
depth.zh: 研讨会的深度给资深学者们留下深刻印象，他们称赞演讲者对统计学和政策细节都了然于胸。

deputy.en: The deputy governor will chair the review while the governor testifies before parliament, the bank announced on Tuesday.
deputy.zh: 央行周二宣布，行长在议会作证期间，将由副行长主持此次审查。

deregulation.en: The deregulation of the airline industry cut fares dramatically, but smaller cities soon lost direct connections to major hubs.
deregulation.zh: 航空业的放松管制使票价大幅下降，但小城市很快失去了与主要枢纽的直航。

derive.en: Chemists derive many modern medicines from compounds first identified in rainforest plants, a fact often cited in conservation debates.
derive.zh: 化学家从最初在雨林植物中发现的一些化合物中获取许多现代药物，这一事实常在自然保护辩论中被引用。

describe.en: In his lecture, the physicist described how a chance observation in the laboratory overturned a theory he had defended for years.
describe.zh: 在讲座中，这位物理学家讲述了实验室里一次偶然的观察如何推翻了他多年坚持的理论。

description.en: The job description listed analytical skills first, yet the interview focused almost entirely on the candidate's network of contacts.
description.zh: 职位描述把分析能力排在首位，面试却几乎完全聚焦于候选人的人脉关系。

desert.en: As the lake shrank, residents began to desert the surrounding villages, moving to cities where work was steadier.
desert.zh: 随着湖泊萎缩，居民开始离弃周边的村庄，迁往工作更稳定的城市。

deserve.en: Workers who generate the profits deserve a fair share of them, whatever the prevailing fashion in executive pay.
deserve.zh: 创造利润的劳动者理应获得公平的一份，无论当时高管薪酬的风尚如何。

design.en: The study's design has been praised because participants were assigned to groups randomly, eliminating the most common source of bias.
design.zh: 该研究的设计广受称赞，因为参与者被随机分组，消除了最常见的偏倚来源。

desirable.en: Economists disagree about whether full employment is desirable, since very tight labor markets can fuel persistent inflation.
desirable.zh: 经济学家对充分就业是否可取意见不一，因为过热的劳动力市场可能助长持续的通胀。

desire.en: Advertising works less by creating desire than by channeling existing anxieties toward particular products, some psychologists argue.
desire.zh: 一些心理学家认为，广告更多是通过把现有的焦虑引向特定产品来发挥作用，而非创造欲望。

desperate.en: The town, desperate to stem population decline, offered free housing and broadband to remote workers willing to relocate.
desperate.zh: 由于急于遏制人口减少，该镇向愿意迁入的远程工作者提供免费住房和宽带。

despite.en: The city continued, despite repeated warnings from engineers, to issue building permits for land below the new flood line.
despite.zh: 尽管工程师多次警告，该市仍继续在低于新洪水线的土地上发放建筑许可。

destroy.en: Invasive species can destroy local ecosystems within a few seasons, permanently altering food webs that evolved over millennia.
destroy.zh: 入侵物种能在几个季节内摧毁当地生态系统，永久改变历经数千年演化而成的食物网。

destruction.en: The destruction of mangrove forests removed a natural barrier that had protected coastal settlements from storm surges.
destruction.zh: 红树林的毁坏使原本保护沿海居民区免受风暴潮侵袭的天然屏障不复存在。

detail.en: The contract spells out in detail which party bears the cost when environmental regulations change mid-project.
detail.zh: 合同详细规定了当环境法规在项目中途变更时由哪一方承担费用。

detect.en: New sensors can detect structural weaknesses in bridges weeks before any visible crack appears, potentially saving lives.
detect.zh: 新型传感器能在桥梁出现任何可见裂缝前数周探测到结构弱点，从而可能挽救生命。

deter.en: Harsher penalties alone rarely deter white-collar crime, because executives calculate that prosecution remains statistically unlikely.
deter.zh: 单靠更重的刑罚很少能遏制白领犯罪，因为高管们盘算被起诉的可能性仍然很低。

determine.en: Twin studies help researchers determine how much of a trait is inherited and how much is shaped by environment.
determine.zh: 双生子研究帮助研究者确定一种特质有多少来自遗传、多少由环境塑造。

develop.en: The lab hopes to develop a battery that charges in minutes without degrading after thousands of charging cycles.
develop.zh: 该实验室希望研发一种几分钟即可充满电、且在数千次充放电循环后不衰减的电池。

developmental.en: Pediatricians stress that developmental screening in the first three years can identify delays while intervention is most effective.
developmental.zh: 儿科医生强调，生命前三年的发育筛查能在干预最有效的阶段发现发育迟缓。

deviate.en: Pilots may not deviate from the approved flight plan without permission, a rule that simplifies investigations after incidents.
deviate.zh: 飞行员未经许可不得偏离获批的飞行计划，这一规则简化了事故发生后的调查。

device.en: The new wearable device monitors heart rhythm continuously and alerts patients through a smartphone app before their symptoms become dangerous.
device.zh: 这种新型可穿戴设备持续监测心律，并在症状变得危险之前通过智能手机应用向患者发出警报。

devote.en: Whatever time professors devote to mentoring students, tenure committees still weigh published research far more heavily in promotion decisions.
devote.zh: 无论教授在指导学生上投入多少时间，终身教职评审委员会在晋升决定中仍远更看重发表的科研成果。

diagnostic.en: Cheap diagnostic tools that work without electricity could transform rural healthcare, provided supply chains keep them stocked.
diagnostic.zh: 无需电力即可使用的廉价诊断工具可以改变农村医疗，前提是供应链能保证供应。

diet.en: Researchers compared the Mediterranean diet with a low-fat alternative and found significantly lower rates of heart disease in the first group.
diet.zh: 研究者将地中海饮食与低脂饮食进行对比，发现第一组的心脏病发病率明显更低。

differ.en: The two laboratories differ mainly in how they treat missing data, which may explain their contradictory conclusions.
differ.zh: 两个实验室的主要分歧在于处理缺失数据的方式，这或许能解释它们相互矛盾的结论。

difference.en: The difference between the two groups was statistically significant, though small enough that individual outcomes varied widely.
difference.zh: 两组之间的差异在统计上显著，但幅度之小足以使个体结果差异很大。

different.en: Students from different academic backgrounds often solve the same design problem in strikingly different ways, enriching class discussion.
different.zh: 来自不同学科背景的学生往往以截然不同的方式解决同一个设计问题，丰富了课堂讨论。

difficulty.en: The main difficulty in reforming the tax code is not technical but political, since every loophole has a defender.
difficulty.zh: 税制改革的主要困难不在技术而在政治，因为每一条漏洞都有其维护者。

digital.en: The spread of digital payment systems has drawn millions of unbanked adults into the formal economy, according to the central bank's survey.
digital.zh: 央行调查显示，数字支付系统的普及已使数百万没有银行账户的成年人进入正规经济。

digitalize.en: The ministry plans to digitalize all land records within three years, a step expected to curb corrupt title transfers.
digitalize.zh: 该部计划在三年内将所有土地档案数字化，此举有望遏制腐败的产权转让。

digitization.en: The digitization of rare manuscripts lets scholars compare variants worldwide without traveling, though funding for such projects remains fragile.
digitization.zh: 珍稀手稿的数字化让学者无需远行即可比对世界各地的版本，尽管此类项目的资金仍不稳定。

dilemma.en: Hospitals face a genuine dilemma: spend scarce funds on the newest equipment or on hiring more experienced nurses.
dilemma.zh: 医院面临真正的两难抉择：是把稀缺资金用于购置最新设备，还是用于聘用更有经验的护士。

dimension.en: The philosopher added an ethical dimension to the debate over automation, asking who bears responsibility when machines misjudge.
dimension.zh: 这位哲学家为关于自动化的辩论加入了伦理维度，追问当机器误判时责任由谁承担。

diminish.en: Repeated budget cuts have diminished the agency's capacity to inspect food plants, auditors warned in a confidential report.
diminish.zh: 审计人员在一份机密报告中警告，接连的预算削减已削弱该机构检查食品厂的能力。

direct.en: The charity adopted a direct approach, transferring cash rather than goods, which reduced poverty with minimal administrative overhead.
direct.zh: 该慈善机构采取了直接的方式，发放现金而非实物，从而以极少的行政开支实现了减贫。

direction.en: The research program changed direction after preliminary results suggested the original hypothesis was too narrow to be testable.
direction.zh: 初步结果提示原有假设过于狭窄而无法检验后，该研究项目改变了方向。

directly.en: The study found that screen time before bed directly reduces sleep quality, even when total hours remain constant.
directly.zh: 研究发现，睡前使用屏幕会直接降低睡眠质量，即使总时长不变。

director.en: The board's new director promised greater transparency, publishing quarterly reports on how research funds are allocated.
director.zh: 董事会新任董事承诺提高透明度，按季度公布科研经费的分配报告。

dirt.en: Cheap sensors can now measure moisture, nutrients, and even contaminants in dirt, letting farmers fertilize only where needed.
dirt.zh: 廉价传感器如今能测量土壤中的水分、养分甚至污染物，让农民只在需要的地方施肥。

disappear.en: Print encyclopedias did not disappear because content became useless, but because updating paper volumes could not compete with instant revision.
disappear.zh: 纸质百科全书并非因为内容无用而消失，而是因为更新纸质卷册无法与即时修订竞争。

disaster.en: The dam failure became a humanitarian disaster only after warnings from engineers went unheeded for more than a year.
disaster.zh: 只是在工程师的警告被忽视一年多之后，大坝溃决才演变成一场人道主义灾难。

discipline.en: Economics borrows heavily from psychology these days, showing how one discipline can be reshaped by another's methods.
discipline.zh: 如今经济学大量借鉴心理学，显示一门学科可以因另一学科的方法而被重塑。

disclose.en: Listed companies must disclose executive bonuses above a set threshold, under new rules aimed at curbing hidden pay.
disclose.zh: 根据旨在遏制隐性薪酬的新规，上市公司必须披露超过规定门槛的高管奖金。

discourse.en: Political discourse on immigration has coarsened online, where inflammatory posts travel faster than careful analysis.
discourse.zh: 网络上关于移民的政治话语变得粗鄙，煽动性帖子的传播速度快于审慎的分析。

discover.en: Students learn more when they discover principles themselves than when rules are simply handed to them, constructivists argue.
discover.zh: 建构主义者认为，学生自己发现原理时学到的东西多于直接接受现成规则。

discovery.en: The discovery that most stomach ulcers are caused by bacteria overturned decades of medical orthodoxy and eventually won a Nobel Prize.
discovery.zh: 发现大多数胃溃疡由细菌引起，这一成果推翻了数十年的医学定论，并最终获得诺贝尔奖。

discrete.en: Machine-learning models treat language as discrete units, which is partly why they struggle with irony and context.
discrete.zh: 机器学习模型将语言视为离散单元，这也是它们难以理解反语与语境的部分原因。

discriminate.en: Algorithms trained on historical hiring data can discriminate against women even when gender is excluded from the inputs.
discriminate.zh: 用历史招聘数据训练的算法，即使在输入中剔除性别，仍可能歧视女性。

discrimination.en: Laws against discrimination in hiring now explicitly cover decisions made by algorithms, not merely those made by human managers.
discrimination.zh: 针对招聘中歧视行为的法律如今明确涵盖算法作出的决定，而不仅仅是人类管理者作出的决定。

disease.en: Public-health campaigns against the disease succeeded once treatment was offered free of charge in every district clinic.
disease.zh: 一旦每个区级诊所都免费提供治疗，针对该疾病的公共卫生运动就取得了成功。

dismiss.en: Managers who dismiss employee concerns as mere complaining tend to lose their best people within two years.
dismiss.zh: 把员工担忧当作单纯抱怨而不予理会的管理者，往往会在两年内失去最优秀的员工。

disorder.en: Sleep disorders are now linked to a surprising range of conditions, from obesity to impaired memory consolidation.
disorder.zh: 睡眠障碍如今被发现与从肥胖到记忆巩固受损等一系列出人意料的病症相关。

disparity.en: The wage disparity between college graduates and non-graduates has widened even as enrollment rates climb.
disparity.zh: 尽管入学率不断攀升，大学毕业生与非毕业生之间的工资差距仍在扩大。

displacement.en: The displacement of longtime residents by rising rents is gentrification's most visible and most contested consequence.
displacement.zh: 房租上涨导致老居民被迫迁离，这是士绅化最显眼、争议也最大的后果。

display.en: Museums increasingly display artifacts alongside the stories of the communities from which the objects were taken.
display.zh: 博物馆日益将文物与其被掠走社群的故事一同陈列。

dispose.en: Consumers who dispose of electronics carelessly leak heavy metals into soil and groundwater, studies show.
dispose.zh: 研究表明，随意丢弃电子产品的消费者会使重金属渗入土壤和地下水。

dispute.en: The two firms settled their patent dispute out of court, avoiding a trial that analysts expected to last years.
dispute.zh: 两家公司庭外解决了专利纠纷，避免了一场分析人士预计将持续数年的审判。

distance.en: The growing distance between party leaderships and ordinary voters helps explain record levels of abstention.
distance.zh: 政党领导层与普通选民之间日益扩大的距离，有助于解释创纪录的弃权率。

distant.en: Modern telescopes can now observe galaxies so distant that their light set out billions of years before the earth existed.
distant.zh: 现代望远镜如今能观测到如此遥远的星系，其光线在地球存在前数十亿年就已出发。

distinct.en: Although the dialects sound alike to outsiders, linguists identify three distinct grammatical systems within the region.
distinct.zh: 尽管外人听来这些方言十分相似，语言学家却在该地区识别出三套截然不同的语法体系。

distinction.en: The distinction between correlation and causation, though basic to statistics, is routinely ignored in media coverage of research.
distinction.zh: 相关与因果之间的区别虽是统计学的基本常识，却在媒体对研究的报道中经常被忽视。

distinctive.en: The region's distinctive approach to vocational training combines classroom instruction with paid apprenticeships in local firms.
distinctive.zh: 该地区独特的职业培训方式将课堂教学与在当地企业的带薪学徒制结合起来。

distinguish.en: Young doctors learn to distinguish symptoms that need urgent treatment from those that can safely be observed.
distinguish.zh: 年轻医生要学会区分需要紧急处理的症状与可以安全观察的症状。

distort.en: Selective reporting can distort public understanding of science, highlighting dramatic findings while omitting failed replications.
distort.zh: 选择性报道会扭曲公众对科学的理解，突出耸动的发现而略去失败的重复验证。

distribute.en: The trial will distribute the new mosquito nets free of charge to households in the worst-affected districts.
distribute.zh: 该试验将向受灾最严重地区的家庭免费分发新型蚊帐。

district.en: School funding tied to district property values has entrenched inequality, a court found in a landmark ruling.
district.zh: 法院在一项里程碑式裁决中认定，与学区房产价值挂钩的学校经费固化了不平等。

diverge.en: Opinion polls show that urban and rural voters diverge sharply on climate policy, complicating any national consensus.
diverge.zh: 民意调查显示，城乡选民在气候政策上分歧尖锐，使任何全国共识都难以达成。

diverse.en: An analysis of six million publications found that diverse research teams produce more cited papers on average.
diverse.zh: 对六百万篇论文的分析发现，成员多样的研究团队平均产出被引用更多的论文。

diversity.en: Conserving the genetic diversity of wild crop relatives may matter more to food security than expanding farmland.
diversity.zh: 保护野生作物近缘种的遗传多样性，对粮食安全而言可能比扩大耕地面积更重要。

divide.en: The proposal would divide the department into two units, one focused on teaching and the other on research.
divide.zh: 该提案将把该系分为两个单位，一个专注于教学，另一个专注于研究。

dividend.en: The company cut its dividend to fund research, a gamble the market initially punished before rewarding.
dividend.zh: 该公司削减股息以资助研发，这一冒险之举起初遭到市场惩罚，后来才获得回报。

division.en: The company's research division operates with unusual independence, publishing results even when they embarrass the marketing side.
division.zh: 该公司的研发部门拥有非同寻常的独立性，即使研究结果令市场部门难堪也照常发表。

divorce.en: Economists have long studied how unexpected job losses raise the probability of divorce within the following two years.
divorce.zh: 经济学家长期研究意料之外的失业如何提高其后两年内离婚的概率。

document.en: Investigators documented systematic underreporting of emissions across the fleet, using maintenance logs the manufacturer itself kept.
document.zh: 调查人员利用制造商自己留存的维修记录，记录下了整个车队系统性的排放少报行为。

domain.en: Artificial intelligence has spread from computer science into almost every domain of research, from ecology to art history.
domain.zh: 人工智能已从计算机科学扩散到从生态学到艺术史等几乎所有研究领域。

domestic.en: The government prefers domestic production of semiconductors, even though importing them remains far cheaper in the short run.
domestic.zh: 政府更倾向于半导体本土生产，尽管短期内进口仍便宜得多。

dominance.en: The platform's dominance in online advertising is now under formal investigation by competition regulators on three separate continents.
dominance.zh: 该平台在网络广告领域的主导地位目前正受到三大洲竞争监管机构的正式调查。

dominant.en: English remains the dominant language of scientific publishing, which disadvantages researchers who must also translate their findings.
dominant.zh: 英语仍是科学出版界的主导语言，这使那些还需要翻译研究成果的研究者处于不利地位。

dominate.en: Only a handful of firms dominate global grain trading, a level of concentration that deeply worries food-security analysts.
dominate.zh: 只有少数几家公司主导着全球粮食贸易，这种集中程度令粮食安全分析人士深感担忧。

doubt.en: There is little doubt among climatologists that the observed warming is primarily driven by human activity.
doubt.zh: 气候学家几乎无人怀疑，观测到的变暖主要由人类活动驱动。

downtown.en: Cities that taxed downtown parking found commuters shifted to public transport faster than any subsidy program achieved.
downtown.zh: 对市中心停车征税的城市发现，通勤者转向公共交通的速度超过了任何补贴计划的成效。

dozen.en: A dozen well-funded start-ups are racing to commercialize solid-state batteries, but manufacturing challenges remain formidable at industrial scale.
dozen.zh: 十几家资金雄厚的初创公司正竞相将固态电池商业化，但在工业规模上制造挑战依然艰巨。

draft.en: The committee circulated a draft of the new ethics code, inviting comments from faculty before the final vote.
draft.zh: 委员会传阅了新伦理准则的草案，并在最终表决前征求教师们的意见。

drag.en: Bureaucratic approval processes drag on for years, deterring exactly the innovative firms the policy was meant to attract.
drag.zh: 官僚式的审批流程一拖数年，恰恰吓退了该政策本想吸引的创新企业。

drama.en: Legal scholars note that courtroom drama on television shapes public expectations of trials more than actual procedure does.
drama.zh: 法律学者指出，电视上的法庭戏比实际的审判程序更能塑造公众对庭审的期待。

dramatic.en: The dramatic fall in solar-panel prices since 2010 explains most of the growth in renewable electricity generation.
dramatic.zh: 2010年以来太阳能电池板价格的急剧下降，解释了可再生能源发电增长的大部分原因。

draw.en: The report draws on interviews with four hundred nurses to explain why so many leave hospital work within five years.
draw.zh: 该报告基于对四百名护士的访谈，解释了为何如此之多的人在五年内离开医院工作。

drawing.en: Architects now share detailed drawings with clients in virtual reality, letting them walk through unbuilt spaces.
drawing.zh: 建筑师如今通过虚拟现实与客户共享详细的图纸，让他们能够走进尚未建成的空间。

dream.en: What was once a dream of universal vaccination now looks achievable, given manufacturing breakthroughs in mRNA technology.
dream.zh: 鉴于mRNA技术的制造突破，曾经遥不可及的全民接种梦想如今看来可以实现。

drop.en: A sharp drop in student enrollment forced the college to close two dormitories and cut adjunct positions.
drop.zh: 学生入学人数的骤降迫使该学院关闭两栋宿舍并裁减兼任教师岗位。

dropout.en: Early-warning systems flag potential dropouts months before they leave school, giving counselors time to intervene.
dropout.zh: 预警系统会在潜在辍学者离开学校前数月发出提示，为辅导员留出干预时间。

drug.en: The new drug lowers blood pressure effectively, but long-term side effects will not be visible for another decade.
drug.zh: 这种新药能有效降低血压，但长期副作用要到十年后才会显现。

due.en: The report, due next month, is expected to recommend capping rent increases in cities with acute housing shortages.
due.zh: 定于下月发布的报告预计将建议在住房严重短缺的城市限制租金涨幅。

dust.en: Desert dust carried across oceans supplies vital nutrients to Amazon soils, an overlooked ecological connection between continents.
dust.zh: 跨洋输送的沙漠尘埃为亚马逊土壤提供重要养分，这是各大洲之间一条被忽视的生态联系。

duty.en: Courts have ruled that platforms have a duty to remove clearly illegal content promptly, provided free expression is respected.
duty.zh: 法院裁定，平台有义务在尊重言论自由的前提下及时删除明显违法的内容。

eager.en: The region, eager to attract biotech investment, offered tax holidays that critics called an unnecessary giveaway.
eager.zh: 由于急于吸引生物技术投资，该地区提供了批评者称为不必要让利的税收减免期。

earn.en: Nurses in the region earn barely half of what equally trained technicians make abroad, driving sustained emigration.
earn.zh: 该地区护士的收入仅为同等培训水平的技术人员在国外所得的一半左右，导致持续的人才外流。

ease.en: To ease pressure on emergency rooms, the city opened round-the-clock clinics staffed mainly by nurse practitioners.
ease.zh: 为缓解急诊室的压力，该市开设了主要由执业护士值守的24小时诊所。

eastern.en: The eastern provinces recorded the fastest growth in wind-power capacity after the national grid's transmission lines were finally upgraded.
eastern.zh: 在国家电网的输电线路最终完成升级后，东部各省的风电装机增长最快。

echo.en: The minister's speech echoed arguments first made by economists two decades ago, though she never acknowledged the debt.
echo.zh: 部长的讲话呼应了经济学家二十年前率先提出的论点，尽管她从未承认这一渊源。

economic.en: The government's economic forecasts assumed steady growth and stable prices, assumptions contradicted by every indicator published since last spring.
economic.zh: 政府的经济预测假定了增长稳定、物价平稳，而这些假设与去年春天以来发布的每一项指标都相矛盾。

economics.en: Behavioral economics has quietly reshaped policy design, from retirement savings schemes to the wording of organ-donation consent forms.
economics.zh: 行为经济学悄然重塑了政策设计，从退休储蓄计划到器官捐献同意书的措辞皆是如此。

economy.en: Because the service economy now generates most new jobs, vocational policies aimed only at factories miss the target.
economy.zh: 由于服务业经济如今创造了大部分新增就业，只针对工厂的职业政策就偏离了目标。

ecosystem.en: Restoring a damaged wetland ecosystem takes decades, which is why prevention is far cheaper than later repair.
ecosystem.zh: 恢复受损的湿地生态系统需要数十年，这正是预防远比事后修复便宜的原因。

edge.en: The firm keeps its competitive edge by hiring researchers directly from doctoral programs rather than poaching rivals' staff.
edge.zh: 该公司通过直接从博士项目招聘研究人员而非挖角对手员工来保持竞争优势。

edition.en: The latest edition of the handbook adds a chapter on statistical pitfalls that even experienced analysts commit.
edition.zh: 手册最新版增加了一章，论述连资深分析师也会犯的统计陷阱。

editor.en: The editor of the journal apologized for publishing the study, which failed a basic check of its raw data.
editor.zh: 该期刊编辑为发表那项连原始数据的基本核查都未通过的研究而道歉。

educate.en: Campaigns that educate teenagers about credit risk seem to work better when delivered by peers rather than teachers.
educate.zh: 在向青少年普及信贷风险方面，由同龄人而非教师来讲解效果似乎更好。

education.en: Investing in early-childhood education returns more per dollar than almost any later intervention, longitudinal studies suggest.
education.zh: 纵向研究表明，投资幼儿教育每美元的回报几乎高于任何后续干预。

educational.en: Video games once dismissed as distractions are now studied for their educational potential in mathematics and history.
educational.zh: 曾被视为干扰的游戏，如今正因其在数学和历史方面的教育潜力而受到研究。

educator.en: Every educator interviewed agreed that class size matters, though none ranked it the most important factor.
educator.zh: 接受访谈的每位教育工作者都认同班级规模很重要，但没有人把它列为最重要的因素。

effect.en: The policy's effect on employment was smaller than predicted, though its effect on wages was larger.
effect.zh: 该政策对就业的影响小于预期，但对工资的影响却大于预期。

effective.en: Vaccines remain the most effective tool against the virus, even as new variants erode some protection.
effective.zh: 尽管新的变异株削弱了部分保护力，疫苗仍是应对该病毒最有效的手段。

academician.en: The senior academician argued that research funding should favor long-term projects whose benefits cannot be measured within a single budget cycle.
academician.zh: 这位资深院士主张，科研经费应向长期项目倾斜，因为这类项目的效益无法在单个预算周期内衡量。

academy.en: Founded to train gifted children in mathematics, the academy now admits students from every background through a transparent, merit-based selection process.
academy.zh: 这所学院最初为培养数学天才儿童而设立，如今通过透明、择优的选拔程序录取来自各种背景的学生。

accede.en: Reluctant as it was, the committee had little option but to accede to demands for an independent audit of its conference travel spending.
accede.zh: 尽管心有不甘，委员会也别无选择，只能同意对其会议差旅开支进行独立审计的要求。

accel.en: The racing team installed a new accel module that measures how quickly the engine responds when the driver presses the pedal.
accel.zh: 这支赛车队安装了一个新的加速传感模块，用以测量发动机在车手踩下油门时的响应速度。

accelerant.en: Investigators suspected an accelerant had been used because the fire spread far faster than ordinary building materials would allow.
accelerant.zh: 调查人员怀疑现场使用了助燃剂，因为火势蔓延的速度远超普通建筑材料所能达到的程度。

accelerate.en: Unless governments accelerate the transition to renewable energy, climate targets set for the next decade will almost certainly be missed.
accelerate.zh: 除非各国政府加快向可再生能源的转型，否则未来十年设定的气候目标几乎肯定无法实现。

acceleration.en: Economists disagree about whether the sudden acceleration in consumer prices reflects temporary supply disruptions or deeper structural inflation.
acceleration.zh: 对于消费物价的突然加速上涨究竟反映了暂时性供应中断还是更深层的结构性通胀，经济学家意见不一。

accelerator.en: A new startup accelerator in the city offers seed funding and mentoring to graduates who want to turn research into products.
accelerator.zh: 这座城市新成立的创业加速器为想把研究成果转化为产品的毕业生提供种子资金和辅导。

accelerometer.en: A tiny accelerometer inside the smartphone detects sudden movement, allowing the device to switch the display orientation automatically.
accelerometer.zh: 智能手机内的微型加速度计能探测突然的运动，使设备得以自动切换屏幕显示方向。

accent.en: Listeners often judge a foreign accent unfairly, although research shows pronunciation differences rarely affect how accurately a message is understood.
accent.zh: 听者往往对外国口音抱有偏见，尽管研究表明发音差异极少影响信息被理解的准确程度。

accentuate.en: Critics argue that standardized testing tends to accentuate existing inequalities rather than reveal genuine differences in intellectual potential.
accentuate.zh: 批评者认为，标准化考试倾向于加剧既有的不平等，而非揭示智力潜能上的真实差异。

accept.en: Committee members were asked to accept or reject each proposal on its merits, without regard to the applicant's institutional prestige.
accept.zh: 委员会成员被要求仅凭提案本身的价值决定接受与否，而不考虑申请者所属机构的声望。

acceptability.en: Public acceptability, not technical feasibility, ultimately determines whether new energy projects such as wind farms can be built.
acceptability.zh: 最终决定风电场等新能源项目能否建成的，往往不是技术可行性，而是公众接受度。

acceptable.en: Regulators set a maximum noise level and declared only buildings below that threshold acceptable for residential use near the airport.
acceptable.zh: 监管机构设定了最高噪声限值，并规定只有低于该门槛的建筑才适合在机场附近作住宅使用。

acceptably.en: Trial results showed that the new process performed acceptably under laboratory conditions, though engineers cautioned that field tests remain essential.
acceptably.zh: 试验结果表明，新工艺在实验室条件下的表现尚可，但工程师提醒说现场测试仍然必不可少。

acceptance.en: The university's growing acceptance of online credits reflects a broader shift in how employers judge qualifications and practical skills.
acceptance.zh: 这所大学对线上学分日益增长的认可，反映出雇主评判资历与实践能力方式上的更广泛转变。

access.en: Debates over who should have access to advanced genetic screening raise ethical questions that existing legislation has barely begun to address.
access.zh: 关于谁应当有权使用高级基因筛查的争论，提出了现行立法几乎尚未触及的伦理问题。

accessibility.en: Improving the accessibility of public transport benefits not only wheelchair users but also elderly passengers, parents with strollers and tourists.
accessibility.zh: 提升公共交通的无障碍水平不仅惠及轮椅使用者，也惠及老年乘客、推婴儿车的家长和游客。

accessible.en: The panel urged scientists to write in language accessible to ordinary readers, arguing that public trust depends on clear communication.
accessible.zh: 专家小组敦促科学家用普通读者能看懂的语言写作，认为公众信任有赖于清晰的沟通。

accession.en: The country's accession to the trade bloc required rewriting hundreds of domestic regulations to align with common standards.
accession.zh: 该国加入这一贸易集团时，不得不改写数百项国内法规，以与共同标准保持一致。

accessorize.en: Fashion writers suggest that buyers accessorize a plain outfit with one distinctive piece rather than spending heavily on entire ensembles.
accessorize.zh: 时尚撰稿人建议买家只用一件有特色的配饰来装点素净的着装，而不是把大笔开销花在整套行头上。

accessory.en: The court treated the driver as an accessory because he had knowingly transported the stolen goods across two borders.
accessory.zh: 法庭认定这名司机属于从犯，因为他明知是赃物仍将其运过了两道边境。

accident.en: The bridge collapse was no accident but the predictable result of years of deferred maintenance and ignored engineering warnings.
accident.zh: 大桥坍塌绝非意外事故，而是多年疏于维护、无视工程警告所导致的可预见的后果。

accidental.en: Historians emphasize that penicillin's discovery was accidental, yet they also stress that only a prepared mind could have recognized it.
accidental.zh: 历史学家强调青霉素的发现纯属偶然，但他们也指出，唯有有准备的头脑才可能识别出它。

accidentally.en: Archaeologists accidentally uncovered the tomb while digging a drainage ditch, a reminder that chance often shapes major discoveries.
accidentally.zh: 考古学家在挖排水沟时意外发现了那座古墓，这提醒人们偶然性常常左右着重大发现。

accidently.en: Witnesses insisted the chemicals were released accidently during routine maintenance, contradicting earlier reports that the spill had been concealed deliberately.
accidently.zh: 目击者坚称化学品是在例行维护期间意外泄漏的，这与此前所称泄漏系被蓄意隐瞒的说法相矛盾。

acclaim.en: Critics acclaimed the young novelist for depicting immigrant life without sentimentality, and the book soon entered university reading lists.
acclaim.zh: 评论家盛赞这位年轻小说家毫不煽情地刻画了移民生活，这部作品很快便进入了大学的阅读书单。

acclamation.en: The proposal was carried by acclamation, with delegates applauding rather than voting, a sign of rare consensus at the summit.
acclamation.zh: 该提案在欢呼声中获得通过，代表们以鼓掌代替投票，显示出这次峰会罕见的共识。

acclimate.en: Exchange students typically need several weeks to acclimate to a new academic culture, especially seminars that reward public disagreement.
acclimate.zh: 交换生通常需要几周时间才能适应新的学术文化，尤其是那些鼓励公开争论的研讨课。

acclimation.en: Physiologists studying acclimation to high altitude found that mountaineers adapt within weeks, whereas permanent settlers show deeper genetic changes.
acclimation.zh: 研究高原适应的生理学家发现，登山者数周内即可完成适应，而永久定居者则表现出更深层的基因改变。

accolade.en: Winning the industry's highest accolade brought the lab unexpected attention, along with pressure to commercialize its fundamental research.
accolade.zh: 赢得该行业最高荣誉让这间实验室意外受到关注，同时也带来了将基础研究商业化的压力。

accommodate.en: Universities must accommodate a growing number of international students without lowering the quality of teaching or campus services.
accommodate.zh: 高校必须在不降低教学或校园服务质量的前提下，容纳数量不断增长的国际学生。

accommodation.en: Rising rents have made affordable accommodation the single largest expense for students in most major university cities.
accommodation.zh: 房租不断上涨，使负担得起的住宿成为多数主要大学城中学生们最大的一项开支。

accommodative.en: The central bank kept an accommodative stance for another quarter, hoping cheap credit would revive investment without reigniting inflation.
accommodative.zh: 央行又一个季度维持宽松立场，希望低息信贷能提振投资，同时不至于再度引发通胀。

accompaniment.en: The report was published as an accompaniment to the exhibition, offering statistics that the artworks could only suggest.
accompaniment.zh: 这份报告作为展览的配套读物出版，提供了那些艺术作品只能暗示的统计数据。

accompanist.en: A skilled accompanist can rescue a nervous soloist's performance, adjusting tempo within seconds when the singer loses confidence.
accompanist.zh: 一位称职的伴奏者能够挽救紧张的独唱者，在歌手失去自信的数秒内调整节奏。

accompany.en: Economic growth does not automatically accompany technological innovation, as several resource-rich countries have discovered to their cost.
accompany.zh: 经济增长并不必然伴随技术创新而来，几个资源丰富的国家已为此付出代价。

accompli.en: Once the merger became a fait accompli, opponents in the boardroom had little choice but to negotiate the terms of implementation.
accompli.zh: 一旦兼并成为既成事实，董事会中的反对者便别无选择，只能就执行条件进行谈判。

accomplice.en: Prosecutors argued that the accountant was more than an accomplice, since she had designed the scheme that concealed the fraud.
accomplice.zh: 检方指出，这名会计远不止是从犯，因为掩盖欺诈的方案正是她设计的。

accomplish.en: Teams accomplish more when objectives are specific and measurable than when they are urged simply to work harder.
accomplish.zh: 当目标具体且可衡量时，团队的完成度会高于仅仅被要求更加努力工作的情况。

accomplishment.en: Graduating from a difficult program is a genuine accomplishment, but employers increasingly ask what candidates can do rather than what they have endured.
accomplishment.zh: 从严苛的项目毕业是一项真正的成就，但雇主越来越关注候选人能做什么，而非他们曾经历过什么。

accord.en: The peace accord survived because both parties recognized that renewed fighting would destroy the fragile economy neither side could rebuild.
accord.zh: 和平协议得以维系，是因为双方都认识到，重启战事将摧毁任何一方都无法重建的脆弱经济。

accordance.en: In accordance with the new data-protection law, companies must now obtain explicit consent before collecting any personal information.
accordance.zh: 依照新的数据保护法，公司现在必须在收集任何个人信息之前获得明确同意。

according.en: Salaries were distributed according to contribution rather than seniority, a policy that initially provoked protest among long-serving staff.
according.zh: 薪酬按贡献而非资历分配，这一政策起初在资深员工中引发了抗议。

accordingly.en: Consumer habits changed quickly after the price rise, and manufacturers adjusted their production schedules accordingly to avoid unwanted inventory.
accordingly.zh: 涨价之后消费习惯迅速改变，制造商相应调整了生产计划，以免积压库存。

accordion.en: The street musician's accordion drew a small crowd, demonstrating how live performance still competes with streamed entertainment in public spaces.
accordion.zh: 街头艺人的手风琴引来一小群围观者，这表明现场表演在公共空间中仍能与流媒体娱乐一争高下。

accost.en: Charity fundraisers who accost pedestrians outside stations raise money effectively, but the aggressive approach damages the organizations' public image.
accost.zh: 在车站外向行人搭话募捐的慈善筹款者筹款效率很高，但咄咄逼人的方式损害了这些组织的公众形象。

account.en: Imports account for nearly half of the country's energy consumption, a dependence that shapes every debate about national security.
account.zh: 进口占该国能源消费的近一半，这种依赖左右着关于国家安全的每一场辩论。

accountability.en: Requiring senior officials to publish their expenses strengthened accountability, though critics argue that real oversight requires independent auditors.
accountability.zh: 要求高级官员公开个人开支增强了问责，但批评者认为真正的监督还需要独立的审计机构。

accountable.en: Public services improve when managers are held accountable for measurable outcomes rather than for compliance with procedures.
accountable.zh: 当管理者以可衡量的成果而非程序合规接受问责时，公共服务就会改善。

accountancy.en: Automation is reshaping accountancy because software now performs routine audits that once occupied entire departments of junior clerks.
accountancy.zh: 自动化正在重塑会计行业，因为软件如今承担了曾经由大批初级职员负责的日常审计工作。

accountant.en: A careful accountant discovered the discrepancy that auditors had missed for years, proving that skepticism matters more than sophisticated tools.
accountant.zh: 一位细心的会计师发现了审计人员多年来漏掉的那笔差额，证明怀疑精神比精密工具更重要。

accouterment.en: For the explorer, each accouterment of the trade, from compass to boots, carried decades of accumulated field experience.
accouterment.zh: 对这位探险家而言，从罗盘到靴子，这一行的每一件装备都承载着数十年积累的野外经验。

accoutrement.en: Critics dismissed the designer's latest accoutrement as marketing rather than innovation, noting that its core function was unchanged.
accoutrement.zh: 批评者讥讽这位设计师的最新配饰只是营销噱头而非创新，指出其核心功能并无变化。

accredit.en: The ministry will accredit only training providers whose graduates pass an independent examination at rates above the national average.
accredit.zh: 教育部将只认可那些毕业生独立考试通过率高于全国平均水平的培训机构。

accreditation.en: Loss of accreditation forced the small college to close, leaving students to transfer credits under emergency arrangements.
accreditation.zh: 失去认证迫使这所小型学院停办，学生们只能在紧急安排下转办学分。

accreted.en: Over millennia the river delta accreted layer upon layer of sediment, gradually building fertile land where the sea once reached.
accreted.zh: 数千年来，河流三角洲一层层淤积泥沙，逐渐在昔日海水所及之处造出沃土。

accretion.en: Astronomers observed the accretion of gas around the young star, a process that eventually forms planets from leftover material.
accretion.zh: 天文学家观测到年轻恒星周围气体的吸积过程，这一过程最终会由残余物质形成行星。

accrual.en: Accounting rules require the accrual of interest income in the period it is earned, not when the cash finally arrives.
accrual.zh: 会计准则要求利息收入在其赚取的当期计提，而不是等到现金实际到账之时。

accrue.en: Benefits from early childhood education accrue over decades, appearing first in school results and later in employment and health.
accrue.zh: 幼儿教育的收益在数十年间逐步累积，最先体现在学业成绩上，随后体现在就业与健康方面。

accumulate.en: Households accumulate wealth most reliably through regular saving, yet stagnant wages have made that habit harder for younger workers.
accumulate.zh: 家庭靠定期储蓄积累财富最为可靠，然而工资停滞已让年轻劳动者更难养成这一习惯。

accumulation.en: The accumulation of plastic waste in the oceans has shifted from a local nuisance to a global ecological problem.
accumulation.zh: 海洋中塑料垃圾的积聚已从局部滋扰演变为全球性生态问题。

accumulative.en: Environmental damage is often accumulative, each year's pollution seeming minor until the total burden crosses a critical threshold.
accumulative.zh: 环境破坏往往具有累积性，每一年的污染看似轻微，直到总负担越过临界阈值。

accumulatively.en: Small errors compound accumulatively in long calculations, which is why numerical analysts insist on rigorous checks at every stage.
accumulatively.zh: 微小误差会在冗长计算中累积放大，这就是数值分析专家坚持在每个阶段严格校验的原因。

accumulator.en: In older vehicles the hydraulic accumulator stored pressure that allowed brakes to function even if the engine failed.
accumulator.zh: 在较老的车辆中，液压蓄能器储存压力，使发动机失灵时制动系统仍能工作。

accuracy.en: Doctors increasingly rely on algorithms, yet few patients understand how accuracy is measured before such tools enter clinical use.
accuracy.zh: 医生越来越依赖算法，但几乎没有患者了解此类工具进入临床之前其准确性是如何测定的。

accurate.en: Weather models are now accurate enough to warn of flash floods hours in advance, saving lives in vulnerable mountain regions.
accurate.zh: 如今的气象模型已精确到能提前数小时预警山洪，在易受灾的山区挽救了生命。

accurately.en: Economists concede that they cannot accurately predict recessions, but they argue that identifying risks early still has practical value.
accurately.zh: 经济学家承认无法精准预测衰退，但他们认为尽早识别风险仍具有现实价值。

accursed.en: In the memoir, the author describes poverty as an accursed inheritance, passed down when no other legacy is available.
accursed.zh: 在回忆录中，作者把贫困描述为一种可诅咒的遗产，在别无传承时代代相传。

accusation.en: The accusation that the lab fabricated its data was withdrawn after independent teams reproduced the results three times.
accusation.zh: 指控该实验室伪造数据的说法已被撤回，因为独立团队三次重复出了同样的结果。

accusative.en: Latin students learn that the accusative case marks the direct object, a distinction English conveys mainly through word order.
accusative.zh: 拉丁语学生要学习宾格标记直接宾语，而英语主要靠语序来传达这一区别。

accusatory.en: An accusatory tone rarely persuades skeptics; teachers achieve more by inviting students to test the evidence for themselves.
accusatory.zh: 指责的口吻很难说服怀疑者；教师邀请学生亲自检验证据，反而更有成效。

accuse.en: It is easy to accuse regulators of negligence after a disaster, yet hindsight makes every past decision look careless.
accuse.zh: 灾难发生后指责监管者玩忽职守固然容易，但事后聪明会让过去的每个决定都显得草率。

accuser.en: Defense lawyers argued that the sole accuser had changed central details of the story between the first and second interviews.
accuser.zh: 辩护律师指出，唯一的指控者在第一次与第二次面谈之间改变了案件的关键细节。

accusingly.en: The manager looked accusingly at the shrunken budget spreadsheet, though the shortfall traced back to cuts she herself had endorsed.
accusingly.zh: 经理用责备的目光盯着缩水的预算表格，尽管缺口恰恰源于她本人支持的削减方案。

accustom.en: Military training aims to accustom recruits to making rapid decisions under conditions of uncertainty and incomplete information.
accustom.zh: 军事训练旨在让新兵习惯在信息不完整、结果不确定的条件下迅速做出决策。

acerbic.en: The columnist's acerbic style wins loyal readers, yet editors worry that sarcasm sometimes obscures the sound reasoning beneath.
acerbic.zh: 这位专栏作家尖刻的文风赢得了忠实读者，但编辑担心讽刺有时会掩盖其下严密的论证。

acetate.en: Photographic film was once coated with cellulose acetate, a material whose slow decay now threatens entire film archives.
acetate.zh: 摄影胶片曾以醋酸纤维素为涂层，这种材料的缓慢老化如今正威胁着整座整座的影片档案馆。

acetone.en: Laboratory technicians use acetone to clean glassware, but its flammability requires storage well away from open flames.
acetone.zh: 实验室技术人员用丙酮清洗玻璃器皿，但由于其易燃性，存放必须远离明火。

achievable.en: Breaking an ambitious emissions target into achievable annual steps makes progress visible and helps sustain public support.
achievable.zh: 把雄心勃勃的减排目标分解为切实可行的年度步骤，能让进展清晰可见，有助于维系公众支持。

achieve.en: Students achieve more when teachers explain the purpose of an exercise than when they simply assign it as routine practice.
achieve.zh: 当教师讲清练习的用意时，学生的表现会好于练习被当作例行公事布置下去的情况。

achievement.en: Landing the probe on the comet was a remarkable achievement, yet its scientific payoff came from the instruments' decade-long data stream.
achievement.zh: 将探测器送上彗星是一项了不起的成就，但其科学回报更多来自仪器长达十年的数据流。

achiever.en: Every high achiever profiled in the study had access to mentors during adolescence, suggesting talent grows best with guidance.
achiever.zh: 研究中每一位事业有成者都曾在青春期获得导师的指点，这提示才能在引导下成长得最好。

achingly.en: The film's landscape shots are achingly beautiful, but critics argued that the plot never rises to match the imagery.
achingly.zh: 影片的风景镜头美得令人心碎，但评论者认为情节始终未能与画面相称。

acid.en: Decades of sulfur emissions produced acid rain that destroyed forests across the region until strict scrubber requirements reversed the damage.
acid.zh: 数十年的硫排放曾形成酸雨，摧毁了该地区的大片森林，直到严格的洗涤塔排放要求才扭转了损害。

acidic.en: The lake became so acidic after decades of industrial discharge that only acid-tolerant algae could survive in its waters.
acidic.zh: 经年累月的工业排放使湖水酸化到只剩耐酸的藻类还能在其水域中存活。

acidification.en: Ocean acidification threatens shellfish in particular, because dissolving carbon dioxide makes it harder for larvae to build shells.
acidification.zh: 海洋酸化对贝类威胁尤甚，因为二氧化碳溶解后会使幼虫更难构建贝壳。

acidify.en: Excess nitrogen fertilizer can acidify farmland over time, gradually releasing aluminum that damages crop roots.
acidify.zh: 过量施用氮肥会日渐酸化农田，逐渐释放出损害作物根系的铝。

acidity.en: Winemakers monitor the acidity of grapes closely, since it determines both the fermentation process and the final taste.
acidity.zh: 酿酒师密切监测葡萄的酸度，因为它同时决定发酵过程与成酒的风味。

acidly.en: The veteran engineer remarked acidly that every generation rediscovers the same design flaws under a fashionable new name.
acidly.zh: 老工程师不无刻薄地说，每一代人都会以时髦的新名义重新发现同样的设计缺陷。

acknowledge.en: Scholars must acknowledge every source they draw on, both as a matter of honesty and to let readers verify claims.
acknowledge.zh: 学者必须注明所借鉴的每一处资料来源，这既是诚实的要求，也让读者得以核查论断。

acknowledgment.en: The report's acknowledgment of sampling limitations gave critics little room to attack its central conclusions.
acknowledgment.zh: 报告对抽样局限的坦承，让批评者几乎找不到攻击其核心结论的余地。

acme.en: Historians consider the twelfth century the acme of the region's cathedral building, when craft guilds reached unmatched technical skill.
acme.zh: 历史学家认为十二世纪是该地区大教堂建造的鼎盛期，彼时行会工匠的技艺无与伦比。

acolyte.en: The professor's former acolyte later overturned several of his theories, illustrating how scientific loyalty gives way to evidence.
acolyte.zh: 这位教授昔日的追随者后来推翻了他的几个理论，说明科学中的忠诚终将让位于证据。

acoustic.en: Concert hall designers spent two years refining the acoustic properties of the ceiling, testing every surface with scaled models.
acoustic.zh: 音乐厅设计者花了两年时间打磨天花板的声学特性，用缩比模型逐一测试每个表面。

acoustical.en: The building's acoustical insulation was upgraded after residents complained that conference noise carried into the neighboring apartments.
acoustical.zh: 在居民投诉会议噪声传入相邻公寓之后，大楼升级了隔声构造。

acoustically.en: Because the vaulted hall is acoustically live, even a whispered conversation near the entrance can be heard at the far end.
acoustically.zh: 由于这座拱顶大厅声学反响很强，就连入口处的一声耳语也能传到大厅另一头。

acquaint.en: Orientation weeks are designed to acquaint new students with library resources they rarely discover until assignments demand them.
acquaint.zh: 迎新周的目的在于让新生熟悉图书馆资源，而他们往往要到作业逼人时才发现这些资源。

acquaintance.en: A passing acquaintance with statistics is no longer optional for journalists who report on polls and medical studies.
acquaintance.zh: 对统计学略知皮毛，对于报道民意调查和医学研究的记者而言已不再是可有可无的技能。

acquiesce.en: Union leaders refused to acquiesce in the plant closure, arguing that the company had never seriously considered alternatives.
acquiesce.zh: 工会领袖拒绝默许关闭工厂，理由是公司从未认真考虑过其他替代方案。

acquiescence.en: The study links civic apathy to quiet acquiescence, showing that citizens rarely oppose policies they believe they cannot change.
acquiescence.zh: 该研究将公民的冷漠与无声的默许联系起来，表明人们很少反对自认为无力改变的政策。

acquiescent.en: An acquiescent press corps failed to question official casualty figures, a lapse the commission's report singled out for criticism.
acquiescent.zh: 一味顺从的记者群体未能质疑官方伤亡数字，委员会报告特别点名批评了这一失职。

acquire.en: Children acquire their first language effortlessly, yet adults studying a second language must often rely on explicit instruction.
acquire.zh: 儿童能毫不费力地习得母语，而学习第二语言的成年人往往得依赖明确的讲授。

acquirer.en: In hostile takeovers, the acquirer typically offers shareholders a premium well above the market price to win control quickly.
acquirer.zh: 在敌意收购中，收购方通常会向股东报出远高于市价的溢价，以便迅速夺得控制权。

acquisition.en: Language acquisition research shows that immersion combined with structured feedback outperforms grammar drills and vocabulary memorization alone.
acquisition.zh: 语言习得研究表明，沉浸式学习结合有结构的反馈，效果优于单纯的语法操练与词汇背诵。

acquisitive.en: Critics portray the media group as acquisitive, noting that it has bought seventeen competitors while cutting local newsrooms.
acquisitive.zh: 批评者指责这个传媒集团贪得无厌，指出它已收购十七家竞争对手，同时削减地方新闻编辑室。

acquit.en: Appeals courts acquit defendants far more often when the original trial relied on testimony that later forensic methods discredited.
acquit.zh: 当原审过度依赖后来被新法证技术推翻的证词时，上诉法院宣告被告无罪的概率要高得多。

acquittal.en: The acquittal triggered nationwide protests and renewed debate about standards of proof in cases involving police conduct.
acquittal.zh: 无罪判决引发了全国范围的抗议，并重新点燃了关于涉警案件中证明标准的辩论。

acquitted.en: The scientist was acquitted of fraud charges after the court found that honest error, not fabrication, explained the anomalies.
acquitted.zh: 那名科学家被判欺诈罪名不成立，法院认定数据中的异常源于诚实的失误而非编造。

acquitting.en: The judge, acquitting the student of plagiarism, warned that paraphrasing without citation still comes dangerously close to the line.
acquitting.zh: 法官宣判该学生剽窃罪名不成立，同时警告说，不加引注地转述他人观点已游走在危险边缘。

acreage.en: The subsidy rewards farmers who convert acreage to wildflower habitat, a policy credited with slowing the decline of bees.
acreage.zh: 这项补贴奖励把耕地改为野花栖息地的农户，该政策被认为减缓了蜜蜂种群的衰退。

adrenalin.en: The surge of adrenalin that students experience before a major examination can sharpen concentration, though prolonged stress eventually impairs memory and judgment.
adrenalin.zh: 学生在重大考试前肾上腺素的激增能提高专注力，但长期压力最终会损害记忆与判断力。

adrenaline.en: Medical researchers note that repeated doses of adrenaline given during cardiac emergencies must be carefully timed, since excessive stimulation may damage heart tissue.
adrenaline.zh: 医学研究者指出，在心脏紧急救治期间反复注射肾上腺素必须严格把握时机，因为过度刺激可能损伤心脏组织。

adrift.en: After the factory closed, the whole town seemed adrift, its young workers leaving in search of opportunities that no longer existed at home.
adrift.zh: 工厂关闭后，整座小镇仿佛随波逐流失去了方向，年轻工人纷纷外出寻找家乡已不复存在的机会。

adroit.en: An adroit negotiator knows when to concede minor points, preserving goodwill while securing the terms that matter most to the client.
adroit.zh: 灵巧的谈判者懂得何时在次要问题上让步，在保住善意的同时争取对客户最为重要的条款。

adroitly.en: Skilled diplomats move adroitly between competing interests, framing compromises so that each side can present the outcome as a victory at home.
adroitly.zh: 老练的外交官在相互竞争的利益之间灵活周旋，把妥协表述得让各方都能在国内宣称为胜利。

adulate.en: Critics warn that talk shows adulate celebrities so habitually that audiences lose the ability to distinguish genuine achievement from carefully managed publicity.
adulate.zh: 评论人士警告，脱口秀节目习惯性地吹捧名人，致使观众丧失了辨别真实成就与精心包装宣传的能力。

adulation.en: The philosopher cautioned that public adulation, however flattering, corrodes independent judgment and teaches leaders to value applause over honest counsel.
adulation.zh: 这位哲学家告诫说，公众的吹捧无论多么动听，都会侵蚀独立判断，并教会领导者把掌声看得比忠言更重。

adult.en: Sociologists observe that the transition to adult responsibilities now occurs later than in previous generations, delaying marriage, homeownership and career stability.
adult.zh: 社会学家观察到，如今人们承担起成年人责任的时间比前几代人更晚，结婚、购房和职业稳定期都随之推迟。

adulterate.en: Inspectors discovered that some suppliers adulterate olive oil with cheaper seed oils, deceiving consumers who pay premium prices for authenticity.
adulterate.zh: 检查人员发现，一些供应商在橄榄油中掺入较便宜的种子油，欺骗为正宗品质支付高价的消费者。

adulteration.en: Historians note that Parliament first regulated bread adulteration in the nineteenth century, when chalk and alum were routinely mixed into flour.
adulteration.zh: 历史学家指出，议会在十九世纪就率先立法管制面包掺假，当时面粉中常被混入白垩和明矾。

adulterer.en: In many classical novels the adulterer faces social ruin rather than legal punishment, revealing how communities once policed private morality.
adulterer.zh: 在许多古典小说中，通奸者面对的是社会性毁灭而非法律惩罚，这揭示了昔日共同体如何监管私人道德。

adulterous.en: Sociological surveys show that adulterous relationships are cited in roughly a third of divorce cases, though causation is difficult to establish.
adulterous.zh: 社会学调查显示，约三分之一的离婚案件涉及婚外情关系，不过其中的因果关系很难确立。

adultery.en: Under the kingdom's revised family law, adultery remains grounds for divorce, yet the courts now require documented evidence rather than rumor.
adultery.zh: 根据该国修订后的家庭法，通奸仍是离婚的法定理由，但法院如今要求提供书面证据而非道听途说。

adulthood.en: Psychologists argue that prolonged adolescence reflects economic realities, since rising housing costs keep many young people financially dependent well into adulthood.
adulthood.zh: 心理学家认为，青春期的延长反映了经济现实：不断上涨的住房成本使许多年轻人步入成年后仍在经济上依赖父母。

advance.en: The committee voted to advance the proposal to the full parliament, where members will debate its fiscal implications next month.
advance.zh: 委员会投票决定将该提案推进至议会全体会议，议员们将于下月就其财政影响展开辩论。

advanced.en: Countries with advanced manufacturing sectors weathered the recent downturn better, because high-value exports are less sensitive to price competition.
advanced.zh: 制造业发达的国家更平稳地度过了近期的经济低迷，因为高附加值出口对价格竞争的敏感度较低。

advancement.en: Her advancement from junior analyst to department director within four years surprised colleagues who had doubted the firm's merit-based promotions.
advancement.zh: 她在四年内从初级分析师晋升为部门主管，这让曾怀疑公司晋升是否唯才是举的同事颇感意外。

advancer.en: Among yesterday's market movers, the biggest advancer was a semiconductor firm whose quarterly earnings far exceeded analyst expectations.
advancer.zh: 在昨日的市场动向中，涨幅最大的个股是一家半导体公司，其季度盈利远超分析师预期。

advantage.en: Early adoption of renewable energy gives manufacturing regions a competitive advantage, since stable power costs attract investment from global firms.
advantage.zh: 率先采用可再生能源使制造业地区获得了竞争优势，因为稳定的电力成本能吸引全球企业的投资。

advantageous.en: For students planning careers in research, mastering statistical software early is clearly advantageous, because most laboratory work now depends on quantitative analysis.
advantageous.zh: 对计划从事研究工作的学生而言，尽早掌握统计软件显然是有利的，因为如今的实验室工作大多依赖定量分析。

advent.en: With the advent of streaming platforms, record companies have shifted their revenue models from album sales to licensing and live performances.
advent.zh: 随着流媒体平台的出现，唱片公司已把收入模式从专辑销售转向版权授权与现场演出。

adventure.en: Travel writing once celebrated adventure in unmapped territories, whereas contemporary accounts increasingly explore the psychological risks of isolation and cultural dislocation.
adventure.zh: 旧时的游记讴歌在未经测绘的地域中冒险，而当代游记作品则越来越多地探讨孤独与文化错位带来的心理风险。

adventurer.en: The nineteenth-century adventurer recorded his journeys in vivid detail, providing later scholars with rare descriptions of societies then closed to outsiders.
adventurer.zh: 这位十九世纪的冒险家以生动的笔触记录旅程，为后来的学者留下了对当时对外封闭社会的珍贵描述。

adventuresome.en: Investment analysts describe the young firm's adventuresome expansion into three foreign markets as bold, though they question whether management can sustain such rapid growth.
adventuresome.zh: 投资分析师认为这家年轻公司进军三个海外市场的冒险式扩张颇具魄力，但质疑管理层能否维持如此快速的增长。

adventurism.en: Historians blame the empire's eventual collapse partly on overseas adventurism, which drained the treasury while neglecting domestic infrastructure.
adventurism.zh: 历史学家将帝国的最终覆灭部分归咎于海外冒险主义，它耗尽了国库，却忽视了国内的基础设施。

adventurous.en: Educational researchers find that adventurous readers who explore unfamiliar genres tend to develop stronger vocabulary and sharper critical thinking skills.
adventurous.zh: 教育研究者发现，乐于探索陌生文体的爱冒险型读者往往能积累更丰富的词汇并形成更敏锐的批判性思维。

adverb.en: Linguists note that misplacing an adverb is among the most frequent errors in examinations, often subtly changing what a sentence actually claims.
adverb.zh: 语言学家指出，副词位置摆放不当是考试中最常见的错误之一，往往会微妙地改变句子实际表达的意思。

adverbial.en: Grammar textbooks classify adverbial phrases by function, distinguishing time expressions from those indicating manner, degree or the speaker's attitude.
adverbial.zh: 语法教科书按功能对状语短语进行分类，把时间表达与表示方式、程度或说话人态度的表达区分开来。

adversarial.en: The adversarial style of parliamentary debate produces memorable soundbites, yet researchers find it discourages the cautious consensus-building that complex policy requires.
adversarial.zh: 议会辩论的对抗性风格制造出令人印象深刻的金句，但研究者发现它不利于复杂政策所需的审慎共识构建。

adversary.en: In chess, a patient player studies the adversary's previous games, searching for habitual weaknesses that can be exploited under pressure.
adversary.zh: 在国际象棋中，有耐心的棋手会研究对手以往的棋局，寻找可以在压力之下加以利用的习惯性弱点。

adverse.en: Farmers in drought regions report that adverse weather now arrives more unpredictably, complicating planting schedules that generations relied upon.
adverse.zh: 干旱地区的农民反映，不利天气如今来得愈发难以预测，令世代沿袭的播种安排难以照旧执行。

adversely.en: Economists warn that sudden tariff increases could adversely affect small exporters, who lack the reserves to survive prolonged trade disputes.
adversely.zh: 经济学家警告，关税突然上调可能对小出口商造成不利影响，因为它们缺乏撑过长期贸易争端的储备。

adversity.en: Biographies of distinguished scientists often emphasize how early adversity, including poverty and discrimination, shaped their persistence rather than deterring it.
adversity.zh: 杰出科学家的传记常常强调，早年包括贫困与歧视在内的逆境如何磨砺了他们的坚韧，而非将其扼杀。

advertise.en: Universities increasingly advertise graduate programs on social media, targeting precisely the demographics that traditional brochures rarely reached.
advertise.zh: 大学越来越多地在社交媒体上为研究生课程做广告，精准瞄准传统宣传册几乎无法触及的人群。

advertisement.en: A single misleading advertisement can cost a company years of consumer trust, which explains why firms now vet marketing claims so carefully.
advertisement.zh: 一则误导性广告就可能让公司付出多年消费者信任的代价，这解释了企业如今为何如此严格地审核营销说辞。

advertiser.en: When a scandal breaks, the advertiser faces a dilemma: withdraw support from the program or risk association with the controversy.
advertiser.zh: 一旦丑闻爆发，广告主便面临两难抉择：要么撤回对该节目的赞助，要么冒着与争议牵连的风险。

advertorial.en: Media watchdogs criticize the advertorial format because paid content is designed to resemble independent journalism, blurring the line between reporting and promotion.
advertorial.zh: 媒体监督机构批评软文形式，因为付费内容被刻意设计得像独立新闻报道，模糊了报道与推广之间的界限。

advice.en: Financial regulators urge consumers to seek independent advice before purchasing complex investment products whose fees are not immediately transparent.
advice.zh: 金融监管机构敦促消费者在购买费用不透明的复杂投资产品之前，先征求独立的专业建议。

advisability.en: The board questioned the advisability of entering the crowded smartphone market, where dominant competitors could easily absorb price wars.
advisability.zh: 董事会质疑进入拥挤的智能手机市场是否明智，因为占主导地位的竞争者可以轻松打得起价格战。

advisable.en: Doctors consider it advisable for travelers to consult clinics several weeks before departure, since some vaccinations require time to take effect.
advisable.zh: 医生认为旅行者宜在出发前数周前往诊所咨询，因为有些疫苗接种需要时间才能生效。

advise.en: Economists advise governments against raising interest rates too quickly, since abrupt tightening can trigger recessions that prove costlier than inflation itself.
advise.zh: 经济学家建议政府不要过快提高利率，因为骤然紧缩可能引发衰退，其代价可能比通货膨胀本身更高。

advisedly.en: The minister chose her words advisedly during the press conference, aware that a single phrase could move currency markets within minutes.
advisedly.zh: 这位部长在记者会上字斟句酌，深知一句话就可能在几分钟内引发外汇市场波动。

advisement.en: The judge took the sentencing recommendation under advisement, requesting additional psychiatric reports before announcing a final decision.
advisement.zh: 法官将对量刑建议加以慎重考虑，并要求补充精神病学报告后方才宣布最终裁决。

adviser.en: A trusted adviser once told the president that unpopular decisions require explanation twice as thorough as popular ones.
adviser.zh: 一位受信任的顾问曾告诉总统，不受欢迎的决策所需要的解释必须比受欢迎的决策详尽一倍。

advisor.en: Each doctoral candidate is assigned an advisor whose approval is required at every stage, from proposal defense to final submission.
advisor.zh: 每位博士生的每个阶段——从开题答辩到最终提交——都必须获得其导师的批准。

advisory.en: The travel advisory warned citizens about political unrest abroad, urging them to register with the embassy before departure.
advisory.zh: 旅行警告提醒公民注意国外的政治动荡，敦促他们出发前在使馆登记备案。

advocacy.en: Public advocacy by patient organizations has accelerated funding for rare disease research, areas that pharmaceutical companies once considered commercially unattractive.
advocacy.zh: 患者组织开展的公共倡导加速了对罕见病研究的资助，而制药公司一度认为该领域缺乏商业吸引力。

advocate.en: Scholars who advocate open access publishing argue that publicly funded research should be freely available to the taxpayers who financed it.
advocate.zh: 提倡开放获取出版的学者主张，由公共资金资助的研究应当无偿提供给为其出资的纳税人。

advocation.en: The professor's advocation of interdisciplinary teaching gradually reshaped the curriculum, though colleagues initially dismissed the idea as impractical.
advocation.zh: 这位教授对跨学科教学的大力拥护逐渐重塑了课程体系，尽管同事们起初认为这一想法不切实际。

affair.en: The finance ministry called the currency fluctuation an internal affair, rejecting foreign criticism of its intervention in exchange markets.
affair.zh: 财政部称此次汇率波动属于内部事务，拒绝外界对其干预外汇市场的批评。

affect.en: Studies of remote work show that commuting time affects productivity less than the quality of management and the design of tasks.
affect.zh: 关于远程办公的研究表明，通勤时间对生产力的影响小于管理质量与任务设计所带来的影响。

afford.en: Housing economists calculate that typical young workers cannot afford rentals in major cities without spending more than half their income on housing.
afford.zh: 住房经济学家测算，普通年轻劳动者若不把收入的一半以上用于住房，就无法负担大城市的房租。

against.en: Public opinion turned against the proposed highway when engineers admitted that construction would destroy the valley's only wetland reserve.
against.zh: 当工程师承认公路建设将摧毁河谷唯一的湿地保护区后，公众舆论转而反对这项拟议工程。

agency.en: The environmental agency published satellite data showing illegal deforestation, compelling regional governments to enforce protections they had previously ignored.
agency.zh: 环保机构公布了显示非法毁林的卫星数据，迫使此前一直忽视相关规定的地方政府加强执法。

agenda.en: Critics claimed the media outlet pursued a hidden agenda, emphasizing stories that supported its owner's commercial and political interests.
agenda.zh: 批评者指称这家媒体另有一套隐秘议程，刻意突出支持其所有者商业与政治利益的报道。

agent.en: In real estate transactions the agent represents the seller, so buyers are advised to commission independent surveys before finalizing any purchase.
agent.zh: 在房地产交易中，经纪人代表卖方行事，因此建议买家在敲定任何购买之前委托独立机构进行房屋查验。

aggressive.en: The startup's aggressive marketing captured market share quickly, but analysts questioned whether such heavy losses were sustainable beyond two years.
aggressive.zh: 这家初创企业激进的营销迅速抢占了市场份额，但分析师质疑如此巨大的亏损能否持续两年以上。

aid.en: International aid to developing countries increasingly comes with conditions, requiring recipients to publish budgets and accept independent audits.
aid.zh: 向发展中国家提供的国际援助越来越附带条件，要求受援方公开预算并接受独立审计。

aim.en: The stated aim of the literacy campaign is to halve adult illiteracy within a decade through community classes and radio instruction.
aim.zh: 这场扫盲运动的既定目标是通过社区课堂和广播教学，在十年内将成人文盲率减半。

aircraft.en: Regulators grounded the aircraft fleet after inspectors discovered fatigue cracks in a component common to all models of the airliner.
aircraft.zh: 检查人员在这款客机所有机型共用的部件上发现疲劳裂纹后，监管机构随即停飞了整个机队。

airline.en: When the airline filed for bankruptcy, thousands of passengers faced canceled routes, illustrating how fragile liberalized aviation markets can be.
airline.zh: 该航空公司申请破产后，成千上万的乘客面临航线取消，这表明自由化的航空市场可能相当脆弱。

album.en: Streaming services report that an album released exclusively online reaches more listeners in one week than physical copies sold in a year.
album.zh: 流媒体平台报告称，一张仅在线发行的专辑一周内触达的听众，比实体唱片一年售出的还要多。

alcohol.en: Epidemiologists link moderate alcohol consumption studies to flawed methodology, noting that abstainers in control groups often include former heavy drinkers.
alcohol.zh: 流行病学家指出，关于适度饮酒的研究存在方法学缺陷，因为对照组中的戒酒者往往包括曾经的酗酒者。

alive.en: Oral traditions keep ancient epics alive, transmitting values across generations even where written records from the same period are scarce.
alive.zh: 口头传统让古代史诗保持活力，即便在同一时期书面记录稀少的情况下，也能把价值观代代相传。

alliance.en: The two technology firms formed an alliance to develop charging standards, hoping a shared format would accelerate consumer adoption.
alliance.zh: 这两家科技企业结成联盟共同制定充电标准，希望统一规格能加快消费者的采用速度。

allow.en: New regulations allow employees to request flexible hours, but employers may refuse on documented operational grounds within one month.
allow.zh: 新法规允许员工申请弹性工作时间，但雇主可在一个月内以有书面记录的运营理由予以拒绝。

ally.en: A reliable trading ally is valuable precisely because alliances built on shared interests survive political changes better than friendships do.
ally.zh: 可靠的贸易盟友之所以可贵，正是因为建立在共同利益之上的联盟比私人情谊更能经受政治变动。

alone.en: Investigators concluded that human error alone could not explain the accident, pointing to systemic failures in maintenance scheduling and oversight.
alone.zh: 调查人员断定，仅凭人为失误无法解释这起事故，维保安排与监管体系中的系统性缺陷才是深层原因。

alter.en: Neuroscientists found that even brief sleep deprivation can alter decision making, biasing people toward riskier choices with delayed consequences.
alter.zh: 神经科学家发现，哪怕是短暂的睡眠剥夺也会改变决策方式，使人们更倾向于选择后果延后的高风险方案。

alternative.en: Cities searching for an alternative to private cars have expanded bicycle lanes, reporting measurable drops in both congestion and air pollution.
alternative.zh: 寻求私家车替代方案的城市扩建了自行车道，交通拥堵和空气污染均出现了可测量的下降。

although.en: The committee approved the budget although several members questioned the projected savings, which depended on untested efficiency assumptions.
although.zh: 委员会批准了该预算，尽管有几位成员质疑预计的节约成效，因为其依赖于未经检验的效率假设。
