facilitate.en: Digital platforms can facilitate communication between researchers in different countries, yet they also raise concerns about data ownership and academic freedom.
facilitate.zh: 数字平台能够促进不同国家研究者之间的交流，但也引发了对数据所有权和学术自由的担忧。

facilitation.en: Effective facilitation of group discussion requires the moderator to remain neutral while ensuring that quieter participants are given genuine opportunities to contribute.
facilitation.zh: 有效地促进小组讨论，要求主持人保持中立，同时确保较为沉默的参与者获得真正的发言机会。

facility.en: The university invested heavily in a new laboratory facility, betting that modern equipment would help it recruit top scientists from abroad.
facility.zh: 该大学斥巨资新建了一处实验设施，指望现代化设备能帮助它从海外招募顶尖科学家。

fact.en: Policy debates often stall because each side selects only the facts that support its case, a tendency psychologists describe as confirmation bias.
fact.zh: 政策辩论常常陷入僵局，因为各方只挑选支持自身立场的事实，心理学家将这种倾向描述为确认偏误。

factor.en: Researchers identified parental involvement as the single most influential factor in explaining differences in achievement among students from comparable socioeconomic backgrounds.
factor.zh: 研究人员发现，家长参与是解释社会经济背景相近的学生之间成绩差异的最具影响力的因素。

faculty.en: When the faculty voted to revise the core curriculum, several senior professors argued that more elective courses would dilute academic rigor.
faculty.zh: 当全体教员投票修订核心课程时，几位资深教授认为增加选修课会削弱学术的严谨性。

fade.en: Support for the reform surged after its launch but began to fade once voters realized the measure would require higher local taxes.
fade.zh: 改革启动后支持率一度飙升，但当选民意识到该措施需要提高地方税收时，支持便开始消退。

failure.en: The report attributes the project's failure not to technical problems but to the management's unwillingness to consult experienced engineers on the ground.
failure.zh: 报告将项目的失败归因于管理层不愿咨询一线经验丰富的工程师，而非技术问题本身。

fair.en: Critics of the entrance exam argue that a test based solely on memorization can hardly provide a fair measure of a student's potential.
fair.zh: 入学考试的批评者认为，仅以记忆为基础的考试难以公平地衡量一个学生的潜力。

fairly.en: Although the two proposals look similar at first glance, they differ fairly sharply in how they would distribute costs between producers and consumers.
fairly.zh: 尽管这两项方案乍看相似，但它们在生产者和消费者之间分摊成本的方式上存在相当明显的差异。

faith.en: Repeated scandals in the banking sector eroded public faith in financial regulators, prompting calls for stricter and more independent oversight.
faith.zh: 银行业接连不断的丑闻侵蚀了公众对金融监管机构的信任，促使人们呼吁建立更严格、更独立的监督机制。

false.en: Psychologists note that eyewitnesses often form false memories when questioning techniques inadvertently suggest details that were never actually observed at the scene.
false.zh: 心理学家指出，当询问技巧无意中暗示现场从未出现过的细节时，目击者往往会形成错误的记忆。

familiar.en: The essayist assumes an audience familiar with classical economics, occasionally citing Adam Smith without bothering to explain the historical context.
familiar.zh: 这位散文作家假定读者熟悉古典经济学，偶尔引用亚当·斯密也不费心解释其历史背景。

family.en: Sociologists observe that the average family size has declined steadily in industrialized societies, a trend closely linked to rising education levels among women.
family.zh: 社会学家注意到，工业化社会中家庭平均规模持续缩小，这一趋势与女性受教育程度的提高密切相关。

fan.en: Even a devoted fan of the series admits that the latest sequel relies on special effects at the expense of coherent storytelling.
fan.zh: 连这部系列作品的忠实影迷也承认，最新的续集依赖特效而牺牲了连贯的叙事。

fantasy.en: Historians argue that nostalgia often turns the past into a comforting fantasy, obscuring the hardships that ordinary people actually endured.
fantasy.zh: 历史学家认为，怀旧常常把过去变成一种令人慰藉的幻想，掩盖了普通人实际经历的艰辛。

farmer.en: Subsidies intended to protect the small farmer frequently end up with large agribusinesses, according to an audit of the agricultural support program.
farmer.zh: 对农业扶持项目的审计显示，本意是保护小农户的补贴常常最终落入大型农业企业手中。

fashion.en: Fast fashion has transformed clothing into a disposable commodity, generating enormous textile waste that few recycling systems are equipped to handle.
fashion.zh: 快时尚使服装沦为一次性商品，产生了极少有回收系统能够处理的巨量纺织废料。

fat.en: Nutrition research has moved away from treating all dietary fat as harmful, distinguishing instead between fats that raise cholesterol and those that appear benign.
fat.zh: 营养学研究已不再把所有膳食脂肪都视为有害，而是区分会升高胆固醇的脂肪与看似无害的脂肪。

fate.en: The fate of the rainforest now depends less on local governments than on global commodity prices that determine whether clearing land remains profitable.
fate.zh: 雨林的命运如今更多取决于决定开垦土地是否仍有利可图的全球大宗商品价格，而非当地政府。

fault.en: The inquiry concluded that the bridge collapse was a design fault aggravated by years of postponed maintenance rather than an unforeseeable natural event.
fault.zh: 调查断定，大桥坍塌源于一处设计缺陷，多年推迟的养护使其雪上加霜，并非不可预见的自然灾害。

favor.en: Survey data favor the hypothesis that employees work harder when they believe promotions are decided by merit rather than by seniority.
favor.zh: 调查数据支持这样一种假设：当员工相信晋升取决于业绩而非资历时，他们会更加努力地工作。

favorite.en: Interviewers quickly discover that asking candidates about their favorite books reveals more about intellectual curiosity than any standard question about weaknesses.
favorite.zh: 面试官很快发现，询问应聘者最喜欢的书籍，比任何关于缺点的常规问题都更能揭示其求知欲。

fear.en: Behavioral economists contend that fear of losses motivates investors more powerfully than the prospect of equivalent gains, a finding known as loss aversion.
fear.zh: 行为经济学家认为，对损失的恐惧比同等收益的前景更能有力地驱动投资者，这一发现被称为损失厌恶。

feasible.en: Engineers concluded that a tunnel beneath the strait was technically feasible but warned that construction costs would exceed any realistic public budget.
feasible.zh: 工程师们断定，在海峡下方修建隧道在技术上是可行的，但警告其建设成本将超出任何现实的公共预算。

feature.en: A distinctive feature of the new constitution is that it requires a supermajority for amendments, making fundamental change deliberately slow.
feature.zh: 新宪法的一个显著特征是规定修宪必须获得绝对多数支持，从而刻意放缓根本性变革的步伐。

federal.en: Under the federal system, education policy is largely left to individual states, producing wide variations in school funding across the country.
federal.zh: 在联邦制下，教育政策基本交由各州自行决定，导致全国各地的学校经费差异悬殊。

fee.en: Universities that rely heavily on tuition fees tend to admit wealthier students, reinforcing inequalities the scholarship system was designed to reduce.
fee.zh: 严重依赖学费的大学往往倾向于录取富裕学生，这加剧了奖学金制度本想缩小的不平等。

feed.en: The drought forced ranchers to buy imported feed, and the resulting rise in production costs was quickly passed on to consumers.
feed.zh: 旱灾迫使牧场主购买进口饲料，由此上升的生产成本很快被转嫁给了消费者。

feeling.en: Public opinion polls can measure attitudes, but they capture little of the feeling that ultimately drives people to vote, donate, or protest.
feeling.zh: 民意调查能够测量态度，却几乎捕捉不到那种最终驱使人们投票、捐款或抗议的情绪。

fellow.en: In his memoir the physicist credits a fellow researcher with the crucial insight, an acknowledgment rare enough to draw attention from historians of science.
fellow.zh: 这位物理学家在回忆录中把关键洞见归功于一位同行研究者，这种致谢极为罕见，足以引起科学史家的注意。

female.en: The study found that female applicants were systematically offered lower starting salaries, even when their qualifications exceeded those of male candidates.
female.zh: 研究发现，女性求职者被系统性地给予更低的起薪，即使她们的资历超过男性候选人。

feminist.en: The essay traces how feminist scholarship reshaped literary criticism during the nineteen seventies, challenging a canon built almost entirely by male authors.
feminist.zh: 本文追溯了女权主义学术如何在二十世纪七十年代重塑文学批评，挑战了一个几乎完全由男性作家构成的经典体系。

fence.en: Residents along the border erected a fence, yet local officials acknowledged that barriers alone could not address the economic pressures driving migration.
fence.zh: 边境沿线的居民竖起了栅栏，但地方官员承认，仅靠屏障无法解决驱动移民的经济压力。

fertilizer.en: Chemical fertilizer dramatically raised crop yields after the war, but decades of overuse left many fields degraded and rivers polluted by runoff.
fertilizer.zh: 战后化肥大幅提高了粮食产量，但数十年的过量使用使许多田地退化，河流也因径流而受到污染。

fiber.en: Nutritionists recommend foods rich in dietary fiber because they slow digestion, stabilize blood sugar, and reduce the risk of intestinal diseases.
fiber.zh: 营养学家推荐富含膳食纤维的食物，因为这类食物能减缓消化、稳定血糖并降低肠道疾病的风险。

fiction.en: Although marketed as fiction, the novel draws so heavily on documented history that teachers assign it alongside conventional textbooks.
fiction.zh: 尽管以小说之名面市，这部作品对有据可查的历史倚重极深，教师们便将它与正规教科书搭配使用。

field.en: Breakthroughs in one scientific field frequently depend on instruments developed for entirely different purposes, a pattern historians of technology call serendipity.
field.zh: 一个科学领域的突破常常依赖为完全不同目的研制的仪器，技术史学家把这种模式称作机缘巧合。

fight.en: Public health officials have to fight misinformation almost as hard as the disease itself, since false claims spread faster than corrections.
fight.zh: 公共卫生官员对抗错误信息的力度几乎不亚于对抗疾病本身，因为虚假说法的传播速度比辟谣更快。

figure.en: The statistics agency later revised its growth figure, reminding analysts that early estimates often rest on incomplete and rapidly changing data.
figure.zh: 统计机构随后修正了其增长数字，提醒分析人士早期估计往往基于不完整且迅速变化的数据。

file.en: Under the new regulation, companies must file detailed reports on their carbon emissions or face escalating penalties.
file.zh: 根据新规定，企业必须申报其碳排放的详细数据，否则将面临不断加重的处罚。

final.en: Because the committee's decision is final, applicants who were rejected this year must wait until the next admission cycle to reapply.
final.zh: 由于委员会的决定是最终裁决，今年被拒的申请者必须等到下一个招生周期才能再次申请。

finally.en: After decades of negotiation, the two governments finally agreed on a framework for sharing the river's water during drought years.
finally.zh: 经过数十年的谈判，两国政府终于就干旱年份分配河水的框架达成一致。

finance.en: Microcredit programs promise to extend finance to households that banks consider unprofitable, yet high interest rates sometimes deepen the debt they intend to relieve.
finance.zh: 小额信贷项目承诺向银行认为无利可图的家庭提供融资，但高昂的利率有时反而加深了它们本想缓解的债务。

financial.en: Most small businesses fail not because their products are weak but because their financial planning cannot survive a single bad quarter.
financial.zh: 大多数小企业失败并非因为产品不佳，而是因为其财务规划挺不过区区一个糟糕的季度。

finding.en: The study's central finding, that class size barely affects learning after third grade, has provoked fierce disagreement among education researchers.
finding.zh: 该研究的核心发现——三年级之后班级规模对学习几乎没有影响——在教育研究者中激起了激烈争论。

fine.en: Opponents argue that a modest fine is treated by large corporations as a routine cost of doing business rather than a deterrent.
fine.zh: 反对者认为，数额不高的罚款会被大公司当作经营的常规成本，而非威慑手段。

finger.en: The historian points a finger at trade policy rather than climate, arguing that droughts only caused famine where grain markets had collapsed.
finger.zh: 这位历史学家把矛头指向贸易政策而非气候，认为干旱只有在粮食市场已经崩溃的地方才酿成饥荒。

firm.en: The consulting firm advised its clients to cut costs, a recommendation that later appeared in reports written for competitors as well.
firm.zh: 这家咨询公司建议客户削减成本，而这项建议后来也出现在其为竞争对手撰写的报告之中。

fiscal.en: Because election years rarely permit fiscal discipline, economists doubt the government will reduce the deficit before the next national vote.
fiscal.zh: 由于选举年份很少容得下财政纪律，经济学家怀疑政府在下一次全国投票之前不会削减赤字。

fix.en: Engineers warned that patching the software every week was no substitute for a permanent fix of the underlying design flaw.
fix.zh: 工程师们警告，每周对软件进行修补并不能替代对底层设计缺陷的永久性修复。

flag.en: The review flags several studies whose sample sizes are too small to support the sweeping conclusions in their abstracts.
flag.zh: 该综述指出若干研究的样本规模过小，不足以支撑其摘要中笼统的结论。

flame.en: The documentary shows how a single escaped flame can race through a dry hillside settlement within minutes, giving residents almost no warning.
flame.zh: 这部纪录片显示，一簇逃逸的火苗如何在几分钟内就能席卷干燥的山坡居民区，让居民几乎来不及预警。

flat.en: Retail sales stayed flat throughout the quarter, suggesting that recent tax cuts had failed to lift household spending.
flat.zh: 整个季度零售销售一直持平，表明最近的减税未能提振家庭消费。

flavor.en: Food scientists can now imitate the flavor of almost any fruit in the laboratory, raising questions about how consumers value naturalness.
flavor.zh: 食品科学家如今能在实验室中模仿几乎所有水果的风味，这引发了消费者如何看待天然性的疑问。

flawed.en: The commission dismissed the interior minister's report as methodologically flawed, noting that its survey excluded the very districts worst affected.
flawed.zh: 委员会以方法论存在缺陷为由否定了内政部长的报告，指出其调查恰恰排除了受灾最严重的地区。

flee.en: When the volcano erupted, tens of thousands of villagers had to flee their homes, straining shelters in nearby towns for months.
flee.zh: 火山喷发时，数以万计的村民被迫逃离家园，使附近城镇的避难所连续数月不堪重负。

flesh.en: The exhibition contrasts classical marble statues with works that deliberately expose flesh and vulnerability, tracing how Western art redefined the human body.
flesh.zh: 这次展览将古典大理石雕像与刻意展露肉体和脆弱性的作品并置，追溯了西方艺术如何重新定义人体。

float.en: Investors speculated about when the government would allow the currency to float freely, a step that exporters feared would erode their price advantage.
float.zh: 投资者纷纷猜测政府何时会让货币自由浮动，出口商担心这一步会削弱其价格优势。

flow.en: Urban planners redesigned the intersections to improve the flow of traffic, but critics noted that smoother driving often invites more cars.
flow.zh: 城市规划者重新设计路口以改善车流，但批评者指出，行车更顺畅往往会招来更多车辆。

fluctuate.en: Commodity prices fluctuate with harvests, currency movements, and geopolitical tensions, which makes long-term planning difficult for agricultural exporters.
fluctuate.zh: 大宗商品价格随收成、汇率波动和地缘政治紧张局势而起伏，这使农业出口方的长期规划变得困难。

focus.en: The lecture series deliberately keeps a narrow focus, believing that depth on a single question teaches more than broad surveys.
focus.zh: 这一系列讲座刻意保持狭窄的焦点，认为对单一问题的深挖比宽泛的概述更有教益。

folk.en: Anthropologists recorded folk songs sung during the harvest, discovering within their verses a rural history absent from official archives.
folk.zh: 人类学家录制了收获季节演唱的民间歌谣，在歌词中发现了一段官方档案中缺失的乡村历史。

follow.en: If the court rules against the agency, other regulators may follow with similar retreats, weakening protections built up over decades.
follow.zh: 如果法院裁定该机构败诉，其他监管机构可能随之作出类似退让，削弱数十年积累起来的保护措施。

following.en: The following year the researchers returned to the same villages, testing whether the improved sanitation program had produced lasting changes in behavior.
following.zh: 次年，研究人员回到同样的村庄，检验经过改进的卫生项目是否带来了持久的行为改变。

force.en: Competition from cheap imports was the main force behind the decline of domestic manufacturing, according to the economists' influential study.
force.zh: 根据这两位经济学家颇具影响的研究，廉价进口商品的竞争是本国制造业衰落背后的主要力量。

foreign.en: The ministry requires that foreign investors disclose their ownership stakes, a rule designed to prevent hidden control of strategic industries.
foreign.zh: 该部委要求外国投资者披露其持股情况，这一规定旨在防止对战略产业的隐性控制。

forest.en: Satellite images reveal that the forest is shrinking twice as fast as official statistics admit, largely because logging concessions are poorly monitored.
forest.zh: 卫星图像显示，森林缩减的速度是官方统计承认值的两倍，主要原因是伐木特许权监管不力。

forever.en: Digital storage was once assumed to preserve records forever, yet formats and media decay, and vast archives have already become unreadable.
forever.zh: 数字存储一度被认为能让记录永久保存，然而格式和介质都会衰变，大量档案已经无法读取。

formal.en: Linguists note that younger writers increasingly avoid formal registers online, blending spoken idiom into genres once reserved for printed prose.
formal.zh: 语言学家注意到，年轻写作者在网上越来越回避正式语体，把口语习惯掺入一度专属于印刷散文的文体之中。

formation.en: Geologists dated the rock formation to roughly sixty million years ago, revising earlier estimates based on incomplete fossil evidence.
formation.zh: 地质学家将这一岩层构造的年代定为约六千万年前，修正了先前基于不完整化石证据的估计。

former.en: In his former role as treasury secretary, he championed deregulation, a stance he now concedes contributed to the banking crisis.
former.zh: 在担任财政部长期间，他曾是放松管制的倡导者，如今他承认这一立场助长了银行业危机。

formidable.en: The new company emerged as a formidable competitor, combining advanced logistics with a brand loyalty that older retailers could not match.
formidable.zh: 这家新公司成长为强大的竞争者，将先进的物流与老牌零售商无法企及的品牌忠诚度结合在一起。

formula.en: Critics complain that the publisher applies the same formula to every bestseller, sacrificing originality for predictable commercial returns.
formula.zh: 批评者抱怨该出版商对每本畅销书都套用同一套公式，为可预期的商业回报牺牲了原创性。

formulate.en: It took the committee two years to formulate guidelines precise enough to be enforced yet flexible enough for local conditions.
formulate.zh: 委员会花了两年时间才制定出既精确到可以执行、又灵活到能适应各地情况的指导方针。

forth.en: The essay sets forth three objections to standard economic models, the most serious being their neglect of institutional history.
forth.zh: 这篇文章提出了对标准经济模型的三点异议，其中最严重的是它们忽视了制度史。

fortune.en: He made a fortune importing machinery, then spent much of it endowing scholarships for students from impoverished rural districts.
fortune.zh: 他靠进口机械发了财，随后把其中大部分用于为贫困农村地区的学生设立奖学金。

forward.en: The committee moved the proposal forward despite objections, scheduling a full debate for the opening session of parliament.
forward.zh: 委员会不顾反对意见推动该提案继续前行，并把全面辩论安排在议会的开幕会议上。

foster.en: Educators disagree about whether competition or cooperation better fosters creativity, and classroom experiments have so far produced mixed results.
foster.zh: 关于竞争与合作何者更能培养创造力，教育者意见不一，课堂实验迄今得出的结果也不一致。

found.en: The brothers used their savings to found a small press that later published several of the century's most influential novels.
found.zh: 兄弟俩用积蓄创办了一家小出版社，后来出版了本世纪最具影响力的几部小说。

foundation.en: Experimental evidence provides the foundation on which the entire theory rests, so any weakness in the data undermines all its predictions.
foundation.zh: 实验证据为整个理论提供了根基，因此数据中的任何弱点都会削弱其全部预测。

fragmentary.en: Because the surviving manuscripts are fragmentary, scholars disagree about whether the philosopher endorsed or merely recorded the argument attributed to him.
fragmentary.zh: 由于传世的手稿残缺不全，学者们对这位哲学家究竟是赞同还是仅仅记录了归于他名下的论证意见不一。

frame.en: How the media frame an economic downturn, as mismanagement or as global misfortune, measurably shifts what voters blame.
frame.zh: 媒体如何定性一场经济衰退，归咎于管理不善还是全球性厄运，会显著改变选民所指责的对象。

framework.en: The treaty establishes a legal framework for sharing genetic resources, though enforcement still depends on the goodwill of member states.
framework.zh: 该条约为共享遗传资源确立了一个法律框架，不过执行仍取决于成员国的善意。

freedom.en: Universities defend academic freedom on the ground that unorthodox ideas, however unwelcome, are essential to the long-term advancement of knowledge.
freedom.zh: 大学捍卫学术自由，理由是非正统的观点无论多么不受欢迎，对知识的长期进步都不可或缺。

freeze.en: The central bank decided to freeze interest rates for another quarter, judging that inflation was falling without further tightening.
freeze.zh: 央行决定将利率再冻结一个季度，认为无需进一步紧缩通胀就在回落。

frequency.en: The study measured the frequency with which residents visited public libraries and correlated it with reported levels of social trust.
frequency.zh: 该研究测量了居民光顾公共图书馆的频率，并将其与所报告的社会信任水平相关联。

frequent.en: Delays became so frequent on the northern line that commuters began scheduling meetings around the published timetable rather than actual conditions.
frequent.zh: 北线的晚点变得如此频繁，以致通勤者开始按公布的时刻表而非实际情况来安排会议。

frequently.en: Clinics in rural areas are frequently staffed by a single doctor, which helps explain the widening gap in health outcomes.
frequently.zh: 农村地区的诊所常常只有一名医生坐诊，这有助于解释健康状况差距不断扩大的原因。

fresh.en: The commission demanded fresh evidence before reopening the inquiry, having grown skeptical of testimony recycled from earlier hearings.
fresh.zh: 委员会要求在重启调查之前提供新证据，此前它已对重复来自早期听证会的证词起了疑心。

fuel.en: Economists warn that populist rhetoric can fuel distrust of the very institutions a modern economy depends on.
fuel.zh: 经济学家警告说，民粹主义言论会加剧对现代经济所依赖制度的不信任。

function.en: Sociologists debate whether religion still performs the function of binding communities together once markets supply most material needs.
function.zh: 社会学家争论，在市场满足大部分物质需求之后，宗教是否仍发挥着凝聚社区的功能。

fund.en: The government agreed to fund the research for five years, on condition that all data be published openly by 2030.
fund.zh: 政府同意为这项研究资助五年，条件是所有数据在2030年前全部公开。

fundamental.en: The court ruled that access to legal representation is a fundamental right, striking down fees that had effectively excluded poor defendants.
fundamental.zh: 法院裁定，获得法律代理是一项基本权利，并废除了实际上将贫穷被告排除在外的收费。

funeral.en: Anthropologists study funeral customs because the ways societies treat death reveal their deepest assumptions about status, kinship, and belief.
funeral.zh: 人类学家研究葬礼习俗，因为社会对待死亡的方式揭示了其关于地位、亲属关系和信仰的最深层假设。

funny.en: What readers found funny in the satire was its precision: every absurd detail corresponded to a documented bureaucratic practice.
funny.zh: 读者觉得这部讽刺作品好笑之处在于它的精确：每一个荒诞细节都对应着有据可查的官僚做法。

furniture.en: Imports of cheap furniture devastated local workshops, and the town's crafts guild now trains apprentices mainly to restore rather than build.
furniture.zh: 廉价家具的进口摧毁了当地作坊，镇上的手工艺行会如今培训学徒主要是为了修复而非制造。

furthermore.en: The trial results were reproducible in three independent laboratories; furthermore, the effect persisted for a full year after treatment ended.
furthermore.zh: 该试验结果在三个独立实验室均可复现，而且疗效在治疗结束后整整持续了一年。

gain.en: Analysts warn that the apparent efficiency gain from automation often disappears once the costs of retraining displaced workers are counted.
gain.zh: 分析人士警告说，一旦计入再培训失业工人的成本，自动化带来的表面效率收益往往就会消失。

galaxy.en: Astronomers estimate that our galaxy contains billions of planets orbiting within the temperate zones of their parent stars.
galaxy.zh: 天文学家估计，我们的星系包含数十亿颗在母星宜居带内运行的行星。

gallery.en: The gallery agreed to lend the paintings on condition that the borrowing museum fund climate-controlled transport and full insurance coverage.
gallery.zh: 美术馆同意出借这些画作，条件是借展的博物馆承担恒温运输和全额保险的费用。

gang.en: Sociologists studying urban poverty caution that treating every group of unemployed youths as a criminal gang deepens the very exclusion it fears.
gang.zh: 研究城市贫困的社会学家警告，把每一群失业青年都当作犯罪团伙来对待，反而会加深他们所惧怕的社会排斥。

gap.en: The wage gap between college graduates and workers without degrees has widened steadily since the nineteen eighties, according to labor economists.
gap.zh: 据劳动经济学家统计，自二十世纪八十年代以来，大学毕业生与没有学位的工人之间的工资差距持续扩大。

garage.en: The legend of the technology industry begins, almost ritually, in a suburban garage where two founders assemble their first prototype.
garage.zh: 科技产业的传奇几乎总是以仪式化的方式开篇：两位创始人在郊区的车库里组装出他们的第一台原型机。

garlic.en: The agricultural cooperative taught farmers to dry and store garlic properly, cutting post-harvest losses by nearly a third.
garlic.zh: 农业合作社教会农民妥善干燥和储存大蒜，使收获后的损失减少了近三分之一。

gas.en: Burning natural gas produces about half the carbon dioxide of coal, which is why utilities promote it as a transitional fuel.
gas.zh: 燃烧天然气产生的二氧化碳约为煤炭的一半，这正是公用事业公司将其作为过渡性燃料加以推广的原因。

gather.en: Reporters had to gather evidence from court records and leaked memoranda, since officials declined every request for an interview.
gather.zh: 记者不得不从法庭记录和泄露的备忘录中搜集证据，因为官员拒绝了每一次采访请求。

gay.en: The study examines how gay characters moved from the margins of mainstream cinema to central roles over three decades.
gay.zh: 该研究考察了三十年间同性恋角色如何从主流电影的边缘走向核心位置。

gaze.en: Art historians describe the painting's power as a gaze that meets the viewer directly, an audacious choice for its period.
gaze.zh: 艺术史学家将这幅画的感染力描述为一种直视观者的凝视，这在那个时代是大胆之举。

gear.en: Colleges now gear their vocational courses toward industries that local employers say they cannot staff adequately.
gear.zh: 各高校如今使职业课程对接本地雇主声称人手不足的行业。

gender.en: The committee removed names and gender from applications after discovering that reviewers scored identical writing differently depending on the author's apparent identity.
gender.zh: 委员会在发现评审者会因作者表面身份不同而对同一篇文章打出不同分数后，把姓名和性别从申请材料中删除了。

gene.en: Scientists inserted a single gene into the rice genome, raising its vitamin content enough to prevent the deficiency linked to blindness.
gene.zh: 科学家将单个基因植入水稻基因组，使其维生素含量提高到足以预防与失明相关的营养缺乏症。

general.en: The court held that in general, prophylactic bans survive constitutional review only when narrower remedies have demonstrably failed.
general.zh: 法院认定，一般而言，预防性禁令只有在更窄的救济措施已被证明无效时才能通过合宪性审查。

generate.en: Data centers generate enormous heat, so engineers are experimenting with ways to recycle it into district heating networks.
generate.zh: 数据中心产生大量热量，因此工程师们正在试验将其回收引入区域供热网络的方法。

generation.en: For the first time, polls suggest a majority of the younger generation expects to earn less than their parents did.
generation.zh: 民意调查首次显示，年轻一代中的多数人预期自己的收入会低于父母。

genetic.en: Doctors can now screen embryos for genetic disorders, a capability that has reopened old debates about where medicine ends and eugenics begins.
genetic.zh: 医生如今能够筛查胚胎的遗传疾病，这一能力重新开启了关于医学与优生学分界的旧有争论。

gentle.en: The critic's review was surprisingly gentle, acknowledging that the young director's ambition exceeded the resources available to him.
gentle.zh: 这位评论家的影评出人意料地温和，承认这位年轻导演的雄心超出了他所能获得的资源。

gentleman.en: The novelist portrays a Victorian gentleman whose respectability conceals a fortune built on colonial trade, exposing the era's moral contradictions.
gentleman.zh: 小说家刻画了一位体面背后藏着殖民贸易财富的维多利亚时代绅士，揭示了那个时代的道德矛盾。

gently.en: The therapist gently challenged the patient's assumption that failure at one stage of life predicted failure at every later one.
gently.zh: 治疗师温和地质疑了患者的假设，即人生某一阶段的失败注定此后每个阶段的失败。

genuine.en: Auditors struggled to distinguish genuine charities from shells created to harvest donations after the earthquake, when public generosity peaked.
genuine.zh: 地震后公众的慷慨达到顶峰，审计人员当时难以把真正的慈善机构与专为骗取捐款而设立的空壳组织区分开来。

geological.en: The museum's geological collection documents four mass extinctions, each preserved in a thin band of unusual clay.
geological.zh: 该博物馆的地质藏品记录了四次大灭绝，每一次都保存在一层薄薄的奇异黏土之中。

gesture.en: The minister's offer to meet the strikers was dismissed as a hollow gesture, since wages remained frozen under existing law.
gesture.zh: 部长会见罢工者的提议被斥为空洞的姿态，因为在现行法律下工资仍被冻结。

ghost.en: The town's economy remains a ghost of its industrial past, with empty mills housing little more than storage and occasional film crews.
ghost.zh: 这座小镇的经济仍只是其工业往昔的一缕残影，空置的厂房里除了仓储和偶尔来访的摄制组几乎别无他用。

giant.en: Regulators accuse the software giant of using its dominant platform to disadvantage smaller rivals in adjacent markets.
giant.zh: 监管机构指控这家软件巨头利用其主导平台损害相邻市场中较小竞争对手的利益。

glance.en: Even a casual glance at the figures reveals that reported incomes lag actual receipts by a wide margin.
glance.zh: 即使随意一瞥这些数字也能发现，申报收入与实际所得之间相差悬殊。

global.en: Climate negotiators remain deadlocked because the costs of emission cuts fall unevenly across global regions with very different historical responsibilities.
global.zh: 气候谈判仍陷于僵局，因为减排成本在历史责任迥异的全球各区域间分布不均。

glove.en: Forensic technicians must wear a fresh glove at each stage of collection, since cross-contamination can invalidate months of laboratory work.
glove.zh: 法证技术人员在取证各环节都必须戴新手套，因为交叉污染可能使数月的实验室工作作废。

goal.en: The researchers set a modest goal for the pilot study: to determine whether weekly tutoring improved reading scores at all.
goal.zh: 研究者为这项试验性研究设定了一个有限的目标：确定每周辅导究竟是否提高了阅读成绩。

god.en: In early agricultural societies, scholars note, the idea of a god of harvests reflected communal anxiety about weather and disease.
god.zh: 学者指出，在早期农业社会中，丰收之神的观念反映了共同体对天气和病害的集体焦虑。

gold.en: The discovery of gold attracted prospectors so quickly that the territorial government collapsed before it could impose any taxation.
gold.zh: 黄金的发现吸引淘金者蜂拥而至，速度之快令地方政府来不及征收任何税赋便已瓦解。

golden.en: Historians treat the 1990s as a golden age of productivity growth, achieved largely through computing and global supply chains.
golden.zh: 历史学家将二十世纪九十年代视为生产率增长的黄金时代，其成就在很大程度上得益于计算机技术与全球供应链。

golf.en: The resort's developers argue that golf tourism brings year-round employment, though ecologists question the water consumption involved.
golf.zh: 度假村开发商声称高尔夫旅游能带来全年就业，但生态学家质疑其中消耗的水资源。

governance.en: The study links corporate governance reform to measurable declines in bribery, though the authors caution against attributing all improvement to regulation.
governance.zh: 该研究将公司治理改革与贿赂行为的显著减少联系起来，但作者告诫不要把所有改善都归功于监管。

government.en: The report recommends that government procurement favor low-carbon suppliers, using public spending as an instrument of climate policy.
government.zh: 报告建议政府采购向低碳供应商倾斜，把公共支出用作气候政策的工具。

governor.en: The state governor vetoed the transportation bill, arguing that its funding formula shortchanged rural counties already struggling with road maintenance.
governor.zh: 该州州长否决了交通法案，理由是其拨款公式亏待了本已在道路养护上捉襟见肘的乡村各县。

grab.en: Investors tried to grab land abroad after food prices spiked in 2008, triggering disputes over sovereignty and smallholder rights.
grab.zh: 2008年食品价格飙升后，投资者试图在海外攫取土地，引发了一场关于主权和小农权利的争端。

graduate.en: Employers complain that each graduate arrives with credentials but without the practical judgment that internships alone seem to develop.
graduate.zh: 雇主们抱怨说，每个毕业生都带着证书而来，却缺乏似乎只有实习才能培养的实际判断力。

grain.en: The import ban pushed up the price of every staple grain, hurting urban consumers the policy was meant to reassure.
grain.zh: 进口禁令推高了每一种主粮谷物的价格，伤害了这项政策本想安抚的城市消费者。

grand.en: The museum's grand entrance was funded by a shipping magnate, a fact recorded discreetly on a small brass plaque.
grand.zh: 博物馆气派的大门由一位航运大亨出资修建，这一事实被低调地记录在一块小小的铜牌上。

grandmother.en: In the interviews, nearly every successful student credited a grandmother or mother who insisted on schooling despite community disapproval.
grandmother.zh: 在访谈中，几乎所有成功的学生都把功劳归于不顾社区反对而坚持让他们上学的祖母或母亲。

grant.en: The foundation will grant three years of support to teams willing to share raw data and failed results publicly.
grant.zh: 该基金会将向愿意公开原始数据和失败结果的团队授予为期三年的资助。

grave.en: The negotiators recognized that the ceasefire violations posed a grave risk to talks that had already survived two collapses.
grave.zh: 谈判代表认识到，违反停火的行为对已经历两次破裂的和谈构成了严重风险。

great.en: The exhibition argues that great scientific reputations are often collective achievements, built on assistants whose names never entered textbooks.
great.zh: 该展览认为，伟大的科学声誉往往是集体成就，建立在那些名字从未进入教科书的助手们的劳动之上。

greenhouse.en: Methane traps far more heat than carbon dioxide per ton, making agricultural emissions a central target of greenhouse policy.
greenhouse.zh: 每吨甲烷截留的热量远高于二氧化碳，这使农业排放成为温室气体政策的核心治理目标。

ground.en: The negotiators refused to resume talks until both sides had found common ground on the sequence of troop withdrawals.
ground.zh: 谈判代表拒绝恢复会谈，直到双方就撤军顺序找到共同立场。

growth.en: Economists increasingly distinguish between growth that raises ordinary wages and growth captured almost entirely by asset owners.
growth.zh: 经济学家越来越多地区分能提高普通工资的增长与几乎全部被资产所有者攫取的增长。

guarantee.en: Constitutional scholars point out that no constitutional text can guarantee rights unless courts and citizens are willing to enforce them.
guarantee.zh: 宪法学者指出，除非法院和公民愿意维护权利，否则任何宪法条文都无法保证权利的实现。

guard.en: The archive must guard its manuscripts against humidity as much as theft, since paper decay destroys more documents than intruders do.
guard.zh: 档案馆必须像防范盗窃一样防范湿气对手稿的侵蚀，因为纸张霉变损毁的文件比窃贼毁掉的更多。

guide.en: The handbook is meant to guide new reviewers through ethical dilemmas, from undisclosed conflicts to pressure from authors.
guide.zh: 这本手册旨在引导新任审稿人应对各种伦理困境，从未披露的利益冲突到来自作者的压力。

guideline.en: The medical guideline recommends shared decision making, yet surveys show most patients still defer entirely to their physicians.
guideline.zh: 这项医疗准则建议医患共同决策，但调查显示大多数患者仍完全听从医生。

guilty.en: The court found the company guilty of concealing safety data, a verdict that opened the way for hundreds of similar claims.
guilty.zh: 法院判定该公司犯有隐瞒安全数据之罪，这一判决为数百起类似索赔铺平了道路。

gun.en: The study finds that states requiring background checks for every gun sale report measurably lower rates of domestic homicide.
gun.zh: 该研究发现，要求每一笔枪支出售都进行背景审查的州，其家庭凶杀率明显更低。

guy.en: The columnist writes for the ordinary guy who distrusts experts, translating technical reports into plain, memorable language.
guy.zh: 这位专栏作家为不信任专家的普通人写作，把技术报告转译成平实而难忘的语言。

habit.en: Behavioral economists argue that no habit, however entrenched, survives long once the environment that sustains it is redesigned.
habit.zh: 行为经济学家认为，无论多么根深蒂固的习惯，一旦维系它的环境被重新设计，都难以长久维持。

habitat.en: Restoring a single wetland habitat can support dozens of bird species, which is why conservation funds increasingly favor such projects.
habitat.zh: 恢复一处湿地栖息地就能为数十种鸟类提供支持，这正是保护资金日益青睐此类项目的原因。

hall.en: The commencement hall seats four thousand graduates, yet tradition requires that every name still be read aloud individually.
hall.zh: 这座毕业典礼礼堂可容纳四千名毕业生，但传统仍要求逐一宣读每个人的姓名。

hamper.en: Bureaucratic delays continue to hamper the vaccination campaign, even though funding and public support have never been stronger.
hamper.zh: 官僚化的拖延继续阻碍疫苗接种运动，尽管资金和公众支持都达到了前所未有的程度。

hand.en: Craftspeople still finish each violin by hand, a practice that limits output but commands premium prices among professional musicians.
hand.zh: 制琴匠人至今仍以手工完成每把小提琴的最后修整，这种做法限制了产量，却在职业音乐家中赢得了溢价。

handful.en: Only a handful of the two hundred applications satisfied the new evidentiary standard, a result critics called excessively strict.
handful.zh: 在两百份申请中，只有寥寥数份达到新的证据标准，批评者称这一结果过于严苛。

handle.en: Courts trained for commercial disputes may struggle to handle litigation involving algorithms, where the relevant evidence is often the code itself.
handle.zh: 专长于商事纠纷的法院可能难以处理涉及算法的诉讼，因为此类案件的关键证据往往就是代码本身。

hang.en: Photographs hang in the corridor exactly as the curator arranged them, a sequence that quietly argues a historical thesis.
hang.zh: 照片按策展人安排的位置悬挂在走廊里，这一顺序不动声色地表达着一个史学论点。

happen.en: Economists study what would happen to wages if immigration doubled, comparing regions that experienced different inflows.
happen.zh: 经济学家通过比较移民流入量不同的地区，研究如果移民数量翻倍工资会发生什么变化。

hardly.en: The subsidy hardly changed farmers' behavior, because compliance costs consumed most of the money it offered.
hardly.zh: 这项补贴几乎没有改变农民的行为，因为合规成本吞噬了它所提供资金的大部分。

hardware.en: Software firms outgrew hardware makers during the past decade, shifting profits from manufacturing devices toward licensing and subscriptions.
hardware.zh: 在过去十年中，软件公司的增长超过了硬件制造商，把利润从设备制造转向授权与订阅业务。

hate.en: Historians document how wartime propaganda taught ordinary people to hate an enemy they had never seen, normalizing violence in the process.
hate.zh: 历史学家记录了战时宣传如何教会普通人去憎恨一个从未谋面的敌人，并在此过程中使暴力变得司空见惯。

head.en: The expedition chose a geologist to head the drilling project, judging scientific credibility more valuable than administrative experience.
head.zh: 考察队选定一位地质学家来主持钻探项目，认为科学公信力比行政经验更有价值。

headline.en: The newspaper's misleading headline overstated the study's conclusions, even though the article itself was carefully hedged.
headline.zh: 该报耸人听闻的标题夸大了研究结论，尽管文章本身措辞相当审慎。

headquarters.en: The company shifted its headquarters from the capital to a smaller city, citing office costs and the difficulty of hiring engineers.
headquarters.zh: 该公司将总部从首都迁往一座较小的城市，理由是办公成本以及招聘工程师的困难。

hearing.en: At the parliamentary hearing, the central banker conceded that the inflation forecast had underestimated supply chain disruptions.
hearing.zh: 在议会听证会上，这位央行行长承认通胀预测低估了供应链中断的影响。

heat.en: Cities record higher nighttime heat than surrounding countryside because asphalt and concrete store energy and release it slowly.
heat.zh: 城市夜间的炎热程度高于周边乡村，因为沥青和混凝土会储存热量并缓慢释放。

heaven.en: Renaissance painters placed God beyond the visible heaven, prompting theological debates about how to depict what lies outside creation.
heaven.zh: 文艺复兴时期的画家将上帝置于可见的天空之外，由此引发了关于如何描绘创世之外之物的神学争论。

heavy.en: The region's heavy reliance on a single crop left farmers exposed when international prices collapsed in a single season.
heavy.zh: 该地区严重依赖单一种植作物，当国际价格在一个季度内崩塌时，农民顿时蒙受惨重损失。

heel.en: The strike brought the shipping industry to heel within weeks, as ports admitted that automation could not replace experienced crane operators.
heel.zh: 罢工在几周内便使航运业屈服，因为各港口承认自动化无法取代经验丰富的吊车司机。

height.en: The dynasty reached the height of its commercial power when it standardized coinage and opened new silk routes.
height.zh: 该王朝在统一币制并开辟新的丝绸之路后，商业实力达到鼎盛。

helicopter.en: Emergency planners now station a rescue helicopter at the mine year-round, a reform adopted after the 2019 flood trapped dozens of workers.
helicopter.zh: 应急规划者如今常年在矿区派驻一架救援直升机，这项改革是在2019年洪水困住数十名矿工之后采取的。

hell.en: Survivors described the collapsed factory as a hell of dust and darkness, where trapped workers waited hours for rescue that arrived too slowly.
hell.zh: 幸存者把倒塌的工厂形容为尘土与黑暗交织的地狱，被困工人在其中苦等数小时才迎来迟缓的救援。

helpful.en: The reviewers found the appendix helpful but complained that the main argument relied on assumptions stated only there.
helpful.zh: 评审人认为附录很有帮助，但抱怨正文的主要论证所依赖的假设仅在附录中有所交代。

heritage.en: UNESCO's listing protects the city's architectural heritage, yet it also accelerates tourism that strains the very buildings it preserves.
heritage.zh: 联合国教科文组织的名录保护了这座城市的建筑遗产，却也加速了旅游业的发展，令其保护的建筑不堪重负。

hero.en: The biography resists making a hero of its subject, dwelling instead on compromises that earlier admiring accounts had quietly passed over.
hero.zh: 这部传记拒绝将其传主塑造成英雄，而是着力描写此前那些仰慕性记述悄悄略过的妥协。

hide.en: Corruption flourishes where officials can hide assets in relatives' names, which is why disclosure rules target entire households.
hide.zh: 在官员能够以亲属名义隐藏资产的地区腐败盛行，因此申报制度把范围扩大到官员的整个家庭。

hierarchy.en: The study finds that a flat hierarchy encourages dissent, which improves decision quality but slows routine execution.
hierarchy.zh: 研究发现，扁平的等级体系鼓励异见，这能提高决策质量，却会拖慢日常执行。

highlight.en: The report's authors highlight one anomaly that earlier studies had buried in footnotes: mortality fell fastest where clinics were newest.
highlight.zh: 报告作者着重指出了一处早前研究埋没在脚注中的异常现象：死亡率下降最快的地方正是诊所最新的地方。

highly.en: The committee rated the proposal highly, though it warned that the budget assumed unrealistically rapid recruitment of specialists.
highly.zh: 委员会对该提案评价很高，但警告其预算对专家招聘速度的假设不切实际。

highway.en: Economists dispute whether a new highway relieves congestion permanently or simply induces additional driving until roads fill again.
highway.zh: 经济学家对新建公路能否永久缓解拥堵存在争议，还是仅仅诱增额外车流直至道路再度饱和。

hip.en: Sociologists trace how the word hip traveled from marginal jazz clubs into mainstream advertising within a single generation.
hip.zh: 社会学家追溯了“时髦”一词如何仅在一代人之内就从边缘的爵士俱乐部进入主流广告业。

hire.en: Firms often prefer to hire graduates they trained themselves, since internal apprenticeships reveal qualities no examination can measure.
hire.zh: 企业往往更愿意雇用自己培养的毕业生，因为内部学徒制能揭示任何考试都无法衡量的素质。

historian.en: Each historian of the period emphasizes different archives, which is why scholarly narratives of the war still diverge sharply.
historian.zh: 研究那段时期的每位历史学家所依据的档案各不相同，这也是学界对这场战争的叙述至今分歧严重的原因。

historic.en: The delegates signed the historic accord on neutral ground, aware that a single reservation could dissolve months of diplomacy.
historic.zh: 代表们在中立地点签署了这项具有历史意义的协定，他们清楚一项保留条款就可能使数月的外交努力付诸东流。

historical.en: The novelist defends her liberties with historical detail, insisting that fiction may dramatize facts without betraying them.
historical.zh: 这位小说家为她在历史细节上的自由处理辩护，坚称小说可以戏剧化事实而不歪曲事实。

history.en: Geologists now argue that human activity has become a force in the planet's history, comparable to volcanic eruptions in its effects.
history.zh: 地质学家如今认为，人类活动已成为地球历史中的一股力量，其影响堪比火山喷发。

hit.en: The recession hit service industries first, because households cut travel and dining out long before postponing larger purchases.
hit.zh: 经济衰退首先冲击了服务业，因为家庭早在推迟大额采购之前就削减了旅行和外出就餐。

hold.en: Legal scholars ask how far courts can hold federal agencies to statutory limits without rewriting the statutes themselves.
hold.zh: 法律学者探讨法院能在多大范围内促使联邦机构遵守法律设定的界限，而不越俎代庖地改写法律本身。

hole.en: Auditors discovered a hole in the pension accounts that simple annual reporting had concealed for nearly ten years.
hole.zh: 审计人员在养老金账户中发现了一个漏洞，而简单的年度报告几乎十年间将其掩盖。

holy.en: Medieval law treated the cathedral's precinct as holy ground, granting fugitives a form of temporary legal protection.
holy.zh: 中世纪法律将大教堂的辖区视为神圣之地，给予逃亡者一种临时的法律庇护。

honest.en: Reviewers praised the report as honest about its limitations, an unusual quality that increased rather than diminished its credibility.
honest.zh: 评审人称赞这份报告对自身局限坦诚相告，这种罕见的品质非但没有削弱反而增强了它的可信度。

honey.en: Because pollinating insects have declined sharply in recent decades, farmers and scientists now worry that the falling supply of honey may signal deeper damage to agricultural ecosystems.
honey.zh: 由于授粉昆虫近几十年急剧减少，农民和科学家如今担心蜂蜜供应的下降可能预示着农业生态系统正遭受更深层破坏。

honor.en: Although the prize carries no large cash award, winning it is widely regarded as the highest honor a scientist can receive from the international research community.
honor.zh: 尽管该奖项并不附带丰厚的奖金，但获奖仍被广泛视为科学家能从国际研究界获得的最高荣誉。

horizon.en: Many economists believe that a recovery in consumer spending lies on the horizon, although its timing remains highly uncertain.
horizon.zh: 许多经济学家认为消费支出的回暖已近在眼前，尽管其确切时间仍高度不确定。

horror.en: Historians trying to explain the horror of the famine rely heavily on survivors' diaries, which record suffering that official reports deliberately minimized.
horror.zh: 试图解释那场饥荒之惨状的历史学家在很大程度上依赖幸存者的日记，其中记录的苦难是官方报告刻意淡化的。

host.en: The national museum will host a series of public lectures examining how digital technology is reshaping modern art.
host.zh: 这座国家博物馆将主办一系列公开讲座，探讨数字技术如何重塑当代艺术。

hostile.en: Critics of the reform remain hostile to any proposal that would give private companies access to confidential medical records.
hostile.zh: 批评改革的人仍然反对任何让私营企业获取机密医疗记录的提案。

house.en: The new library will house a special collection of manuscripts documenting the region's social history over the past three centuries.
house.zh: 新图书馆将收藏一批特别的手稿，记录该地区三个世纪以来的社会历史。

household.en: Rising energy prices have squeezed household budgets across the country, forcing many families to cut spending on education and health care.
household.zh: 能源价格上涨已使全国家庭预算吃紧，迫使许多家庭削减教育和医疗方面的开支。

housing.en: Urban planners argue that a shortage of affordable housing, rather than job losses, is the main force driving young workers away from major cities.
housing.zh: 城市规划者认为，经济适用房的短缺而非失业，才是把年轻劳动者赶出大城市的主要力量。

however.en: The experiment produced promising results; however, the sample size was too small for the findings to be generalized.
however.zh: 这项实验取得了令人鼓舞的结果，然而样本量太小，不足以将结论推广开来。

huge.en: The project consumed a huge share of the university's annual budget, yet its practical benefits for ordinary students remained difficult to measure.
huge.zh: 该项目消耗了这所大学年度预算的很大一部分，但它给普通学生带来的实际收益却难以衡量。

human.en: Psychologists have long debated whether human behavior is shaped primarily by inherited traits or by the social environment in which people grow up.
human.zh: 心理学家长期争论人类行为究竟主要由遗传特质塑造，还是主要由人们成长所处的社会环境塑造。

humanitarian.en: International agencies warned that without immediate humanitarian assistance, millions of displaced families would face starvation before the end of the winter.
humanitarian.zh: 国际机构警告，如果没有立即的人道主义援助，数百万流离失所的家庭将在冬季结束前面临饥荒。

humor.en: Political cartoonists use humor to expose the weaknesses of public officials, a tradition that many scholars trace back to the early press.
humor.zh: 政治漫画家利用幽默来揭露公职人员的弱点，学者们把这一传统追溯到早期的报刊。

hunt.en: Paleoanthropologists suggest that early humans cooperated to hunt large animals, a behavior that may have accelerated the development of language.
hunt.zh: 古人类学家认为，早期人类曾合作捕猎大型动物，这种行为可能加速了语言的发展。

hurt.en: Economists warn that sudden tariff increases would hurt domestic manufacturers that depend on imported components for more than half of their production.
hurt.zh: 经济学家警告，关税突然上调会伤害那些一半以上零部件依赖进口的国内制造商。

husband.en: In her classic study of rural families, the sociologist observed that the husband and wife typically divided farm work according to season rather than tradition.
husband.zh: 在那项关于农村家庭的经典研究中，这位社会学家观察到丈夫和妻子通常按季节而非按传统来分工农活。

hypothesis.en: To test the hypothesis that sleep loss impairs memory, researchers compared the recall accuracy of two groups over six consecutive weeks.
hypothesis.zh: 为检验睡眠不足会损害记忆这一假设，研究人员比较了两组人连续六周内的回忆准确度。

ideal.en: Early experiments rarely take place under ideal conditions, so researchers must design studies that can tolerate noise, delay, and measurement error.
ideal.zh: 早期实验很少在理想条件下进行，因此研究人员必须设计能够容忍噪声、延迟和测量误差的研究方案。

identification.en: The identification of the gene responsible for the disorder took nearly a decade and required cooperation among laboratories on four continents.
identification.zh: 对致病基因的鉴定历时近十年，需要四大洲实验室的通力合作。

identify.en: Machine learning systems can now identify patterns in medical images that even experienced doctors occasionally miss, raising questions about training and liability.
identify.zh: 机器学习系统如今能识别医学影像中连经验丰富的医生偶尔都会漏看的模式，这也引发了关于培训和责任的疑问。

identity.en: Sociologists note that migration can blur cultural identity, as second-generation immigrants negotiate between the traditions of their parents and those of the host society.
identity.zh: 社会学家指出，迁移会模糊文化身份，因为第二代移民要在父母传承的传统与所在社会的传统之间进行协调。

ideology.en: The study argues that a party's ideology shapes its environmental policy far more than economic evidence or public opinion does.
ideology.zh: 该研究认为，一个政党的意识形态对其环境政策的影响远大于经济证据或公众舆论。

ignore.en: Manufacturers that ignore consumer feedback about product safety risk not only legal penalties but also the long-term erosion of brand trust.
ignore.zh: 无视消费者关于产品安全反馈的制造商，不仅面临法律处罚的风险，还会遭受品牌信任的长期流失。

illegal.en: Satellite data suggest that illegal logging continues inside protected forests despite stricter penalties introduced by the government two years ago.
illegal.zh: 卫星数据显示，尽管政府两年前出台了更严厉的处罚，受保护森林中的非法采伐仍在继续。

illness.en: Public health researchers have found that untreated mental illness costs employers billions annually through absenteeism and reduced productivity.
illness.zh: 公共卫生研究人员发现，未经治疗的精神疾病每年通过旷工和生产率下降给雇主造成数十亿的损失。

illustrate.en: To illustrate how incentives shape behavior, the author cites a program that paid students for regular attendance and improved test scores.
illustrate.zh: 为说明激励机制如何塑造行为，作者引用了一项为按时出勤的学生付费并提高其考试成绩的计划。

illustration.en: The decline of local newspapers offers a clear illustration of how digital advertising has redrawn the economics of the media industry.
illustration.zh: 地方报纸的衰落清晰地说明，数字广告如何改写了媒体产业的经济格局。

image.en: Constant exposure to edited photographs on social media has been linked to a distorted body image among teenagers, according to several large surveys.
image.zh: 多项大型调查显示，持续接触社交媒体上经过修饰的照片，与青少年扭曲的身材意象有关。

imagination.en: Science fiction has long captured the public imagination, but its visions of the future also influence the research agenda of real laboratories.
imagination.zh: 科幻小说长期激发着公众的想象力，而它对未来图景的设想也影响着真实实验室的研究议程。

imagine.en: Few policymakers imagined a decade ago that remote work would become a permanent feature of the professional labor market.
imagine.zh: 十年前几乎没有政策制定者能想到，远程办公会成为职业劳动力市场的一个永久性特征。

immediate.en: The committee urged the government to take immediate action against factories that discharge untreated waste into the river at night.
immediate.zh: 委员会敦促政府对夜间向河流排放未经处理废水的工厂立即采取行动。

immediately.en: The new traffic regulation took effect immediately, leaving delivery companies little time to redesign their routes and schedules.
immediately.zh: 新的交通法规立即生效，留给快递公司重新设计路线和日程的时间所剩无几。

immense.en: Teachers working in underfunded schools often perform under immense pressure, managing large classes with outdated equipment and minimal administrative support.
immense.zh: 在经费不足的学校工作的教师常常在巨大压力下授课，要管理大班额，设备陈旧且行政支持极少。

immerse.en: Language researchers recommend that adult learners immerse themselves in authentic conversations rather than relying exclusively on grammar drills and textbook exercises.
immerse.zh: 语言研究人员建议成年学习者沉浸在真实的对话中，而不是完全依赖语法操练和课本练习。

immigrant.en: Many immigrant entrepreneurs open small businesses that revitalize declining neighborhoods, yet they still face disproportionate barriers when applying for bank loans.
immigrant.zh: 许多移民创业者开办小企业，让衰败的街区重获活力，但在申请银行贷款时仍面临格外多的障碍。

immune.en: Chronic stress appears to weaken the immune system, according to studies that tracked hospital workers over several flu seasons.
immune.zh: 对医院工作人员多个流感季的追踪研究表明，长期压力似乎会削弱免疫系统。

immunity.en: Epidemiologists warned that vaccination rates below the threshold required for herd immunity would allow preventable diseases to reappear in crowded cities.
immunity.zh: 流行病学家警告，疫苗接种率低于实现群体免疫所需的阈值，将使可预防的疾病在拥挤的城市中卷土重来。

impact.en: Economists are still measuring the full impact of automation on manufacturing employment, and early estimates vary considerably across regions.
impact.zh: 经济学家仍在衡量自动化对制造业就业的全面影响，各地区的初步估计差异相当大。

impartial.en: For a survey to be credible, the researchers must remain impartial and disclose in advance who financed the study.
impartial.zh: 要使调查可信，研究人员必须保持公正，并提前披露研究的资助方。

implement.en: Local governments often struggle to implement national environmental policies because they lack the staff, funding, and technical expertise required.
implement.zh: 地方政府在执行国家环境政策时常常力不从心，因为它们缺乏所需的人员、资金和技术专长。

implication.en: The court's ruling has far-reaching implications for technology companies, which may now be held responsible for content published by their users.
implication.zh: 法院的这项裁决对科技公司影响深远，这些公司如今可能要为用户发布的内容承担责任。

implicit.en: The argument rests on an implicit assumption that economic growth automatically improves public health, an assumption the data only partly support.
implicit.zh: 这一论证隐含着经济增长会自动改善公众健康的假设，而数据只能部分支持这一假设。

imply.en: Rising vacancy rates in city centers imply that remote work has permanently altered the demand for commercial office space.
imply.zh: 市中心不断上升的空置率意味着远程办公已永久性地改变了商业办公空间的需求。

import.en: The country continues to import more than half of its crude oil, leaving its economy exposed to sudden price swings abroad.
import.zh: 该国一半以上的原油仍需进口，其经济因此容易受到海外价格剧烈波动的冲击。

importance.en: Educators increasingly stress the importance of critical thinking, arguing that memorizing facts matters less in an age of instant search.
importance.zh: 教育者日益强调批判性思维的重要性，认为在即时搜索的时代，死记硬背事实已不那么重要。

important.en: It is important to remember that correlation between two variables does not by itself establish a causal relationship between them.
important.zh: 必须记住，两个变量之间的相关关系本身并不能确立二者之间的因果关系。

impose.en: Several European countries have moved to impose higher taxes on sugary drinks, hoping such measures will reduce obesity among children.
impose.zh: 几个欧洲国家已着手对含糖饮料征收更高的税，希望此类措施能降低儿童的肥胖率。

impossible.en: Critics once declared it impossible to recycle certain plastics economically, yet new chemical processes have begun to change that judgment.
impossible.zh: 批评者曾宣称某些塑料在经济上回收是不可能的，但新的化学工艺已开始改变这一判断。

impress.en: The candidate's detailed grasp of immigration statistics failed to impress the interview panel, which valued practical experience over factual recall.
impress.zh: 这位候选人对移民统计数据的详尽掌握并未给面试小组留下深刻印象，面试官更看重实践经验而非事实记忆。

impression.en: Studies of job interviews suggest that a candidate's first impression forms within seconds and is remarkably difficult to reverse afterwards.
impression.zh: 关于求职面试的研究表明，候选人的第一印象在几秒内形成，而且事后极难扭转。

impressive.en: The laboratory reported impressive gains in battery efficiency, though independent teams have not yet reproduced the results at commercial scale.
impressive.zh: 该实验室报告了电池效率方面令人瞩目的提升，不过独立团队尚未在商业规模上重现这些结果。

improve.en: Simply adding more computers to classrooms does not automatically improve learning outcomes; teacher training appears to matter far more.
improve.zh: 仅仅往教室里添置更多电脑并不能自动改善学习效果，教师培训似乎重要得多。

improvement.en: Although the treatment produced only a modest improvement in patients' symptoms, its low cost makes wide adoption attractive for rural clinics.
improvement.zh: 尽管这种疗法对患者症状的改善有限，但其成本低廉，使农村诊所广泛采用它颇具吸引力。

incentive.en: Some cities now offer a financial incentive to residents who install solar panels, a policy that has measurably accelerated adoption.
incentive.zh: 一些城市现在为安装太阳能板的居民提供经济激励，这一政策已切实加快了太阳能的普及。

incentivize.en: Behavioral economists argue that small, well-designed rewards can incentivize energy conservation more effectively than fines or public criticism.
incentivize.zh: 行为经济学家认为，小额而设计得当的奖励能够比罚款或公开批评更有效地激励人们节约能源。

incident.en: The data breach incident prompted regulators to question whether current privacy laws are adequate for an economy built on personal information.
incident.zh: 这次数据泄露事件促使监管机构质疑，现行隐私法对于建立在个人信息基础上的经济是否足够。

include.en: The final cost of the railway project will include compensation for residents whose homes lie along the planned route.
include.zh: 铁路项目的最终成本将包括对家园位于规划沿线的居民的补偿。

inclusion.en: The inclusion of oral histories in the archive has broadened the discipline's understanding of ordinary life during the industrial transition.
inclusion.zh: 口述史被纳入档案，拓宽了这门学科对工业化转型时期普通人生活的理解。

income.en: Because disposable income is considerably higher in coastal provinces, young workers keep migrating eastward despite the rising cost of living there.
income.zh: 由于沿海省份的可支配收入明显更高，尽管那里的生活成本不断上升，年轻劳动者仍在持续向东迁移。

incorporate.en: Modern city planners now incorporate green corridors into dense districts, citing evidence that trees lower summer temperatures and improve mental health.
incorporate.zh: 现代城市规划者如今把绿色廊道纳入高密度城区，援引的证据表明树木能降低夏季气温并改善心理健康。

increase.en: Online retailers have continued to increase their investment in warehouse automation even as consumer spending growth slowed markedly.
increase.zh: 即便消费支出增长明显放缓，网络零售商仍在继续增加对仓储自动化的投资。

increasingly.en: Universities are becoming increasingly dependent on tuition fees, a trend that critics say narrows access for students from low-income families.
increasingly.zh: 大学正越来越依赖学费收入，批评者称这一趋势缩小了低收入家庭学生的入学机会。

incredible.en: The migration of Arctic caribou is an incredible feat of navigation, yet climate change is altering the routes these herds have used for centuries.
incredible.zh: 北极驯鹿的迁徙是一场令人难以置信的导航壮举，然而气候变化正在改变这些鹿群数百年来沿用的路线。

indeed.en: The reform did reduce administrative costs; indeed, several agencies reported savings exceeding their original estimates within the first year.
indeed.zh: 改革确实降低了行政成本；事实上，多家机构报告的首年节省金额都超出了最初估计。

independence.en: Judicial independence is considered essential to investor confidence, because courts that resist political pressure enforce contracts more predictably.
independence.zh: 司法独立被视为投资者信心的关键，因为能够抵御政治压力的法院执行合同更加可预期。

independent.en: Before the drug reached the market, an independent panel of physicians reviewed all the clinical trial data for signs of bias.
independent.zh: 在该药上市之前，一个由医生组成的独立小组审查了全部临床试验数据，以寻找偏倚的迹象。

index.en: The consumer price index rose more slowly than expected last quarter, easing fears that inflation was becoming permanently embedded in wages.
index.zh: 上季度消费者价格指数的涨幅低于预期，缓解了人们对通胀永久嵌入工资体系的担忧。

indicate.en: Preliminary results indicate that students who take handwritten notes retain conceptual material better than those who type their notes.
indicate.zh: 初步结果表明，手写记笔记的学生对概念性内容的记忆优于打字记笔记的学生。

indication.en: There is strong indication that remote monitoring devices can reduce hospital readmissions, though insurers have been slow to cover them.
indication.zh: 有充分迹象表明，远程监测设备能降低再入院率，不过保险公司迟迟不愿将其纳入承保范围。

indispensable.en: Clean water is indispensable to public health, which is why economists treat water infrastructure as an investment rather than an expense.
indispensable.zh: 清洁用水对公共卫生不可或缺，这正是经济学家把水利基础设施视为投资而非开支的原因。

individual.en: Standardized tests may overlook individual differences in creativity, a limitation that has fueled criticism of school ranking systems.
individual.zh: 标准化考试可能忽视个体在创造力上的差异，这一局限加剧了对学校排名制度的批评。

induce.en: Economists question whether tax breaks alone can induce firms to relocate, since skilled labor and supplier networks often matter more.
induce.zh: 经济学家质疑单靠税收优惠能否促使企业搬迁，因为熟练劳动力和供应商网络往往更为关键。

industrial.en: During the industrial revolution, cities expanded so rapidly that public sanitation could not keep pace with population growth.
industrial.zh: 工业革命期间，城市扩张得如此迅速，以致公共卫生设施跟不上人口增长的步伐。

industry.en: The textile industry has relocated repeatedly in search of cheaper labor, leaving once-thriving mill towns struggling to attract new employers.
industry.zh: 纺织业为寻找更廉价的劳动力而一再迁移，使曾经繁荣的工业城镇难以吸引新的雇主。

inequality.en: Rising income inequality has become a central theme in political debate, with researchers linking it to slower economic mobility.
inequality.zh: 收入不平等加剧已成为政治辩论的核心议题，研究人员将其与经济流动性放缓联系在一起。

inevitable.en: Many historians regard the decline of handcraft production as inevitable once standardized machinery made mass manufacturing profitable.
inevitable.zh: 许多历史学家认为，一旦标准化机械使大规模制造有利可图，手工业生产的衰落就不可避免。

infant.en: Improvements in prenatal care have sharply reduced infant mortality, one of the most reliable indicators of a population's overall health.
infant.zh: 产前护理的改进大幅降低了婴儿死亡率，而婴儿死亡率是衡量人口总体健康最可靠的指标之一。

infection.en: Hospitals have cut postsurgical infection rates significantly by enforcing simple hygiene protocols rather than relying on expensive new drugs.
infection.zh: 医院通过严格执行简单的卫生规程，显著降低了术后感染率，而不是依赖昂贵的新药。

infectious.en: Global travel has made infectious disease control an international enterprise, since an outbreak in one region can reach distant cities within hours.
infectious.zh: 全球旅行使传染病控制成为一项国际事业，因为一个地区的疫情能在数小时内传到遥远的城市。

infer.en: Because the survey did not include rural respondents, the authors caution readers against trying to infer national trends from the data.
infer.zh: 由于这项调查未纳入农村受访者，作者告诫读者不要试图据此推断全国性的趋势。

inflation.en: Central banks raised interest rates to curb inflation, but economists warn that aggressive tightening could push the economy into recession.
inflation.zh: 央行提高了利率以遏制通胀，但经济学家警告，激进的紧缩可能把经济推入衰退。

influence.en: Peer groups exert a powerful influence on adolescent behavior, often exceeding the effect of parents once teenagers enter secondary school.
influence.zh: 同伴群体对青少年行为有强大影响，青少年进入中学后，这种影响往往超过父母。

inform.en: Decades of classroom research now inform national reading policy, though implementing the findings uniformly across districts remains difficult.
inform.zh: 数十年的课堂研究如今为全国阅读政策提供依据，但在各学区统一落实这些发现仍然困难。

infrastructure.en: Aging infrastructure is quietly imposing hidden costs on the economy, as frequent power failures and delayed shipments erode business confidence.
infrastructure.zh: 老化的基础设施正悄然给经济带来隐性成本，频繁的停电和延误的货运正在侵蚀企业信心。

ingredient.en: Food scientists can now trace every ingredient in a packaged meal back to its farm of origin using blockchain records.
ingredient.zh: 食品科学家如今可以利用区块链记录，把包装食品中的每一种成分追溯到其原产地农场。

inherent.en: There is an inherent tension between maximizing shareholder returns and investing heavily in long-term research with uncertain payoffs.
inherent.zh: 在股东回报最大化与重金投入回报不定的长期研究之间存在固有矛盾。

inhibit.en: Strict liability rules may inhibit investment in experimental drugs, because firms fear lawsuits even when trials follow every regulation.
inhibit.zh: 严格的责任规则可能抑制对试验性药物的投资，因为即便试验完全合规，企业也害怕诉讼。

initial.en: Despite initial skepticism from senior editors, the young journalist's investigation eventually forced the ministry to reopen the case.
initial.zh: 尽管资深编辑起初持怀疑态度，这位年轻记者的调查最终仍迫使该部门重新立案。

initiate.en: The foundation will initiate a five-year program that trains rural teachers to use free digital libraries in daily instruction.
initiate.zh: 该基金会将启动一项为期五年的计划，培训农村教师在日常教学中使用免费的数字图书馆。

initiative.en: Under the new government initiative, small manufacturers that cut emissions ahead of schedule receive priority access to public contracts.
initiative.zh: 根据这项新的政府举措，提前完成减排目标的小型制造企业将优先获得公共合同。

injury.en: Mandatory seatbelt laws sharply reduced head injury rates, providing some of the clearest evidence that regulation can change behavior.
injury.zh: 强制系安全带的法律大幅降低了头部受伤率，为法规能够改变行为提供了最清晰的证据之一。

inner.en: Sociologists studying the inner city argue that unemployment alone cannot explain its decline, pointing instead to decades of disinvestment.
inner.zh: 研究城市内城区的社会学家认为，仅靠失业无法解释其衰落，并指出根源在于数十年的投资撤离。

innocent.en: The appeal court concluded that the defendant was innocent of fraud, yet the earlier proceedings had already destroyed his business.
innocent.zh: 上诉法院认定被告无罪，但此前的诉讼程序早已摧毁了他的生意。

innovate.en: Firms operating in protected markets rarely innovate, a pattern economists attribute to the absence of competitive pressure.
innovate.zh: 在受保护市场中经营的企业很少创新，经济学家把这种模式归因于竞争压力的缺失。

innovation.en: Technological innovation tends to concentrate in regions where universities, venture capital, and skilled migrants cluster within a small geographic area.
innovation.zh: 技术创新往往集中在大学、风险资本和高技能移民在狭小地理区域内聚集的地区。

innovative.en: The firm survived the downturn largely because its innovative pricing model attracted customers who had previously considered the product unaffordable.
innovative.zh: 这家公司基本靠其创新的定价模式挺过了低迷期，该模式吸引了以前认为产品买不起的顾客。

inquiry.en: The parliamentary inquiry into the banking scandal heard testimony from former executives who denied any knowledge of the practice.
inquiry.zh: 针对银行业丑闻的议会调查听取了前高管的证词，这些高管否认知晓这一做法。

insect.en: Because certain insect species pollinate crops worth billions annually, their decline poses a direct threat to global food security.
insect.zh: 由于某些昆虫物种每年为价值数十亿的作物授粉，它们的数量下降对全球粮食安全构成直接威胁。

inside.en: Leaked memos from inside the company revealed that executives had been warned about the defective brakes months before the recall.
inside.zh: 从公司内部泄露的备忘录显示，早在召回前数月，高管们就已被警告刹车存在缺陷。

insight.en: Field experiments give economists fresh insight into real decision-making that laboratory surveys frequently fail to capture.
insight.zh: 现场实验让经济学家得以洞察真实的决策过程，这是实验室调查常常无法捕捉的。

insist.en: Company spokespeople insist that the layoffs were driven by automation rather than by the newly signed trade agreement.
insist.zh: 公司发言人坚称，裁员是自动化所致，而非新签署的贸易协定所致。

inspect.en: Food safety officers now inspect processing plants without advance notice, a change that has noticeably improved compliance records.
inspect.zh: 食品安全官员如今会突击检查加工厂，不作事先通知，这一变化明显改善了合规记录。

inspire.en: Her account of growing up in a mining town continues to inspire students who doubt that education can change their circumstances.
inspire.zh: 她讲述自己在矿区小镇长大的经历，至今仍激励着那些怀疑教育能否改变自身处境的学生。

install.en: The city plans to install sensors at every major intersection so that traffic signals can respond to congestion in real time.
install.zh: 该市计划在每个主要路口安装传感器，使交通信号灯能够实时响应拥堵状况。

instance.en: Some technologies reduce workload while creating new obligations; medical record systems, for instance, demand constant data entry from physicians.
instance.zh: 有些技术在减轻负担的同时也制造了新的义务，例如医疗记录系统就要求医生不断录入数据。

institute.en: The research institute publishes an annual report evaluating how well national education systems prepare students for the digital economy.
institute.zh: 该研究所发布年度报告，评估各国教育体系培养学生迎接数字经济的成效如何。

institution.en: Marriage remains a central social institution, yet demographic data show that people are entering it later and leaving it more often.
institution.zh: 婚姻仍是一种核心的社会制度，然而人口数据显示，人们进入婚姻更晚，离开婚姻也更频繁。

institutional.en: Because institutional investors now hold a majority of shares in listed companies, they can wield unusual power over executive pay and board elections.
institutional.zh: 由于机构投资者如今持有上市公司的大多数股份，它们能够对高管薪酬和董事会选举施加异乎寻常的影响力。

instruction.en: Cognitive scientists find that spaced practice and explicit instruction outperform discovery learning, especially for students encountering material for the first time.
instruction.zh: 认知科学家发现，间隔练习和清晰的讲授优于发现式学习，对学生初次接触的内容尤其如此。

instrument.en: Precision is the central virtue of the new orbiting instrument, which can measure atmospheric carbon with unprecedented accuracy.
instrument.zh: 精度是这台新轨道仪器的核心优点，它能够以前所未有的准确度测量大气中的碳含量。

insurance.en: Rising insurance premiums in coastal regions reflect a colder calculation: insurers now price climate risk directly into household policies.
insurance.zh: 沿海地区不断上涨的保险费反映出一种冷峻的计算：保险公司如今把气候风险直接计入家庭保单的定价。

integrate.en: Educators are trying to integrate vocational training into the academic curriculum so that graduates possess both theoretical knowledge and practical skills.
integrate.zh: 教育者正努力把职业培训融入学术课程，使毕业生既具备理论知识又具备实用技能。

integration.en: The economic integration of the two regions proceeded faster than their cultural integration, producing friction that persists to this day.
integration.zh: 这两个地区的经济一体化进程快于文化融合，由此产生的摩擦延续至今。

integrity.en: Scientific integrity requires that researchers publish negative results as diligently as positive ones, a norm that competitive funding pressures erode.
integrity.zh: 科学诚信要求研究者以同样的勤勉发表阴性结果和阳性结果，而竞争性的经费压力正在侵蚀这一规范。

intellectual.en: Universities pride themselves on intellectual freedom, yet budget pressures increasingly push departments toward courses with obvious commercial appeal.
intellectual.zh: 大学以思想自由为傲，但预算压力正日益把各院系推向具有明显商业吸引力的课程。

intelligence.en: Artificial intelligence is transforming drug discovery by predicting how millions of molecular structures will interact with target proteins.
intelligence.zh: 人工智能正在变革药物研发，它能够预测数百万种分子结构与靶蛋白将如何相互作用。

intend.en: Lawmakers intend the subsidy to help low-income households, but utility data suggest most of the benefit flows to large consumers.
intend.zh: 立法者打算让这项补贴帮助低收入家庭，但公用事业数据显示，大部分好处流向了用电大户。

intense.en: Competition for research funding has become so intense that some scientists spend more time writing grant applications than doing experiments.
intense.zh: 科研经费竞争已激烈到如此程度，以致一些科学家花在撰写基金申请上的时间比做实验还多。

intensify.en: Climate models predict that heat waves will intensify in mid-latitude cities, straining electricity grids designed for milder conditions.
intensify.zh: 气候模型预测，中纬度城市的热浪将会加剧，使为较温和条件设计的电网不堪重负。

intensity.en: The intensity of the debate over gene editing reflects a deeper disagreement about where regulators should draw ethical lines.
intensity.zh: 围绕基因编辑的争论之激烈，反映出人们在监管者应于何处划定伦理界线这一问题上更深的分歧。

intention.en: The minister declared his intention to reform the pension system, though he offered few details about how the transition would be financed.
intention.zh: 部长宣布了他改革养老金制度的意图，但对于转型将如何筹资却几乎没有提供细节。

interdisciplinary.en: Solving urban congestion requires interdisciplinary teams that combine transport engineering, behavioral psychology, and municipal economics in a single research design.
interdisciplinary.zh: 解决城市拥堵需要跨学科团队，把交通工程、行为心理学和城市经济学融合在同一项研究设计之中。

interest.en: Central bank interest rate decisions move markets within seconds, which is why traders parse every sentence of the official statement.
interest.zh: 央行的利率决定会在几秒钟内撼动市场，因此交易员会逐句解读官方声明的每个句子。

interface.en: Designers have learned that a confusing interface discourages users faster than slow performance, so clarity now drives most software updates.
interface.zh: 设计师已经明白，令人困惑的界面比缓慢的性能更快让用户望而却步，因此清晰易用如今主导着大多数软件更新。

intermediate.en: The language school offers three levels of instruction, placing each new student in a beginner, intermediate, or advanced class after testing.
intermediate.zh: 这所语言学校提供三个级别的教学，经测试后把每位新学员分入初级、中级或高级班。

internal.en: The leaked report described internal disagreements over whether the company should prioritize quarterly profits or long-term sustainability.
internal.zh: 泄露的报告描述了公司内部的分歧：究竟应优先考虑季度利润还是长期可持续性。

international.en: Enforcement of the fishing treaty remains weak, because governments facing domestic pressure to protect jobs rarely put international commitments ahead of national interests.
international.zh: 这项捕捞条约的执行依然乏力，因为面临保护就业之国内压力的各国政府，很少把国际承诺置于国家利益之前。

internet.en: Rural communities without reliable internet access fall further behind in education and commerce, deepening the digital divide that policymakers promised to close.
internet.zh: 缺乏可靠网络接入的农村社区在教育和商业上进一步落后，加深了政策制定者曾承诺弥合的数字鸿沟。

interpret.en: How courts interpret ambiguous contract language can determine whether thousands of franchise owners survive a corporate restructuring.
interpret.zh: 法院如何解释含糊的合同用语，可能决定数以千计的加盟商能否在公司重组中存活下来。

interpretation.en: Ancient legal codes resist a single interpretation, so historians compare translations from several languages before drawing conclusions about their intent.
interpretation.zh: 古代法典难以作出单一的解释，因此历史学家会比对多种语言的译本，然后再对其意图下结论。

interrupt.en: Frequent notifications interrupt concentrated work, and studies show that employees need roughly twenty minutes to regain deep focus afterwards.
interrupt.zh: 频繁的通知会打断专注的工作，研究表明员工事后大约需要二十分钟才能重新进入深度专注状态。

intervene.en: Most economists agree that governments should intervene when markets fail, but they disagree sharply about how to identify failure in advance.
intervene.zh: 多数经济学家同意在市场失灵时政府应当介入，但对于如何提前识别失灵，他们分歧极大。

interview.en: The journalist secured a rare interview with the retiring judge, who spoke candidly about the pressures facing the modern judiciary.
interview.zh: 这名记者争取到了对即将退休法官的罕见专访，后者坦率谈到了现代司法界面临的种种压力。

intricate.en: Repairing antique clocks demands intricate work, and the shrinking number of apprentices entering the trade worries preservation societies.
intricate.zh: 修复古董钟表需要极为精细的工序，而进入这一行当的学徒日渐减少，令文物保护团体忧心。

intrinsic.en: Psychologists distinguish between extrinsic rewards and intrinsic motivation, noting that pay can sometimes crowd out the genuine pleasure of a task.
intrinsic.zh: 心理学家区分外在奖励与内在动机，指出报酬有时会挤占任务本身带来的真正乐趣。

introduce.en: The government will introduce stricter fuel standards next year, giving automakers barely eighteen months to retool their assembly lines.
introduce.zh: 政府将于明年推出更严格的燃油标准，留给汽车制造商改造装配线的时间只有短短十八个月。

introduction.en: Since its introduction in the 1990s, the standardized admission test has been accused of favoring students from wealthier families.
introduction.zh: 自上世纪九十年代引入以来，这项标准化入学考试一直被指责偏袒富裕家庭的学生。

intuition.en: Experienced firefighters often trust intuition when conditions deteriorate, a phenomenon that researchers link to pattern recognition built through years of practice.
intuition.zh: 经验丰富的消防员在条件恶化时常凭直觉行动，研究人员将这一现象与多年实践形成的模式识别能力联系起来。

invasion.en: Ecologists describe the spread of the vine as a biological invasion, because it displaces native plants and rewrites entire food webs.
invasion.zh: 生态学家把这种藤蔓的蔓延描述为一场生物入侵，因为它排挤本地植物并改写了整条食物链。

invent.en: It is easier to invent a new device than to predict which social norms will change once people adopt it.
invent.zh: 发明一件新装置容易，而预测人们采用它之后哪些社会规范会改变则要难得多。

invest.en: Provincial governments now invest heavily in high-speed rail, betting that better connections will spread growth beyond the largest cities.
invest.zh: 省级政府如今重金投资高铁，寄望于更便捷的交通能把增长扩散到最大城市之外。

investigate.en: Auditors were appointed to investigate why construction costs on the bridge exceeded the original estimate by nearly forty percent.
investigate.zh: 审计人员受命调查这座大桥的建造成本为何比最初的估算高出近百分之四十。

investment.en: Education is often described as the most productive investment a society can make, yet school budgets are the first casualty of austerity.
investment.zh: 教育常被描述为一个社会所能进行的最有成效的投资，然而学校预算总是紧缩政策的首个牺牲品。

invite.en: The committee voted to invite independent experts to review the draft standard after industry objections delayed its release for months.
invite.zh: 在行业异议使标准草案的发布推迟数月之后，委员会投票决定邀请独立专家进行评审。

invoke.en: Opponents of the emergency decree warned ministers not to invoke national security as a pretext for suppressing ordinary criticism.
invoke.zh: 紧急状态法令的反对者警告部长们，不要援引国家安全作为压制正常批评的借口。

involve.en: Effective disaster planning must involve local residents, because external agencies rarely understand which neighborhoods flood first or where the elderly live.
involve.zh: 有效的防灾规划必须让当地居民参与，因为外来的机构很少了解哪些街区最先被淹、老人住在哪里。

iron.en: Archaeologists argue that the shift from bronze to iron tools democratized farming, since iron ore was far more widely available.
iron.zh: 考古学家认为，从青铜工具到铁制工具的转变使农耕走向平民化，因为铁矿的分布要广泛得多。

irrigation.en: Modern drip irrigation consumes far less water than flood methods, which explains its rapid adoption in drought-prone farming regions.
irrigation.zh: 现代滴灌的耗水量远低于漫灌方式，这解释了它在易旱农业区得到迅速推广的原因。

island.en: On small island states, rising sea levels threaten not only homes but also the freshwater supplies on which tourism depends.
island.zh: 在小岛屿国家，海平面上升威胁的不仅是住房，还有旅游业赖以运转的淡水供应。

isolate.en: Researchers managed to isolate the compound responsible for the plant's analgesic effect, opening a promising path for synthetic production.
isolate.zh: 研究人员成功分离出使该植物具有镇痛作用的化合物，为合成生产开辟了一条前景可期的路径。

issue.en: Access to affordable child care has become a defining political issue among younger voters, according to consecutive national surveys.
issue.zh: 连续多轮全国调查显示，获得价格可承受的托育服务已成为年轻选民关注的决定性政治议题。

item.en: Each item on the questionnaire was tested with focus groups before the national survey was distributed to two thousand households.
item.zh: 在这份全国问卷发放给两千户家庭之前，问卷中的每个条目都经过了焦点小组的测试。

jacket.en: Researchers studying workplace norms note that the suit jacket has disappeared from many offices, a symbol of how informal communication has become.
jacket.zh: 研究职场规范的人员注意到，西装外套已从许多办公室消失，这象征着职场交流已变得多么不拘礼节。

jeans.en: What began as durable workwear for miners has turned jeans into a global fashion staple that transcends class and generation.
jeans.zh: 牛仔裤起初是矿工的耐磨工装，如今已变成一种跨越阶层与世代的全球时尚单品。

jet.en: Aviation accounts for a growing share of carbon emissions, and each long-haul jet flight adds roughly a ton of carbon dioxide per passenger.
jet.zh: 航空在碳排放中所占份额不断上升，每次长途喷气式客机飞行平均每位乘客约增加一吨二氧化碳。

joint.en: The two universities launched a joint research center to study how aging populations will reshape public health systems.
joint.zh: 两所大学共同发起了一个联合研究中心，研究人口老龄化将如何重塑公共卫生体系。

joke.en: Anthropologists argue that a shared joke can mark the boundary of a social group, signaling who belongs and who does not.
joke.zh: 人类学家认为，一个共享的玩笑能够标出一个社会群体的边界，表明谁属于圈内、谁不属于。

journal.en: Peer review is supposed to safeguard quality, yet a single journal retraction can now undo years of public trust in a field.
journal.zh: 同行评审本应保障质量，但如今一家期刊的一次撤稿就可能毁掉公众对某个领域多年积累的信任。

journalist.en: An experienced journalist can often verify a claim within hours by consulting court records, filings, and sources on the ground.
journalist.zh: 经验丰富的记者通常能在数小时内核实一项说法，方法是查阅法庭记录、档案文件以及当地的消息源。

journey.en: The migration journey of the monarch butterfly spans three generations, a biological relay that still puzzles researchers.
journey.zh: 帝王蝶的迁徙之旅跨越三代个体，这种生物学上的接力至今仍令研究者困惑。

joy.en: Studies of workplace wellbeing suggest that employees perform best when they experience genuine joy in problem solving rather than fear of evaluation.
joy.zh: 职场幸福感研究表明，员工在解决问题中体验到真正的快乐时表现最佳，而不是在惧怕考核时。

judge.en: Behavioral research shows that people judge the fairness of an offer not by its size but by how it compares with others.
judge.zh: 行为研究表明，人们评判一项提议是否公平，不是看其金额大小，而是看它与其他提议相比如何。

junior.en: Firms that pair each junior employee with a senior mentor report faster skill development and noticeably lower staff turnover.
junior.zh: 为每名初级员工配备一位资深导师的企业，其员工技能成长更快，人员流失率也明显更低。

jury.en: Trial procedures differ widely across countries: some systems rely on a jury of ordinary citizens, others on professional judges alone.
jury.zh: 各国的审判程序差异很大：有些制度依靠普通公民组成的陪审团，另一些则完全依靠职业法官。

justice.en: The commission concluded that equal access to legal representation is a precondition of social justice, not a luxury affordable only to the wealthy.
justice.zh: 该委员会得出结论，平等获得法律代理是社会公正的前提，而不是只有富人才负担得起的奢侈品。

justify.en: Campaigners asked how a government could justify cutting library budgets while doubling spending on ceremonial events.
justify.zh: 活动人士质问，政府有何理由在把庆典活动开支翻倍的同时削减图书馆预算。

keep.en: City archives keep meticulous weather records stretching back two centuries, data that modern climatologists consider invaluable.
keep.zh: 城市档案馆保存着跨度达两百年的翔实天气记录，现代气候学家视之为无价的数据。

kick.en: Public health campaigns help smokers kick the habit by combining nicotine replacement with counseling rather than relying on willpower alone.
kick.zh: 公共卫生运动通过尼古丁替代与心理咨询相结合来帮助吸烟者戒除烟瘾，而不是仅靠意志力。

kid.en: Educational psychologists observe that every kid learns differently, which is one reason rigid curricula so often leave able students behind.
kid.zh: 教育心理学家观察到，每个孩子的学习方式都不同，这正是僵化的课程常常把有能力的学生甩在后面的原因之一。

kill.en: Plant pathologists confirmed that the fungus can kill infected trees within a single growing season, leaving little time for containment.
kill.zh: 植物病理学家证实，这种真菌能在一个生长季内杀死受感染的树木，几乎没给防控留下时间。

king.en: Constitutional historians trace the principle that even a king is subject to the law back to medieval disputes over taxation.
king.zh: 宪政史学家把国王也必须服从法律这一原则追溯到中世纪围绕征税的争端。

kiss.en: In cross-cultural business training, instructors warn that a greeting kiss considered warm in one country may cause serious discomfort in another.
kiss.zh: 在跨文化商务培训中，培训师提醒学员，在一个国家被视为热情的问候之吻在另一个国家可能引起严重不适。

knee.en: Orthopedic surgeons report a rise in knee injuries among amateur runners, a trend they attribute to sudden increases in training volume.
knee.zh: 骨科医生报告业余跑者的膝部损伤增多，他们将这一趋势归因于训练量的突然增加。

knowledge.en: Universities exist to produce and transmit knowledge, but employers increasingly complain that graduates lack the practical skills to apply it.
knowledge.zh: 大学存在的意义在于生产和传授知识，但雇主日益抱怨毕业生缺乏应用这些知识的实用技能。

lab.en: The university lab that produced the first working prototype now licenses the technology to manufacturers on three continents.
lab.zh: 造出首个可工作原型的这所大学实验室，如今把这项技术授权给三大洲的制造商。

label.en: Consumer groups want regulators to require a warning label on products containing artificial colors, citing studies of children's behavior.
label.zh: 消费者团体要求监管机构在含人工色素的产品上加贴警示标签，并援引了有关儿童行为的研究。

labor.en: Cheap transportation let manufacturers move production abroad, but rising labor costs in developing economies are now pulling some factories home.
labor.zh: 廉价的运输让制造商得以把生产转移到海外，但发展中经济体不断上涨的劳动力成本正把一些工厂拉回本土。

lack.en: Analysts attribute the project's failure to a lack of coordination among agencies, each of which guarded its own budget.
lack.zh: 分析人士把该项目的失败归因于各机构之间缺乏协调，而每家机构都守着自己的预算。

lady.en: Medieval literature celebrated the idealized lady of the court, an image historians read less as romance than as a code of power.
lady.zh: 中世纪文学颂扬理想化的宫廷贵妇这一形象，历史学家更多将其解读为一种权力规范，而非浪漫。

land.en: As cities expand, developers compete for scarce land near transit lines, driving housing prices beyond what average earners can afford.
land.zh: 随着城市扩张，开发商争抢公交线路沿线的稀缺土地，把房价推高到普通收入者难以承受的水平。

landfill.en: Several states now ban electronic waste from landfill sites, requiring manufacturers to finance recycling programs for discarded devices.
landfill.zh: 好几个州现已禁止电子垃圾进入垃圾填埋场，要求制造商为废弃设备出资建立回收项目。

lap.en: Engineers fitted the prototype with lighter wheels after telemetry showed it losing time on every lap of the test circuit.
lap.zh: 遥测数据显示原型车在测试赛道的每一圈都在损失时间，工程师随后为它换上了更轻的轮毂。

largely.en: The festival survives largely on volunteer labor and municipal grants, a fragile model that organizers admit cannot last forever.
largely.zh: 这个节庆主要依靠志愿劳动和市政拨款维持，组织者也承认这种脆弱的模式无法永远持续下去。

last.en: Coal-fired plants were expected to last forty years, but cheap renewables are forcing utilities to retire them decades early.
last.zh: 燃煤电厂原本被预期运行四十年，但廉价的可再生能源正迫使公用事业公司提前几十年让其退役。

later.en: Early studies dismissed the compound as inert; later experiments, however, revealed its potent effect on cell division.
later.zh: 早期研究认为这种化合物没有活性，然而后来的实验揭示了它对细胞分裂的强力作用。

latin.en: Botanical terminology still draws heavily on latin roots because early naturalists needed a stable vocabulary that crossed every national border.
latin.zh: 植物学术语至今仍大量借用拉丁语词根，因为早期博物学者需要一种能跨越每个国界的稳定词汇。

latter.en: The study compares two financing models: the former relies on user fees, while the latter depends entirely on general taxation.
latter.zh: 该研究比较了两种融资模式：前者依靠使用者付费，后者则完全依赖一般税收。

laughter.en: Neuroscientists have found that shared laughter synchronizes breathing and heart rates among listeners, strengthening social bonds within groups.
laughter.zh: 神经科学家发现，共同的笑声会使听者的呼吸和心率同步，从而强化群体内部的社会纽带。

launch.en: The agency will launch a fleet of small satellites next year to monitor illegal fishing across the western Pacific.
launch.zh: 该机构将于明年发射一批小型卫星，监测西太平洋地区的非法捕捞活动。

law.en: Economists observe that the law of supply and demand still governs housing markets, even where governments heavily subsidize construction.
law.zh: 经济学家观察到，即使在政府大力补贴建设的地区，供求法则仍然支配着住房市场。

lawn.en: Ecologists urge homeowners to replace part of the suburban lawn with native plants, which need less water and support pollinators.
lawn.zh: 生态学家敦促房主把部分郊区草坪换成原生植物，后者需水更少且能供养传粉昆虫。

lawyer.en: Public defender offices are so understaffed that a single lawyer may handle several hundred cases a year, raising questions about fair trials.
lawyer.zh: 公设辩护人办公室人手严重不足，一名律师一年可能要经手数百起案件，这引发了关于审判公平的质疑。

lay.en: The recession forced the airline to lay off a fifth of its workforce, though management promised to rehire when demand recovered.
lay.zh: 经济衰退迫使这家航空公司裁减五分之一的员工，不过管理层承诺需求恢复后会重新雇用。

layer.en: Geologists reading the sediment layer from that period found evidence of a sudden cooling event that lasted several centuries.
layer.zh: 通过解读那个时期的沉积层，地质学家找到了一场持续数个世纪的突然降温事件的证据。

lead.en: Economists warn that unchecked borrowing could lead to a currency crisis, as it has in several emerging markets before.
lead.zh: 经济学家警告，不加约束的举债可能导致货币危机，正如此前几个新兴市场经历过的那样。

leadership.en: Corporate leadership changes rarely alter strategy unless the new team also controls the board, a finding that complicates investor expectations.
leadership.zh: 公司领导层的更替很少能改变战略，除非新团队同时掌控董事会，这一发现使投资者的预期变得复杂。
